units.title: Media and technology
units.intro: Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

ex.zh: 事情没能如他所愿让他感到失望。
ex.p: shì qing méi néng rú tā suǒ yuàn ràng tā gǎn dào shī wàng
ex.en: He was disappointed that things didn't turn out as he'd hoped.

ex.zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。
ex.p: tā dìng qī qù kàn yá yī suǒ yǐ tā hěn shǎo yá tòng
ex.en: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.

ex.zh: 哪条路都可以去公园哦。
ex.p: nǎ tiáo lù dōu kě yǐ qù gōng yuán é
ex.en: You can reach the park by either road.

ex.zh: 我一直住这家酒店的哦。
ex.p: wǒ yī zhí zhù zhè jiā jiǔ diàn de é
ex.en: I always stay at this hotel.

items.en: to do; to make; to go in for

ex.zh: 他们互帮互助，把校庆搞得很成功。
ex.p: tā men hù bāng hù zhù bǎ xiào qìng gǎo de hěn chéng gōng
ex.en: They helped one another to make the school festival a success.

ex.zh: 他终于弄清楚怎么搞定这事了。
ex.p: tā zhōng yú lòng qīng chu zěn me gǎo dìng zhè shì le
ex.en: He finally found out how to make it.

ex.zh: 你就只告诉我一个人，你对她的意见如何？
ex.p: nǐ jiù zhǐ gào sù wǒ yī gè rén nǐ duì tā de yì jiàn rú hé
ex.en: Between you and me, what is your opinion of her?

ex.zh: 我一直想学习如何游泳。
ex.p: wǒ yī zhí xiǎng xué xí rú hé yóu yǒng
ex.en: I've always wanted to learn how to swim.

ex.zh: 如果他努力学习，他会通过考试的。
ex.p: rú guǒ tā nǔ lì xué xí tā huì tōng guò kǎo shì de
ex.en: If he studied hard, he would pass the test.

ex.zh: 如果他知道她的电话，他会打给她。
ex.p: rú guǒ tā zhī dào tā de diàn huà tā huì dá gěi tā
ex.en: If he knew her phone number, he could call her.

ex.zh: 你是唯一一个能帮助我们的人。
ex.p: nǐ shì wéi yī yī gè néng bāng zhù wǒ men de rén
ex.en: You're the only one who can help us.

ex.zh: 他是村子里面唯一在世的人。
ex.p: tā shì cūn zǐ lǐ miàn wéi yī zài shì de rén
ex.en: He's the only survivor in the village.

items.en: (particle equivalent to 啊 after a vowel, expressing surprise or doubt)

ex.zh: 拍火车的照片什么的，有什么好玩的呀？
ex.p: pāi huǒ chē de zhào piàn shén me de yǒu shén me hǎo wán de ya
ex.en: What's so fun about taking pictures of trains?

ex.zh: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？
ex.p: nǐ zhī bù zhī dào quán shì jiè měi nián yǒu duō shǎo rén è sǐ ya
ex.en: Do you know how many people in the world starve to death every year?

ex.zh: 你还和你的高中同学保持联系吗？
ex.p: nǐ hái hé nǐ de gāo zhōng tóng xué bǎo chí lián xì ma
ex.en: Do you keep in contact with your high school classmates?

ex.zh: 恐怕就这点上，我和你持不同意见。
ex.p: kǒng pà jiù zhè diǎn shǎng wǒ hé nǐ chí bù tóng yì jiàn
ex.en: I'm afraid I differ with you on this point.

ex.zh: 人生就是如此。
ex.p: rén shēng jiù shì rú cǐ
ex.en: That's life.

ex.zh: 早知如此，就不应该借钱给他。
ex.p: zǎo zhī rú cǐ jiù bù yīng gāi jiè qián gěi tā
ex.en: You should have known better than to lend him money.

items.en: to reside; to live; to dwell

ex.zh: 那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。
ex.p: nà gè yào de huà méi yǒu chǔ fāng shì mǎi bù dào de
ex.en: You can't buy this medicine without a prescription.

ex.zh: 发现了远处的灯光的旅行者欢喜不已。
ex.p: fā xiàn le yuǎn chù de dēng guāng de lǚ xíng zhě huan xǐ bù yǐ
ex.en: The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.

ex.zh: 我们要快点处理这问题。
ex.p: wǒ men yào kuài diǎn chǔ lǐ zhè wèn tí
ex.en: We've got to do something about this problem soon.

ex.zh: 我会尽快处理这问题。
ex.p: wǒ huì jǐn kuài chǔ lǐ zhè wèn tí
ex.en: I'll deal with this problem as soon as I can.

ex.zh: 你知道从火车站到市政府有多远？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào cóng huǒ chē zhàn dào shì zhèng fǔ yǒu duō yuǎn
ex.en: Do you know how far it is from the station to city hall?

ex.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
ex.p: zhèng fǔ yīng gāi jiā dà duì nóng yè de tóu zī
ex.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.

ex.zh: 她跑得很快是为了赶上其他成员。
ex.p: tā páo de hěn kuài shì wèi le gǎn shàng qí tā chéng yuán
ex.en: She ran very fast to catch up with the other members.

ex.zh: 我的一个兄弟是老师，其他都是律师。
ex.p: wǒ de yī gè xiōng dì shì lǎo shī qí tā dōu shì lǜ shī
ex.en: One of my brothers is a teacher and the others are lawyers.

ex.zh: 因为曾遇见过那个女孩，我马上就认出来了。
ex.p: yīn wèi zēng yù jiàn guò nà gè nǚ hái wǒ mǎ shàng jiù rèn chū lái le
ex.en: Having met the girl before, I recognized her at once.

ex.zh: 这是她曾经住过的房子。
ex.p: zhè shì tā céng jīng zhù guò de fáng zi
ex.en: This is the house where she used to live.

ex.zh: 你最喜欢的操作系统是哪个？
ex.p: nǐ zuì xǐ huan de cāo zuò xì tǒng shì nǎ gè
ex.en: What's your favorite operating system?

ex.zh: 他们已经换了系统。
ex.p: tā men yǐ jīng huàn le xì tǒng
ex.en: They've changed the system.

ex.zh: 他打出租车以及时赶到。
ex.p: tā dá chū zū chē yǐ jí shí gǎn dào
ex.en: He took a taxi to get there in time.

ex.zh: 在他们控制我们之前，我们先制服他们。
ex.p: zài tā men kòng zhì wǒ men zhī qián wǒ men xiān zhì fú tā men
ex.en: Get them before they get us.

ex.zh: 我失去了控制。
ex.p: wǒ shī qù le kòng zhì
ex.en: I'm losing my grip.

ex.zh: 谁组织了这次会议？
ex.p: shéi zǔ zhī le zhè cì huì yì
ex.en: Who organized that meeting?

ex.zh: 根本不可能做那件事。
ex.p: gēn běn bù kě néng zuò nà jiàn shì
ex.en: Doing that is simply out of the question.

ex.zh: 我根本不需要这个。
ex.p: wǒ gēn běn bù xū yào zhè gè
ex.en: I don't need this at all.

ex.zh: 我们今天所认识的工业在那个时代不存在。
ex.p: wǒ men jīn tiān suǒ rèn shi de gōng yè zài nà gè shí dài bù cún zài
ex.en: Industry as we know it today didn't exist in those days.

ex.zh: 你该把你的值钱物品保存在一个安全的地方。
ex.p: nǐ gāi bǎ nǐ de zhí qián wù pǐn bǎo cún zài yī gè ān quán de dì fāng
ex.en: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.

items.en: to lean against or on; to stand by the side of; to come near to

ex.zh: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。
ex.p: hái zi men de yī shí zhù xíng kào de shì tā men de fù mǔ
ex.en: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.

ex.zh: 天气预报一点也不可靠。
ex.p: tiān qì yù bào yī diǎn yě bù kě kào
ex.en: The weather forecast is not reliable at all.

items.en: the scene (of a crime, accident etc); (on) the spot; (at) the site

ex.zh: 警察到达了事故现场。
ex.p: jǐng chá dào dá le shì gù xiàn chǎng
ex.en: The police got to the scene of the accident.

ex.zh: 一群人聚集在现场。
ex.p: yī qún rén jù jí zài xiàn chǎng
ex.en: A crowd gathered at the scene.

items.en: in case (sth happens); if; once (sth happens, then...)

ex.zh: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。
ex.p: huài xí guàn yī dàn bèi yǎng chéng biàn bù néng jiǎn dān de gǎi zhèng
ex.en: Once you've formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.

ex.zh: 他是时代杂志的记者。
ex.p: tā shì shí dài zá zhì de jì zhě
ex.en: He is a reporter for Time magazine.

ex.zh: 我们今天所认识的工业在那个时代不存在。
ex.p: wǒ men jīn tiān suǒ rèn shi de gōng yè zài nà gè shí dài bù cún zài
ex.en: Industry as we know it today didn't exist in those days.

ex.zh: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。
ex.p: nǐ bù yīng gāi zài shè jiāo wǎng luò shǎng fēn xiǎng guò duō sī rén xìn xī
ex.en: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.

ex.zh: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。
ex.p: shù jù biǎo míng nián qīng rén chōu yān de xiàn xiàng méi yǒu jiǎn shǎo
ex.en: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.

ex.zh: 我办完事会立刻联络你。
ex.p: wǒ bàn wán shì huì lì kè lián luò nǐ
ex.en: I'll call you as soon as I've finished.

ex.zh: 医生决定立刻动手术。
ex.p: yī shēng jué dìng lì kè dòng shǒu shù
ex.en: The doctor decided to operate at once.

items.en: to interview; to gather news; to hunt for and collect

ex.zh: 你想看哪种类型的电影？
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng kàn nǎ zhǒng lèi xíng de diàn yǐng
ex.en: What kind of movie do you want to watch?

ex.zh: 你做什么类型的工作？
ex.p: nǐ zuò shén me lèi xíng de gōng zuò
ex.en: What sort of work do you do?

items.en: to search (a place); to search (a database); to search for (sth)
(TV, radio) to broadcast live; live broadcast; (Internet) to livestream

ex.zh: 软件正在不断进化。
ex.p: ruǎn jiàn zhèng zài bù duàn jìn huà
ex.en: Software is constantly evolving.

ex.zh: 我的软件全都是开源的。
ex.p: wǒ de ruǎn jiàn quán dōu shì kāi yuán de
ex.en: All of my software is open source.

ex.zh: 大多数人认为计算机永远不会有思考的能力。
ex.p: dà duō shù rén rèn wéi jì suàn jī yǒng yuǎn bù huì yǒu sī kǎo de néng lì
ex.en: Most people think computers will never be able to think.

ex.zh: 您会使用计算机吗？
ex.p: nín huì shǐ yòng jì suàn jī ma
ex.en: Can you use a computer?

ex.zh: 我认为你应该在这里开个账户。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi nǐ yīng gāi zài zhè lǐ kāi gè zhàng hù
ex.en: I think you should open an account here.

ex.zh: 我的银行账户里没留下钱。
ex.p: wǒ de yín háng zhàng hù lǐ méi liú xià qián
ex.en: There's no money left in my bank account.

items.en: so that; so as to; in order to

ex.zh: 声音大声一点，以便让坐在后边的学生能听到。
ex.p: shēng yīn dà shēng yī diǎn yǐ biàn ràng zuò zài hòu bian de xué sheng néng tīng dào
ex.en: Turn the volume up so that the students at the back can hear.

items.en: key (on a piano or computer keyboard)

ex.zh: 这正是问题的关键。
ex.p: zhè zhèng shì wèn tí de guān jiàn
ex.en: That's the point.

ex.zh: 这是一个关键点。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè guān jiàn diǎn
ex.en: This is a crucial point.

items.en: intelligent; able; smart (phone, system, bomb etc)
to act as intermediary; to link; intermediate

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第71单元

Media and technology

Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.p: nǐ zhī dào cóng huǒ chē zhàn dào shì zhèng fǔ yǒu duō yuǎn
sents.en: Do you know how far it is from the station to city hall?

sents.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
sents.p: zhèng fǔ yīng gāi jiā dà duì nóng yè de tóu zī
sents.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.

sents.zh: 她跑得很快是为了赶上其他成员。
sents.p: tā páo de hěn kuài shì wèi le gǎn shàng qí tā chéng yuán
sents.en: She ran very fast to catch up with the other members.

sents.zh: 我的一个兄弟是老师，其他都是律师。
sents.p: wǒ de yī gè xiōng dì shì lǎo shī qí tā dōu shì lǜ shī
sents.en: One of my brothers is a teacher and the others are lawyers.

sents.zh: 因为曾遇见过那个女孩，我马上就认出来了。
sents.p: yīn wèi zēng yù jiàn guò nà gè nǚ hái wǒ mǎ shàng jiù rèn chū lái le
sents.en: Having met the girl before, I recognized her at once.

sents.zh: 这是她曾经住过的房子。
sents.p: zhè shì tā céng jīng zhù guò de fáng zi
sents.en: This is the house where she used to live.

sents.zh: 你最喜欢的操作系统是哪个？
sents.p: nǐ zuì xǐ huan de cāo zuò xì tǒng shì nǎ gè
sents.en: What's your favorite operating system?

sents.zh: 他们已经换了系统。
sents.p: tā men yǐ jīng huàn le xì tǒng
sents.en: They've changed the system.

sents.zh: 他打出租车以及时赶到。
sents.p: tā dá chū zū chē yǐ jí shí gǎn dào
sents.en: He took a taxi to get there in time.

sents.zh: 在他们控制我们之前，我们先制服他们。
sents.p: zài tā men kòng zhì wǒ men zhī qián wǒ men xiān zhì fú tā men
sents.en: Get them before they get us.

sents.zh: 我失去了控制。
sents.p: wǒ shī qù le kòng zhì
sents.en: I'm losing my grip.

sents.zh: 谁组织了这次会议？
sents.p: shéi zǔ zhī le zhè cì huì yì
sents.en: Who organized that meeting?

sents.zh: 根本不可能做那件事。
sents.p: gēn běn bù kě néng zuò nà jiàn shì
sents.en: Doing that is simply out of the question.

sents.zh: 我根本不需要这个。
sents.p: wǒ gēn běn bù xū yào zhè gè
sents.en: I don't need this at all.

sents.zh: 我们今天所认识的工业在那个时代不存在。
sents.p: wǒ men jīn tiān suǒ rèn shi de gōng yè zài nà gè shí dài bù cún zài
sents.en: Industry as we know it today didn't exist in those days.

sents.zh: 你该把你的值钱物品保存在一个安全的地方。
sents.p: nǐ gāi bǎ nǐ de zhí qián wù pǐn bǎo cún zài yī gè ān quán de dì fāng
sents.en: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.

sents.zh: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。
sents.p: hái zi men de yī shí zhù xíng kào de shì tā men de fù mǔ
sents.en: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.

sents.zh: 天气预报一点也不可靠。
sents.p: tiān qì yù bào yī diǎn yě bù kě kào
sents.en: The weather forecast is not reliable at all.

sents.zh: 警察到达了事故现场。
sents.p: jǐng chá dào dá le shì gù xiàn chǎng
sents.en: The police got to the scene of the accident.

sents.zh: 一群人聚集在现场。
sents.p: yī qún rén jù jí zài xiàn chǎng
sents.en: A crowd gathered at the scene.

sents.zh: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。
sents.p: huài xí guàn yī dàn bèi yǎng chéng biàn bù néng jiǎn dān de gǎi zhèng
sents.en: Once you've formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.

sents.zh: 他是时代杂志的记者。
sents.p: tā shì shí dài zá zhì de jì zhě
sents.en: He is a reporter for Time magazine.

sents.zh: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。
sents.p: nǐ bù yīng gāi zài shè jiāo wǎng luò shǎng fēn xiǎng guò duō sī rén xìn xī
sents.en: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.

sents.zh: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。
sents.p: shù jù biǎo míng nián qīng rén chōu yān de xiàn xiàng méi yǒu jiǎn shǎo
sents.en: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.

sents.zh: 我办完事会立刻联络你。
sents.p: wǒ bàn wán shì huì lì kè lián luò nǐ
sents.en: I'll call you as soon as I've finished.

sents.zh: 医生决定立刻动手术。
sents.p: yī shēng jué dìng lì kè dòng shǒu shù
sents.en: The doctor decided to operate at once.

sents.zh: 你想看哪种类型的电影？
sents.p: nǐ xiǎng kàn nǎ zhǒng lèi xíng de diàn yǐng
sents.en: What kind of movie do you want to watch?

sents.zh: 你做什么类型的工作？
sents.p: nǐ zuò shén me lèi xíng de gōng zuò
sents.en: What sort of work do you do?

sents.zh: 软件正在不断进化。
sents.p: ruǎn jiàn zhèng zài bù duàn jìn huà
sents.en: Software is constantly evolving.

sents.zh: 我的软件全都是开源的。
sents.p: wǒ de ruǎn jiàn quán dōu shì kāi yuán de
sents.en: All of my software is open source.

sents.zh: 大多数人认为计算机永远不会有思考的能力。
sents.p: dà duō shù rén rèn wéi jì suàn jī yǒng yuǎn bù huì yǒu sī kǎo de néng lì
sents.en: Most people think computers will never be able to think.

sents.zh: 您会使用计算机吗？
sents.p: nín huì shǐ yòng jì suàn jī ma
sents.en: Can you use a computer?

sents.zh: 我认为你应该在这里开个账户。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi nǐ yīng gāi zài zhè lǐ kāi gè zhàng hù
sents.en: I think you should open an account here.

sents.zh: 我的银行账户里没留下钱。
sents.p: wǒ de yín háng zhàng hù lǐ méi liú xià qián
sents.en: There's no money left in my bank account.

sents.zh: 声音大声一点，以便让坐在后边的学生能听到。
sents.p: shēng yīn dà shēng yī diǎn yǐ biàn ràng zuò zài hòu bian de xué sheng néng tīng dào
sents.en: Turn the volume up so that the students at the back can hear.

sents.zh: 这正是问题的关键。
sents.p: zhè zhèng shì wèn tí de guān jiàn
sents.en: That's the point.

sents.zh: 这是一个关键点。
sents.p: zhè shì yī gè guān jiàn diǎn
sents.en: This is a crucial point.

units.title: Media and technology
units.intro: Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

ex.zh: 他是前几天和你见过面的那个人。
ex.p: tā shì qián jī tiān hé nǐ jiàn guò miàn de nà gè rén
ex.en: He is the man you met the other day.

ex.zh: 他是你前些时候见过的那个人。
ex.p: tā shì nǐ qián xiē shí hou jiàn guò de nà gè rén
ex.en: He is the man you met the other day.

items.en: to keep; to maintain; to hold

ex.zh: 你应该一直让手保持干净。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi yī zhí ràng shǒu bǎo chí gān jìng
ex.en: You must always keep your hands clean.

ex.zh: 您应该一直让手保持干净。
ex.p: nín yīng gāi yī zhí ràng shǒu bǎo chí gān jìng
ex.en: You must always keep your hands clean.

ex.zh: 地图上的蓝线代表河流。
ex.p: dì tú shǎng de lán xiàn dài biǎo hé liú
ex.en: The blue lines on the map represent rivers.

ex.zh: 我知道金钱不代表一切。
ex.p: wǒ zhī dào jīn qián bù dài biǎo yī qiè
ex.en: I know that money isn't everything.

items.en: to exceed; to overtake; to surpass

ex.zh: 他有超过一百万美元的资产。
ex.p: tā yǒu chāo guò yī bǎi mò měi yuán de zī chǎn
ex.en: He has over a million dollars in assets.

ex.zh: 他应该超过六十岁了。
ex.p: tā yīng gāi chāo guò liù shí suì le
ex.en: He must be over sixty.

ex.zh: 我无法确定我是高兴还是难过。
ex.p: wǒ wú fǎ què dìng wǒ shì gāo xìng hái shi nán guò
ex.en: I can't decide if I'm happy or sad.

ex.zh: 我不确定当时我正在想什么。
ex.p: wǒ bù què dìng dāng shí wǒ zhèng zài xiǎng shén me
ex.en: I'm not sure what I was thinking.

ex.zh: 巴士会把你们带到市中心。
ex.p: bā shì huì bǎ nǐ men dài dào shì zhōng xīn
ex.en: The bus will take you to the center of the city.

ex.zh: 市中心有很多旅馆。
ex.p: shì zhōng xīn yǒu hěn duō lǚ guǎn
ex.en: There are many hotels downtown.

ex.zh: 他们根据情报采取行动。
ex.p: tā men gēn jù qíng bào cǎi qǔ xíng dòng
ex.en: They acted on the information.

ex.zh: 现在是行动的时候了。
ex.p: xiàn zài shì xíng dòng de shí hou le
ex.en: Now is the time to act.

items.en: to cooperate; to collaborate; to work together

ex.zh: 我需要你们的合作。
ex.p: wǒ xū yào nǐ men de hé zuò
ex.en: I need your cooperation.

ex.zh: 这两个男人是生意上的合作伙伴。
ex.p: zhè liǎng gè nán rén shì shēng yì shǎng de hé zuò huǒ bàn
ex.en: The two men were business partners.

items.en: abbr. for 哈萨克斯坦, Kazakhstan

ex.zh: 他们都哈哈大笑起来。
ex.p: tā men dōu hā hā dà xiào qǐ lai
ex.en: They all burst out laughing.

ex.zh: 他是哈佛大学的生物学教授。
ex.p: tā shì hā fó dà xué de shēng wù xué jiào shòu
ex.en: He's a professor of biology at Harvard.

ex.zh: 六岁及以上的小孩应该上学。
ex.p: liù suì jí yǐ shàng de xiǎo hái yīng gāi shàng xué
ex.en: Children of six and above should attend school.

ex.zh: 我等不及要去度假。
ex.p: wǒ děng bù jí yào qù dù jià
ex.en: I can't wait to go on a vacation.

items.en: to inform; to report; to make known

ex.zh: 在明天前完成报告几乎是不可能的。
ex.p: zài míng tiān qián wán chéng bào gào jī hū shì bù kě néng de
ex.en: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.

ex.zh: 你写这份报告花了多长时间？
ex.p: nǐ xiě zhè fèn bào gào huā le duō cháng shí jiān
ex.en: How long did it take you to write this report?

items.en: to treat (an illness); medical treatment; therapy

ex.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。
ex.p: yù fáng cuò shī bǐ zhēn zhèng de zhì liáo gēng yǒu xiào
ex.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.

ex.zh: 没有药物能够治疗这种疾病。
ex.p: méi yǒu yào wù néng gòu zhì liáo zhè zhǒng jí bìng
ex.en: No medicine can cure this disease.

ex.zh: 拥有一切的人可能会失去一切。
ex.p: yōng yǒu yī qiè de rén kě néng huì shī qù yī qiè
ex.en: One who has everything can lose everything.

ex.zh: 每个人都想要得到无法拥有的东西
ex.p: měi gè rén dōu xiǎng yào dé dào wú fǎ yōng yǒu de dōng xī
ex.en: Everyone wants what they can't have.

ex.zh: 我妹妹的英语有了明显的进步。
ex.p: wǒ mèi mei de yīng yǔ yǒu le míng xiǎn de jìn bù
ex.en: My sister has made remarkable progress in English.

ex.zh: 一百多个人在一个火车事故中受了伤。
ex.p: yī bǎi duō gè rén zài yī gè huǒ chē shì gù zhōng shòu le shāng
ex.en: A hundred people were hurt in a train wreck.

ex.zh: 你不再能伤害到我了。
ex.p: nǐ bù zài néng shāng hài dào wǒ le
ex.en: You can no longer hurt me.

ex.zh: 我也想要和你身上那件同样的外套。
ex.p: wǒ yě xiǎng yào hé nǐ shēn shang nà jiàn tóng yàng de wài tào
ex.en: I want the same jacket as you're wearing.

ex.zh: 您最好在外衣里穿一件套衫。
ex.p: nín zuì hǎo zài wài yī lǐ chuān yī jiàn tào shān
ex.en: You'd better wear a sweater under your jacket.

ex.zh: 一个人要为他的行为负责。
ex.p: yī gè rén yào wèi tā de xíng wéi fù zé
ex.en: A man is responsible for his deeds.

ex.zh: 你的行为离要求的太远了。
ex.p: nǐ de xíng wéi chī yāo qiú de tài yuǎn le
ex.en: Your behavior leaves much to be desired.

ex.zh: 生活中绝对没有什么是持久的。
ex.p: shēng huó zhōng jué duì méi yǒu shén me shì chí jiǔ de
ex.en: Absolutely nothing is permanent in life.

ex.zh: 让我像这样继续下去是绝对不可能的。
ex.p: ràng wǒ xiàng zhè yàng jì xù xià qù shì jué duì bù kě néng de
ex.en: It's absolutely impossible for me to go on like this.

ex.zh: 昨天的派对上她并没有如约而至。
ex.p: zuó tiān de pài duì shǎng tā bìng méi yǒu rú yāo ér zhì
ex.en: She didn't show up at the party yesterday.

ex.zh: 在派对中我和他聊得很开心。
ex.p: zài pài duì zhōng wǒ hé tā liáo de hěn kāi xīn
ex.en: I enjoyed talking with him at the party.

items.en: eye; small hole; crux (of a matter)

ex.zh: 他就算带了眼镜也看得不很清楚。
ex.p: tā jiù suàn dài le yǎn jìng yě kàn de bù hěn qīng chu
ex.en: Even with his glasses, he doesn't see very well.

ex.zh: 我没带眼镜就什么都看不到。
ex.p: wǒ méi dài yǎn jìng jiù shén me dōu kàn bù dào
ex.en: I can't see anything without my glasses.

items.en: to design; to plan; design; plan

ex.zh: 我改了一下我网站的版面设计。
ex.p: wǒ gǎi le yī xià wǒ wǎng zhàn de bǎn miàn shè jì
ex.en: I've changed my website's layout.

ex.zh: 润滑系统设计得不好。
ex.p: rùn huá xì tǒng shè jì de bù hǎo
ex.en: The lubrication system was poorly designed.

ex.zh: 他正在思考他未来的生活。
ex.p: tā zhèng zài sī kǎo tā wèi lái de shēng huó
ex.en: He was meditating on his future life.

ex.zh: 孩子是我们的未来。
ex.p: hái zi shì wǒ men de wèi lái
ex.en: Children are our future.

items.en: to exploit; to make use of; to use

ex.zh: 她常常利用他的无知。
ex.p: tā cháng cháng lì yòng tā de wú zhī
ex.en: She often takes advantage of his ignorance.

ex.zh: 来好好利用大周末吧。
ex.p: lái hǎo hǎo lì yòng dà zhōu mò ba
ex.en: Let's take advantage of the long weekend.

ex.zh: 他给我们带来了令人难过的消息。
ex.p: tā gěi wǒ men dài lái le líng rén nán guò de xiāo xi
ex.en: He brought us sad news.

ex.zh: 医生发现了一些令人吃惊的事实。
ex.p: yī shēng fā xiàn le yī xiē líng rén chī jīng de shì shí
ex.en: Doctors have discovered some startling facts.

items.en: to comprise; to include; to involve
to grab; to catch; to arrest

ex.zh: 如果你不抓紧的话，你就会赶不上火车。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù zhuā jǐn de huà nǐ jiù huì gǎn bù shàng huǒ chē
ex.en: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.

ex.zh: 如果你抓紧，你还能赶上火车。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ zhuā jǐn nǐ hái néng gǎn shàng huǒ chē
ex.en: If you hurry you can still make the train.

ex.zh: 从某种意义上来说，她也是对的。
ex.p: cóng mǒu zhǒng yì yì shàng lái shuō tā yě shì duì de
ex.en: In a sense, she is right, too.

ex.zh: 这对于我来说没任何意义。
ex.p: zhè duì yú wǒ lái shuō méi rèn hé yì yì
ex.en: It doesn't make sense to me.

ex.zh: 即便是小孩子也能做到呢。
ex.p: jí biàn shì xiǎo hái zi yě néng zuò dào ne
ex.en: Even a child can do it.

ex.zh: 他很快便与小区里新来的男孩交上了朋友。
ex.p: tā hěn kuài biàn yú xiǎo qū lǐ xīn lái de nán hái jiāo shǎng le péng you
ex.en: He quickly made friends with the new boy on the block.

ex.zh: 你成功与否取决于你自身的努力。
ex.p: nǐ chéng gōng yǔ fǒu qǔ jué yú nǐ zì shēn de nǔ lì
ex.en: Whether you succeed or not depends on your own efforts.

ex.zh: 你记事情的能力并不比我好多少。
ex.p: nǐ jì shì qing de néng lì bìng bù bǐ wǒ hǎo duō shǎo
ex.en: You are no better at remembering things than I am.

items.en: to deal; to trade; to transact; transaction; deal

ex.zh: 这是一笔不错的交易。
ex.p: zhè shì yī bǐ bù cuò de jiāo yì
ex.en: It's a good deal.

ex.zh: 我看你该做这交易。
ex.p: wǒ kàn nǐ gāi zuò zhè jiāo yì
ex.en: I think you should make the deal.

ex.zh: 不要低估我的力量。
ex.p: bù yào dī gū wǒ de lì liang
ex.en: Don't underestimate my power.

ex.zh: 不要小看我的力量。
ex.p: bù yào xiǎo kàn wǒ de lì liang
ex.en: Don't underestimate my power.

ex.zh: 公司放弃了那个项目。
ex.p: gōng sī fàng qì le nà gè xiàng mù
ex.en: The company abandoned that project.

ex.zh: 这是我最喜欢的项目。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de xiàng mù
ex.en: This is my favorite project.

items.en: to bring about; to create; to cause

ex.zh: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。
ex.p: jìn lái kā fēi de duǎn quē zào chéng le xǔ duō wèn tí
ex.en: The recent coffee shortage brought about many problems.

ex.zh: 我把车库改造成车间使用。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ chē kù gǎi zào chéng chē jiān shǐ yòng
ex.en: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.

items.en: some; a certain; sb or sth indefinite

ex.zh: 我知道这看起来像是失去了某人。
ex.p: wǒ zhī dào zhè kàn qǐ lai xiàng shì shī qù le mǒu rén
ex.en: I know what it's like to lose someone.

ex.zh: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。
ex.p: zài mǒu zhǒng chéng dù shǎng wǒ rèn tóng nǐ suǒ shuō de
ex.en: I agree with what you say to some extent.

ex.zh: 我让他随我来，他同意了。
ex.p: wǒ ràng tā suí wǒ lái tā tóng yì le
ex.en: I asked him to come with me and he agreed.

ex.zh: 你就随了我的意吧。
ex.p: nǐ jiù suí le wǒ de yì ba
ex.en: Humor me.

ex.zh: 我不期望，他们能够支持我的观点。
ex.p: wǒ bù qī wàng tā men néng gòu zhī chí wǒ de guān diǎn
ex.en: I don't expect that they will support my view.

ex.zh: 如果你需要笔的话，我借你一支。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ xū yào bǐ de huà wǒ jiè nǐ yī zhī
ex.en: If you need a pen, I'll lend you one.

ex.zh: 现在的人教育程度比以前高得多。
ex.p: xiàn zài de rén jiào yù chéng dù bǐ yǐ qián gāo de duō
ex.en: People are more educated now than they used to be.

ex.zh: 今晚我度过了一段非常美好的时光。
ex.p: jīn wǎn wǒ dù guò le yī duàn fēi cháng měi hǎo de shí guāng
ex.en: I had a really nice time tonight.

ex.zh: 这本书他们读起来够简单了。
ex.p: zhè běn shū tā men dòu qǐ lai gòu jiǎn dān le
ex.en: This book is easy enough for them to read.

ex.zh: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。
ex.p: wǒ men de qián bù gòu suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǐ hǎo bǎ dìng dān qǔ xiāo le
ex.en: I had to cancel the order because we didn't have enough money.

ex.zh: 我弟弟非常重要。至少他认为他是。
ex.p: wǒ dì di fēi cháng zhòng yào zhì shǎo tā rèn wéi tā shì
ex.en: My brother is very important. At least he thinks he is.

ex.zh: 她太过好奇，以至于打开了盒子。
ex.p: tā tài guò hào qí yǐ zhì yú dǎ kāi le hé zi
ex.en: She was so curious that she opened the box.

ex.zh: 一场令人难忘的事件发生了。
ex.p: yī cháng líng rén nán wàng de shì jiàn fā shēng le
ex.en: An unforgettable event occurred.

ex.zh: 这只是偶发事件。
ex.p: zhè zhǐ shì ǒu fā shì jiàn
ex.en: That only happens occasionally.

ex.zh: 他认为只有训练有素的演员才能够获得成功。
ex.p: tā rèn wéi zhǐ yǒu xùn liàn yǒu sù de yǎn yuán cái néng gòu huò dé chéng gōng
ex.en: He thinks that only very well trained actors can be really successful.

ex.zh: 总统在电视上对国民讲话。
ex.p: zǒng tǒng zài diàn shì shǎng duì guó mín jiǎng huà
ex.en: The President spoke to the nation on TV.

ex.zh: 总统拒绝回答那个问题。
ex.p: zǒng tǒng jù jué huí dá nà gè wèn tí
ex.en: The President refused to answer the question.

ex.zh: 她似乎比以往任何时候都漂亮。
ex.p: tā sì hū bǐ yǐ wǎng rèn hé shí hou dōu piào liang
ex.en: She looked more beautiful than ever.

ex.zh: 我弟弟似乎在大学过得很愉快。
ex.p: wǒ dì di sì hū zài dà xué guò de hěn yú kuài
ex.en: My brother seems to enjoy himself at college.

ex.zh: 根据天气预报，雨季下周会开始。
ex.p: gēn jù tiān qì yù bào yǔ jì xià zhōu huì kāi shǐ
ex.en: According to the weather forecast, the rainy season will set in next week.

ex.zh: 据我所知，他没做错任何事。
ex.p: jù wǒ suǒ zhī tā méi zuò cuò rèn hé shì
ex.en: As far as I know, he did nothing wrong.

ex.zh: 这个球是那个男孩的宝贝。
ex.p: zhè gè qiú shì nà gè nán hái de bǎo bèi
ex.en: This ball is that boy's treasure.

ex.zh: 他是家里的宝贝。
ex.p: tā shì jiā lǐ de bǎo bèi
ex.en: He is the baby of the family.

ex.zh: 日本是世界高科技产业的领头人。
ex.p: rì běn shì shì jiè gāo kē jì chǎn yè de lǐng tóu rén
ex.en: Japan is a leader in the world's high-tech industry.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第72单元

Media and technology

Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 他是前几天和你见过面的那个人。
sents.p: tā shì qián jī tiān hé nǐ jiàn guò miàn de nà gè rén
sents.en: He is the man you met the other day.

sents.zh: 他是你前些时候见过的那个人。
sents.p: tā shì nǐ qián xiē shí hou jiàn guò de nà gè rén
sents.en: He is the man you met the other day.

sents.zh: 你应该一直让手保持干净。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi yī zhí ràng shǒu bǎo chí gān jìng
sents.en: You must always keep your hands clean.

sents.zh: 您应该一直让手保持干净。
sents.p: nín yīng gāi yī zhí ràng shǒu bǎo chí gān jìng
sents.en: You must always keep your hands clean.

sents.zh: 地图上的蓝线代表河流。
sents.p: dì tú shǎng de lán xiàn dài biǎo hé liú
sents.en: The blue lines on the map represent rivers.

sents.zh: 我知道金钱不代表一切。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào jīn qián bù dài biǎo yī qiè
sents.en: I know that money isn't everything.

sents.zh: 他有超过一百万美元的资产。
sents.p: tā yǒu chāo guò yī bǎi mò měi yuán de zī chǎn
sents.en: He has over a million dollars in assets.

sents.zh: 他应该超过六十岁了。
sents.p: tā yīng gāi chāo guò liù shí suì le
sents.en: He must be over sixty.

sents.zh: 我无法确定我是高兴还是难过。
sents.p: wǒ wú fǎ què dìng wǒ shì gāo xìng hái shi nán guò
sents.en: I can't decide if I'm happy or sad.

sents.zh: 我不确定当时我正在想什么。
sents.p: wǒ bù què dìng dāng shí wǒ zhèng zài xiǎng shén me
sents.en: I'm not sure what I was thinking.

sents.zh: 巴士会把你们带到市中心。
sents.p: bā shì huì bǎ nǐ men dài dào shì zhōng xīn
sents.en: The bus will take you to the center of the city.

sents.zh: 市中心有很多旅馆。
sents.p: shì zhōng xīn yǒu hěn duō lǚ guǎn
sents.en: There are many hotels downtown.

sents.zh: 他们根据情报采取行动。
sents.p: tā men gēn jù qíng bào cǎi qǔ xíng dòng
sents.en: They acted on the information.

sents.zh: 现在是行动的时候了。
sents.p: xiàn zài shì xíng dòng de shí hou le
sents.en: Now is the time to act.

sents.zh: 我需要你们的合作。
sents.p: wǒ xū yào nǐ men de hé zuò
sents.en: I need your cooperation.

sents.zh: 这两个男人是生意上的合作伙伴。
sents.p: zhè liǎng gè nán rén shì shēng yì shǎng de hé zuò huǒ bàn
sents.en: The two men were business partners.

sents.zh: 他们都哈哈大笑起来。
sents.p: tā men dōu hā hā dà xiào qǐ lai
sents.en: They all burst out laughing.

sents.zh: 他是哈佛大学的生物学教授。
sents.p: tā shì hā fó dà xué de shēng wù xué jiào shòu
sents.en: He's a professor of biology at Harvard.

sents.zh: 六岁及以上的小孩应该上学。
sents.p: liù suì jí yǐ shàng de xiǎo hái yīng gāi shàng xué
sents.en: Children of six and above should attend school.

sents.zh: 我等不及要去度假。
sents.p: wǒ děng bù jí yào qù dù jià
sents.en: I can't wait to go on a vacation.

sents.zh: 在明天前完成报告几乎是不可能的。
sents.p: zài míng tiān qián wán chéng bào gào jī hū shì bù kě néng de
sents.en: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.

sents.zh: 你写这份报告花了多长时间？
sents.p: nǐ xiě zhè fèn bào gào huā le duō cháng shí jiān
sents.en: How long did it take you to write this report?

sents.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。
sents.p: yù fáng cuò shī bǐ zhēn zhèng de zhì liáo gēng yǒu xiào
sents.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.

sents.zh: 没有药物能够治疗这种疾病。
sents.p: méi yǒu yào wù néng gòu zhì liáo zhè zhǒng jí bìng
sents.en: No medicine can cure this disease.

sents.zh: 拥有一切的人可能会失去一切。
sents.p: yōng yǒu yī qiè de rén kě néng huì shī qù yī qiè
sents.en: One who has everything can lose everything.

sents.zh: 每个人都想要得到无法拥有的东西
sents.p: měi gè rén dōu xiǎng yào dé dào wú fǎ yōng yǒu de dōng xī
sents.en: Everyone wants what they can't have.

sents.zh: 我妹妹的英语有了明显的进步。
sents.p: wǒ mèi mei de yīng yǔ yǒu le míng xiǎn de jìn bù
sents.en: My sister has made remarkable progress in English.

sents.zh: 一百多个人在一个火车事故中受了伤。
sents.p: yī bǎi duō gè rén zài yī gè huǒ chē shì gù zhōng shòu le shāng
sents.en: A hundred people were hurt in a train wreck.

sents.zh: 你不再能伤害到我了。
sents.p: nǐ bù zài néng shāng hài dào wǒ le
sents.en: You can no longer hurt me.

sents.zh: 我也想要和你身上那件同样的外套。
sents.p: wǒ yě xiǎng yào hé nǐ shēn shang nà jiàn tóng yàng de wài tào
sents.en: I want the same jacket as you're wearing.

sents.zh: 您最好在外衣里穿一件套衫。
sents.p: nín zuì hǎo zài wài yī lǐ chuān yī jiàn tào shān
sents.en: You'd better wear a sweater under your jacket.

sents.zh: 一个人要为他的行为负责。
sents.p: yī gè rén yào wèi tā de xíng wéi fù zé
sents.en: A man is responsible for his deeds.

sents.zh: 你的行为离要求的太远了。
sents.p: nǐ de xíng wéi chī yāo qiú de tài yuǎn le
sents.en: Your behavior leaves much to be desired.

sents.zh: 生活中绝对没有什么是持久的。
sents.p: shēng huó zhōng jué duì méi yǒu shén me shì chí jiǔ de
sents.en: Absolutely nothing is permanent in life.

sents.zh: 让我像这样继续下去是绝对不可能的。
sents.p: ràng wǒ xiàng zhè yàng jì xù xià qù shì jué duì bù kě néng de
sents.en: It's absolutely impossible for me to go on like this.

sents.zh: 昨天的派对上她并没有如约而至。
sents.p: zuó tiān de pài duì shǎng tā bìng méi yǒu rú yāo ér zhì
sents.en: She didn't show up at the party yesterday.

sents.zh: 在派对中我和他聊得很开心。
sents.p: zài pài duì zhōng wǒ hé tā liáo de hěn kāi xīn
sents.en: I enjoyed talking with him at the party.

sents.zh: 他就算带了眼镜也看得不很清楚。
sents.p: tā jiù suàn dài le yǎn jìng yě kàn de bù hěn qīng chu
sents.en: Even with his glasses, he doesn't see very well.

sents.zh: 我没带眼镜就什么都看不到。
sents.p: wǒ méi dài yǎn jìng jiù shén me dōu kàn bù dào
sents.en: I can't see anything without my glasses.

sents.zh: 我改了一下我网站的版面设计。
sents.p: wǒ gǎi le yī xià wǒ wǎng zhàn de bǎn miàn shè jì
sents.en: I've changed my website's layout.

sents.zh: 润滑系统设计得不好。
sents.p: rùn huá xì tǒng shè jì de bù hǎo
sents.en: The lubrication system was poorly designed.

sents.zh: 他正在思考他未来的生活。
sents.p: tā zhèng zài sī kǎo tā wèi lái de shēng huó
sents.en: He was meditating on his future life.

sents.zh: 孩子是我们的未来。
sents.p: hái zi shì wǒ men de wèi lái
sents.en: Children are our future.

sents.zh: 她常常利用他的无知。
sents.p: tā cháng cháng lì yòng tā de wú zhī
sents.en: She often takes advantage of his ignorance.

sents.zh: 来好好利用大周末吧。
sents.p: lái hǎo hǎo lì yòng dà zhōu mò ba
sents.en: Let's take advantage of the long weekend.

sents.zh: 他给我们带来了令人难过的消息。
sents.p: tā gěi wǒ men dài lái le líng rén nán guò de xiāo xi
sents.en: He brought us sad news.

sents.zh: 医生发现了一些令人吃惊的事实。
sents.p: yī shēng fā xiàn le yī xiē líng rén chī jīng de shì shí
sents.en: Doctors have discovered some startling facts.

sents.zh: 如果你不抓紧的话，你就会赶不上火车。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù zhuā jǐn de huà nǐ jiù huì gǎn bù shàng huǒ chē
sents.en: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.

sents.zh: 如果你抓紧，你还能赶上火车。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ zhuā jǐn nǐ hái néng gǎn shàng huǒ chē
sents.en: If you hurry you can still make the train.

sents.zh: 从某种意义上来说，她也是对的。
sents.p: cóng mǒu zhǒng yì yì shàng lái shuō tā yě shì duì de
sents.en: In a sense, she is right, too.

sents.zh: 这对于我来说没任何意义。
sents.p: zhè duì yú wǒ lái shuō méi rèn hé yì yì
sents.en: It doesn't make sense to me.

sents.zh: 即便是小孩子也能做到呢。
sents.p: jí biàn shì xiǎo hái zi yě néng zuò dào ne
sents.en: Even a child can do it.

sents.zh: 他很快便与小区里新来的男孩交上了朋友。
sents.p: tā hěn kuài biàn yú xiǎo qū lǐ xīn lái de nán hái jiāo shǎng le péng you
sents.en: He quickly made friends with the new boy on the block.

sents.zh: 你成功与否取决于你自身的努力。
sents.p: nǐ chéng gōng yǔ fǒu qǔ jué yú nǐ zì shēn de nǔ lì
sents.en: Whether you succeed or not depends on your own efforts.

sents.zh: 你记事情的能力并不比我好多少。
sents.p: nǐ jì shì qing de néng lì bìng bù bǐ wǒ hǎo duō shǎo
sents.en: You are no better at remembering things than I am.

sents.zh: 这是一笔不错的交易。
sents.p: zhè shì yī bǐ bù cuò de jiāo yì
sents.en: It's a good deal.

sents.zh: 我看你该做这交易。
sents.p: wǒ kàn nǐ gāi zuò zhè jiāo yì
sents.en: I think you should make the deal.

sents.zh: 不要低估我的力量。
sents.p: bù yào dī gū wǒ de lì liang
sents.en: Don't underestimate my power.

sents.zh: 不要小看我的力量。
sents.p: bù yào xiǎo kàn wǒ de lì liang
sents.en: Don't underestimate my power.

sents.zh: 公司放弃了那个项目。
sents.p: gōng sī fàng qì le nà gè xiàng mù
sents.en: The company abandoned that project.

sents.zh: 这是我最喜欢的项目。
sents.p: zhè shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de xiàng mù
sents.en: This is my favorite project.

sents.zh: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。
sents.p: jìn lái kā fēi de duǎn quē zào chéng le xǔ duō wèn tí
sents.en: The recent coffee shortage brought about many problems.

sents.zh: 我把车库改造成车间使用。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ chē kù gǎi zào chéng chē jiān shǐ yòng
sents.en: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.

sents.zh: 我知道这看起来像是失去了某人。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào zhè kàn qǐ lai xiàng shì shī qù le mǒu rén
sents.en: I know what it's like to lose someone.

sents.zh: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。
sents.p: zài mǒu zhǒng chéng dù shǎng wǒ rèn tóng nǐ suǒ shuō de
sents.en: I agree with what you say to some extent.

sents.zh: 我让他随我来，他同意了。
sents.p: wǒ ràng tā suí wǒ lái tā tóng yì le
sents.en: I asked him to come with me and he agreed.

sents.zh: 你就随了我的意吧。
sents.p: nǐ jiù suí le wǒ de yì ba
sents.en: Humor me.

sents.zh: 我不期望，他们能够支持我的观点。
sents.p: wǒ bù qī wàng tā men néng gòu zhī chí wǒ de guān diǎn
sents.en: I don't expect that they will support my view.

sents.zh: 如果你需要笔的话，我借你一支。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ xū yào bǐ de huà wǒ jiè nǐ yī zhī
sents.en: If you need a pen, I'll lend you one.

sents.zh: 现在的人教育程度比以前高得多。
sents.p: xiàn zài de rén jiào yù chéng dù bǐ yǐ qián gāo de duō
sents.en: People are more educated now than they used to be.

sents.zh: 今晚我度过了一段非常美好的时光。
sents.p: jīn wǎn wǒ dù guò le yī duàn fēi cháng měi hǎo de shí guāng
sents.en: I had a really nice time tonight.

sents.zh: 这本书他们读起来够简单了。
sents.p: zhè běn shū tā men dòu qǐ lai gòu jiǎn dān le
sents.en: This book is easy enough for them to read.

sents.zh: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。
sents.p: wǒ men de qián bù gòu suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǐ hǎo bǎ dìng dān qǔ xiāo le
sents.en: I had to cancel the order because we didn't have enough money.

sents.zh: 我弟弟非常重要。至少他认为他是。
sents.p: wǒ dì di fēi cháng zhòng yào zhì shǎo tā rèn wéi tā shì
sents.en: My brother is very important. At least he thinks he is.

sents.zh: 她太过好奇，以至于打开了盒子。
sents.p: tā tài guò hào qí yǐ zhì yú dǎ kāi le hé zi
sents.en: She was so curious that she opened the box.

sents.zh: 一场令人难忘的事件发生了。
sents.p: yī cháng líng rén nán wàng de shì jiàn fā shēng le
sents.en: An unforgettable event occurred.

sents.zh: 这只是偶发事件。
sents.p: zhè zhǐ shì ǒu fā shì jiàn
sents.en: That only happens occasionally.

sents.zh: 他认为只有训练有素的演员才能够获得成功。
sents.p: tā rèn wéi zhǐ yǒu xùn liàn yǒu sù de yǎn yuán cái néng gòu huò dé chéng gōng
sents.en: He thinks that only very well trained actors can be really successful.

sents.zh: 总统在电视上对国民讲话。
sents.p: zǒng tǒng zài diàn shì shǎng duì guó mín jiǎng huà
sents.en: The President spoke to the nation on TV.

sents.zh: 总统拒绝回答那个问题。
sents.p: zǒng tǒng jù jué huí dá nà gè wèn tí
sents.en: The President refused to answer the question.

sents.zh: 她似乎比以往任何时候都漂亮。
sents.p: tā sì hū bǐ yǐ wǎng rèn hé shí hou dōu piào liang
sents.en: She looked more beautiful than ever.

sents.zh: 我弟弟似乎在大学过得很愉快。
sents.p: wǒ dì di sì hū zài dà xué guò de hěn yú kuài
sents.en: My brother seems to enjoy himself at college.

sents.zh: 根据天气预报，雨季下周会开始。
sents.p: gēn jù tiān qì yù bào yǔ jì xià zhōu huì kāi shǐ
sents.en: According to the weather forecast, the rainy season will set in next week.

sents.zh: 据我所知，他没做错任何事。
sents.p: jù wǒ suǒ zhī tā méi zuò cuò rèn hé shì
sents.en: As far as I know, he did nothing wrong.

sents.zh: 这个球是那个男孩的宝贝。
sents.p: zhè gè qiú shì nà gè nán hái de bǎo bèi
sents.en: This ball is that boy's treasure.

sents.zh: 他是家里的宝贝。
sents.p: tā shì jiā lǐ de bǎo bèi
sents.en: He is the baby of the family.

sents.zh: 日本是世界高科技产业的领头人。
sents.p: rì běn shì shì jiè gāo kē jì chǎn yè de lǐng tóu rén
sents.en: Japan is a leader in the world's high-tech industry.

units.title: Media and technology
units.intro: Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

ex.zh: 地图帮助我们知道所在的位置。
ex.p: dì tú bāng zhù wǒ men zhī dào suǒ zài de wèi zhi
ex.en: A map helps us to know where we are.

ex.zh: 教堂在村子的中心位置。
ex.p: jiào táng zài cūn zǐ de zhōng xīn wèi zhi
ex.en: The church is in the middle of the village.

ex.zh: 图书馆是我最喜欢去的地方之一。
ex.p: tú shū guǎn shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan qù de dì fāng zhī yī
ex.en: The library is one of my favorite places.

ex.zh: 学习一门语言最好的方法是什么？
ex.p: xué xí yī mén yǔ yán zuì hǎo de fāng fǎ shì shén me
ex.en: What's the best way to learn a language?

ex.zh: 他弟弟是个有名的足球选手。
ex.p: tā dì di shì gè yǒu míng de zú qiú xuǎn shǒu
ex.en: His brother is a famous soccer player.

ex.zh: 我们没机会赢那些一流选手。
ex.p: wǒ men méi jī huì yíng nà xiē yī liú xuǎn shǒu
ex.en: We have no chance against those top players.

ex.zh: 我没有参与对话。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu cān yù duì huà
ex.en: I did not participate in the dialog.

ex.zh: 参与者大部分是女性。
ex.p: cān yù zhě dà bù fen shì nǚ xìng
ex.en: The participants were for the most part women.

items.en: to show; to illustrate; to display
to be classified as; to belong to; to be part of

ex.zh: 我们俩不属于这儿。
ex.p: wǒ men liǎ bù shǔ yú zhèr
ex.en: The two of us don't belong here.

ex.zh: 这辆自行车属于我。
ex.p: zhè liàng zì xíng chē shǔ yú wǒ
ex.en: This bicycle belongs to me.

ex.zh: 那是人类第一次在月球上行走。
ex.p: nà shì rén lèi dì yī cì zài yuè qiú shǎng xíng zǒu
ex.en: That was the first time that a man walked on the moon.

ex.zh: 狗是人类最好的朋友。
ex.p: gǒu shì rén lèi zuì hǎo de péng you
ex.en: Dog is man's best friend.

ex.zh: 我需要做手术吗？
ex.p: wǒ xū yào zuò shǒu shù ma
ex.en: Do I need surgery?

ex.zh: 医生们拒绝做第二次手术。
ex.p: yī shēng men jù jué zuò dì èr cì shǒu shù
ex.en: Doctors refused to perform a second operation.

items.en: parent; one's own (flesh and blood); relative

ex.zh: 我父亲有个习惯，早餐之前读报纸。
ex.p: wǒ fù qīn yǒu gè xí guàn zǎo cān zhī qián dòu bào zhǐ
ex.en: My father is in the habit of reading the newspaper before breakfast.

ex.zh: 前几天我发现了一本我父亲写的书。
ex.p: qián jī tiān wǒ fā xiàn le yī běn wǒ fù qīn xiě de shū
ex.en: The other day I discovered a book written by my father.

ex.zh: 自由非常非常重要。
ex.p: zì yóu fēi cháng fēi cháng zhòng yào
ex.en: Freedom is very, very important.

ex.zh: 自由是有代价的。
ex.p: zì yóu shì yǒu dài jià de
ex.en: Freedom is not free.

items.en: to cast; to send; to throw oneself (into the river etc)

ex.zh: 外国投资者从美国收回他们的钱。
ex.p: wài guó tóu zī zhě cóng měi guó shōu huí tā men de qián
ex.en: Foreign investors withdrew their money from America.

ex.zh: 我在这项计划上投入了所有精力。
ex.p: wǒ zài zhè xiàng jì huà shǎng tóu rù le suǒ yǒu jīng lì
ex.en: I've put all of my energy into this plan.

ex.zh: 黑海里的水事实上是黑的吗？
ex.p: hēi hǎi lǐ de shuǐ shì shí shàng shì hēi de ma
ex.en: Is the water in the Black Sea actually black?

ex.zh: 我认为这个事实很重要。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi zhè gè shì shí hěn zhòng yào
ex.en: I think that fact is very important.

items.en: unexpectedly; to one's surprise; go so far as to

ex.zh: 我仍旧无法相信我居然做了这种事。
ex.p: wǒ réng jiù wú fǎ xiāng xìn wǒ jū rán zuò le zhè zhǒng shì
ex.en: I still can't believe I did it.

ex.zh: 让我出乎意料的是，他居然很会唱歌。
ex.p: ràng wǒ chū hū yì liào de shì tā jū rán hěn huì chàng gē
ex.en: To my surprise, he was good at singing.

ex.zh: 我已经读过很多种类的书了。
ex.p: wǒ yǐ jīng dòu guò hěn duō zhǒng lèi de shū le
ex.en: I've read many kinds of books.

ex.zh: 我也听过一个类似的故事。
ex.p: wǒ yě yǐn guò yī gè lèi sì de gù shì
ex.en: I also heard a similar story.

ex.zh: 他是个天文学专家。
ex.p: tā shì gè tiān wén xué zhuān jiā
ex.en: He's an expert in astronomy.

ex.zh: 社会上满是不称职的医生。
ex.p: shè huì shǎng mǎn shì bù chèn zhí de yī shēng
ex.en: The world is full of incompetent doctors.

ex.zh: 一百年称为一个世纪。
ex.p: yī bǎi nián chēng wéi yī gè shì jì
ex.en: One hundred years is called a century.

ex.zh: 我们已经将它做了分析。
ex.p: wǒ men yǐ jīng jiāng tā zuò le fēn xī
ex.en: We've had it analyzed.

items.en: to enjoy; to live it up; pleasure

ex.zh: 今晚我非常享受和你的聊天。
ex.p: jīn wǎn wǒ fēi cháng xiǎng shòu hé nǐ de liáo tiān
ex.en: I enjoyed talking with you this evening very much.

ex.zh: 虽然我享受打保龄球，但是我最近没有去打保龄球。
ex.p: suī rán wǒ xiǎng shòu dá bǎo líng qiú dàn shì wǒ zuì jìn méi yǒu qù dá bǎo líng qiú
ex.en: Although I enjoy bowling, I haven't gone bowling recently.

ex.zh: 你跟你的女朋友见面以来有多久了？
ex.p: nǐ gēn nǐ de nǚ péng you jiàn miàn yǐ lái yǒu duō jiǔ le
ex.en: How long has it been since you saw your girlfriend?

ex.zh: 价格已经达到了十三年以来的最高点。
ex.p: jià gé yǐ jīng dá dào le shí sān nián yǐ lái de zuì gāo diǎn
ex.en: Prices have reached a 13-year high.

ex.zh: 我反应过度了吗？
ex.p: wǒ fǎn yìng guò dù le ma
ex.en: Am I overreacting?

ex.zh: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。
ex.p: dà jiā dōu kě wàng zhī dào qián guàn jūn de zhǔ fā shēng le shén me
ex.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.

items.en: value; worth; fig. values (ethical, cultural etc)

ex.zh: 真正的友谊比金钱更有价值。
ex.p: zhēn zhèng de yǒu yì bǐ jīn qián gēng yǒu jià zhí
ex.en: Real friendship is more valuable than money.

ex.zh: 我们不能高估健康的价值。
ex.p: wǒ men bù néng gāo gū jiàn kāng de jià zhí
ex.en: We cannot overestimate the value of health.

ex.zh: 我大学里的第一天相当没意思。
ex.p: wǒ dà xué lǐ de dì yī tiān xiāng dāng méi yì si
ex.en: My first day in the university was rather boring.

ex.zh: 我相当有自信我能做到这一点。
ex.p: wǒ xiāng dāng yǒu zì xìn wǒ néng zuò dào zhè yī diǎn
ex.en: I'm fairly confident I can do that.

items.en: to achieve; to implement; to realize

ex.zh: 你的梦想实现了。
ex.p: nǐ de mèng xiǎng shí xiàn le
ex.en: Your dreams have come true.

ex.zh: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。
ex.p: zì cóng shǒu shù hòu wǒ fù qīn yī zhí chǔ yú liáng hǎo de zhuàng tài
ex.en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.

ex.zh: 很快人群就在他周围聚集了起来。
ex.p: hěn kuài rén qún jiù zài tā zhōu wéi jù jí le qǐ lai
ex.en: A crowd soon gathered around him.

ex.zh: 今天早上在去学校的路上，我看到了一群外国人。
ex.p: jīn tiān zǎo shang zài qù xué xiào de lù shang wǒ kàn dào le yī qún wài guó rén
ex.en: I saw a group of foreigners on my way to school this morning.

ex.zh: 你想通过做那件事而得到原谅是吗？
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng tōng guò zuò nà jiàn shì ér dé dào yuán liàng shì ma
ex.en: You want to be excused from doing that, don't you?

ex.zh: 我很想找出她为什么这么说的原因。
ex.p: wǒ hěn xiǎng zhǎo chū tā wèi shén me zhè me shuō de yuán yīn
ex.en: I'd love to find out why she said so.

ex.zh: 她停下来抽了根烟。
ex.p: tā tíng xià lái chōu le gēn yān
ex.en: She stopped to smoke a cigarette.

ex.zh: 这根本不是确定的。
ex.p: zhè gēn běn bù shì què dìng de
ex.en: It is by no means certain.

items.en: to establish; to set up; to found

ex.zh: 真正的友谊建立在彼此信任的基础上。
ex.p: zhēn zhèng de yǒu yì jiàn lì zài bǐ cǐ xìn rèn de jī chǔ shǎng
ex.en: True friendship is based on mutual trust.

ex.zh: 老板对你的工作有很高的评价。
ex.p: lǎo bǎn duì nǐ de gōng zuò yǒu hěn gāo de píng jià
ex.en: The boss has a good opinion of your work.

ex.zh: 你跟你的老板说什么了？
ex.p: nǐ gēn nǐ de lǎo bǎn shuō shén me le
ex.en: What did you tell your boss?

items.en: to gather; to collect; collected works

ex.zh: 警察收集了很多对他不利的证据。
ex.p: jǐng chá shōu jí le hěn duō duì tā bù lì de zhèng jù
ex.en: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.

ex.zh: 我想我们应集中于另外的事情。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng wǒ men yīng jí zhōng yú lìng wài de shì qing
ex.en: I think we should concentrate on other things.

ex.zh: 我们有必要为上这门课买本教材吗？
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu bì yào wèi shǎng zhè mén kè mǎi běn jiào cái ma
ex.en: Will it be necessary for us to buy a book for this class?

ex.zh: 我有必要向他解释原因吗？
ex.p: wǒ yǒu bì yào xiàng tā jiě shì yuán yīn ma
ex.en: Is it necessary for me to explain the reason to him?

ex.zh: 为抢救病人医生已尽力了。
ex.p: wèi qiǎng jiù bìng rén yī shēng yǐ jìn lì le
ex.en: The doctor tried every possible means to save his patient.

ex.zh: 我来问个有点傻的问题。
ex.p: wǒ lái wèn gè yǒu diǎn shǎ de wèn tí
ex.en: Let me ask a stupid question.

ex.zh: 我不像你想的那么傻。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiàng nǐ xiǎng de nà me shǎ
ex.en: I'm not as stupid as you think I am.

ex.zh: 他有权出入美国大使馆。
ex.p: tā yǒu quán chū rù měi guó dà shǐ guǎn
ex.en: He has access to the American Embassy.

ex.zh: 我们知道我们的权利。
ex.p: wǒ men zhī dào wǒ men de quán lì
ex.en: We know our rights.

ex.zh: 我父亲爱世上的每一个人。
ex.p: wǒ fù qīn ài shì shǎng de měi yī gè rén
ex.en: My father loves everyone in the world.

ex.zh: 救护车把伤者送往了最近的医院。
ex.p: jiù hù chē bǎ shāng zhě sòng wǎng le zuì jìn de yī yuàn
ex.en: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.

ex.zh: 他冒着生命危险救了那条狗。
ex.p: tā mào zhe shēng mìng wēi xiǎn jiù le nà tiáo gǒu
ex.en: He rescued the dog at the risk of his own life.

items.en: to reinstate; to resume; to restore

ex.zh: 他从重感冒中恢复了过来。
ex.p: tā cóng zhòng gǎn mào zhōng huī fù le guò lái
ex.en: He has recovered from his bad cold.

ex.zh: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào zěn me huī fù yǐ shān chú de wén jiàn ma
ex.en: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?

ex.zh: 她或许知道我们在这儿。
ex.p: tā huò xǔ zhī dào wǒ men zài zhèr
ex.en: She might know that we are here.

ex.zh: 我或许可以修好它。
ex.p: wǒ huò xǔ kě yǐ xiū hǎo tā
ex.en: I might be able to fix that.

ex.zh: 不是每个人都意识到这点。
ex.p: bù shì měi gè rén dōu yì shí dào zhè diǎn
ex.en: Not everyone noticed.

ex.zh: 他已经意识到它了。
ex.p: tā yǐ jīng yì shí dào tā le
ex.en: He already knew about it.

items.en: to sculpt; to carve; musical instrument (old)

ex.zh: 我必须努力学习，才能追上其他学生。
ex.p: wǒ bì xū nǔ lì xué xí cái néng duī shǎng qí tā xué sheng
ex.en: I had to study hard to keep up with the other students.

ex.zh: 我看见一只猫追着一只狗跑。
ex.p: wǒ kàn jiàn yī zhǐ māo duī zhe yī zhǐ gǒu páo
ex.en: I see a cat chasing a dog.

items.en: to lead to; to create; to cause

ex.zh: 道路结冰导致了很多起事故。
ex.p: dào lù jié bīng dǎo zhì le hěn duō qǐ shì gù
ex.en: Many accidents resulted from the icy conditions of the road.

ex.zh: 那事故是他的粗心导致的。
ex.p: nà shì gù shì tā de cū xīn dǎo zhì de
ex.en: That accident was due to his carelessness.

items.en: to concentrate; to centralize; to focus

ex.zh: 他试图把注意力集中在信上。
ex.p: tā shì tú bǎ zhù yì lì jí zhōng zài xìn shǎng
ex.en: He tried to concentrate on the letter.

ex.zh: 我想我们应集中于另外的事情。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng wǒ men yīng jí zhōng yú lìng wài de shì qing
ex.en: I think we should concentrate on other things.

ex.zh: 我没发现任何我该道歉的理由。
ex.p: wǒ méi fā xiàn rèn hé wǒ gāi dào qiàn de lǐ yóu
ex.en: I don't see any reason why I have to apologize.

ex.zh: 我没有特别的理由去做。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu tè bié de lǐ yóu qù zuò
ex.en: I have no particular reason to do so.

exercises.zh: 学习一门语言最好的方法是什么？
exercises.p: xué xí yī mén yǔ yán zuì hǎo de fāng fǎ shì shén me
exercises.en: What's the best way to learn a language?

exercises.q: 我需要做＿＿吗？
exercises.en: Do I need surgery?
exercises.why: 手术 shǒu shù: (surgical) operation; surgery

exercises.q: 为＿＿救病人医生已尽力了。
exercises.en: The doctor tried every possible means to save his patient.
exercises.why: 抢 qiāng: opposite in direction; contrary

exercises.q: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的＿＿。

exercises.why: 状态 zhuàng tài: condition; state; state of affairs

exercises.q: 不是每个人都＿＿到这点。

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第73单元

Media and technology

Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 地图帮助我们知道所在的位置。
sents.p: dì tú bāng zhù wǒ men zhī dào suǒ zài de wèi zhi
sents.en: A map helps us to know where we are.

sents.zh: 教堂在村子的中心位置。
sents.p: jiào táng zài cūn zǐ de zhōng xīn wèi zhi
sents.en: The church is in the middle of the village.

sents.zh: 图书馆是我最喜欢去的地方之一。
sents.p: tú shū guǎn shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan qù de dì fāng zhī yī
sents.en: The library is one of my favorite places.

sents.zh: 学习一门语言最好的方法是什么？
sents.p: xué xí yī mén yǔ yán zuì hǎo de fāng fǎ shì shén me
sents.en: What's the best way to learn a language?

sents.zh: 他弟弟是个有名的足球选手。
sents.p: tā dì di shì gè yǒu míng de zú qiú xuǎn shǒu
sents.en: His brother is a famous soccer player.

sents.zh: 我们没机会赢那些一流选手。
sents.p: wǒ men méi jī huì yíng nà xiē yī liú xuǎn shǒu
sents.en: We have no chance against those top players.

sents.zh: 我没有参与对话。
sents.p: wǒ méi yǒu cān yù duì huà
sents.en: I did not participate in the dialog.

sents.zh: 参与者大部分是女性。
sents.p: cān yù zhě dà bù fen shì nǚ xìng
sents.en: The participants were for the most part women.

sents.zh: 我们俩不属于这儿。
sents.p: wǒ men liǎ bù shǔ yú zhèr
sents.en: The two of us don't belong here.

sents.zh: 这辆自行车属于我。
sents.p: zhè liàng zì xíng chē shǔ yú wǒ
sents.en: This bicycle belongs to me.

sents.zh: 那是人类第一次在月球上行走。
sents.p: nà shì rén lèi dì yī cì zài yuè qiú shǎng xíng zǒu
sents.en: That was the first time that a man walked on the moon.

sents.zh: 狗是人类最好的朋友。
sents.p: gǒu shì rén lèi zuì hǎo de péng you
sents.en: Dog is man's best friend.

sents.zh: 我需要做手术吗？
sents.p: wǒ xū yào zuò shǒu shù ma
sents.en: Do I need surgery?

sents.zh: 医生们拒绝做第二次手术。
sents.p: yī shēng men jù jué zuò dì èr cì shǒu shù
sents.en: Doctors refused to perform a second operation.

sents.zh: 我父亲有个习惯，早餐之前读报纸。
sents.p: wǒ fù qīn yǒu gè xí guàn zǎo cān zhī qián dòu bào zhǐ
sents.en: My father is in the habit of reading the newspaper before breakfast.

sents.zh: 前几天我发现了一本我父亲写的书。
sents.p: qián jī tiān wǒ fā xiàn le yī běn wǒ fù qīn xiě de shū
sents.en: The other day I discovered a book written by my father.

sents.zh: 自由非常非常重要。
sents.p: zì yóu fēi cháng fēi cháng zhòng yào
sents.en: Freedom is very, very important.

sents.zh: 自由是有代价的。
sents.p: zì yóu shì yǒu dài jià de
sents.en: Freedom is not free.

sents.zh: 外国投资者从美国收回他们的钱。
sents.p: wài guó tóu zī zhě cóng měi guó shōu huí tā men de qián
sents.en: Foreign investors withdrew their money from America.

sents.zh: 我在这项计划上投入了所有精力。
sents.p: wǒ zài zhè xiàng jì huà shǎng tóu rù le suǒ yǒu jīng lì
sents.en: I've put all of my energy into this plan.

sents.zh: 黑海里的水事实上是黑的吗？
sents.p: hēi hǎi lǐ de shuǐ shì shí shàng shì hēi de ma
sents.en: Is the water in the Black Sea actually black?

sents.zh: 我认为这个事实很重要。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi zhè gè shì shí hěn zhòng yào
sents.en: I think that fact is very important.

sents.zh: 我仍旧无法相信我居然做了这种事。
sents.p: wǒ réng jiù wú fǎ xiāng xìn wǒ jū rán zuò le zhè zhǒng shì
sents.en: I still can't believe I did it.

sents.zh: 让我出乎意料的是，他居然很会唱歌。
sents.p: ràng wǒ chū hū yì liào de shì tā jū rán hěn huì chàng gē
sents.en: To my surprise, he was good at singing.

sents.zh: 我已经读过很多种类的书了。
sents.p: wǒ yǐ jīng dòu guò hěn duō zhǒng lèi de shū le
sents.en: I've read many kinds of books.

sents.zh: 我也听过一个类似的故事。
sents.p: wǒ yě yǐn guò yī gè lèi sì de gù shì
sents.en: I also heard a similar story.

sents.zh: 他是个天文学专家。
sents.p: tā shì gè tiān wén xué zhuān jiā
sents.en: He's an expert in astronomy.

sents.zh: 社会上满是不称职的医生。
sents.p: shè huì shǎng mǎn shì bù chèn zhí de yī shēng
sents.en: The world is full of incompetent doctors.

sents.zh: 一百年称为一个世纪。
sents.p: yī bǎi nián chēng wéi yī gè shì jì
sents.en: One hundred years is called a century.

sents.zh: 我们已经将它做了分析。
sents.p: wǒ men yǐ jīng jiāng tā zuò le fēn xī
sents.en: We've had it analyzed.

sents.zh: 今晚我非常享受和你的聊天。
sents.p: jīn wǎn wǒ fēi cháng xiǎng shòu hé nǐ de liáo tiān
sents.en: I enjoyed talking with you this evening very much.

sents.zh: 虽然我享受打保龄球，但是我最近没有去打保龄球。
sents.p: suī rán wǒ xiǎng shòu dá bǎo líng qiú dàn shì wǒ zuì jìn méi yǒu qù dá bǎo líng qiú
sents.en: Although I enjoy bowling, I haven't gone bowling recently.

sents.zh: 你跟你的女朋友见面以来有多久了？
sents.p: nǐ gēn nǐ de nǚ péng you jiàn miàn yǐ lái yǒu duō jiǔ le
sents.en: How long has it been since you saw your girlfriend?

sents.zh: 价格已经达到了十三年以来的最高点。
sents.p: jià gé yǐ jīng dá dào le shí sān nián yǐ lái de zuì gāo diǎn
sents.en: Prices have reached a 13-year high.

sents.zh: 我反应过度了吗？
sents.p: wǒ fǎn yìng guò dù le ma
sents.en: Am I overreacting?

sents.zh: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。
sents.p: dà jiā dōu kě wàng zhī dào qián guàn jūn de zhǔ fā shēng le shén me
sents.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.

sents.zh: 真正的友谊比金钱更有价值。
sents.p: zhēn zhèng de yǒu yì bǐ jīn qián gēng yǒu jià zhí
sents.en: Real friendship is more valuable than money.

sents.zh: 我们不能高估健康的价值。
sents.p: wǒ men bù néng gāo gū jiàn kāng de jià zhí
sents.en: We cannot overestimate the value of health.

sents.zh: 我大学里的第一天相当没意思。
sents.p: wǒ dà xué lǐ de dì yī tiān xiāng dāng méi yì si
sents.en: My first day in the university was rather boring.

sents.zh: 我相当有自信我能做到这一点。
sents.p: wǒ xiāng dāng yǒu zì xìn wǒ néng zuò dào zhè yī diǎn
sents.en: I'm fairly confident I can do that.

sents.zh: 你的梦想实现了。
sents.p: nǐ de mèng xiǎng shí xiàn le
sents.en: Your dreams have come true.

sents.zh: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。
sents.p: zì cóng shǒu shù hòu wǒ fù qīn yī zhí chǔ yú liáng hǎo de zhuàng tài
sents.en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.

sents.zh: 很快人群就在他周围聚集了起来。
sents.p: hěn kuài rén qún jiù zài tā zhōu wéi jù jí le qǐ lai
sents.en: A crowd soon gathered around him.

sents.zh: 今天早上在去学校的路上，我看到了一群外国人。
sents.p: jīn tiān zǎo shang zài qù xué xiào de lù shang wǒ kàn dào le yī qún wài guó rén
sents.en: I saw a group of foreigners on my way to school this morning.

sents.zh: 你想通过做那件事而得到原谅是吗？
sents.p: nǐ xiǎng tōng guò zuò nà jiàn shì ér dé dào yuán liàng shì ma
sents.en: You want to be excused from doing that, don't you?

sents.zh: 我很想找出她为什么这么说的原因。
sents.p: wǒ hěn xiǎng zhǎo chū tā wèi shén me zhè me shuō de yuán yīn
sents.en: I'd love to find out why she said so.

sents.zh: 她停下来抽了根烟。
sents.p: tā tíng xià lái chōu le gēn yān
sents.en: She stopped to smoke a cigarette.

sents.zh: 这根本不是确定的。
sents.p: zhè gēn běn bù shì què dìng de
sents.en: It is by no means certain.

sents.zh: 真正的友谊建立在彼此信任的基础上。
sents.p: zhēn zhèng de yǒu yì jiàn lì zài bǐ cǐ xìn rèn de jī chǔ shǎng
sents.en: True friendship is based on mutual trust.

sents.zh: 老板对你的工作有很高的评价。
sents.p: lǎo bǎn duì nǐ de gōng zuò yǒu hěn gāo de píng jià
sents.en: The boss has a good opinion of your work.

sents.zh: 你跟你的老板说什么了？
sents.p: nǐ gēn nǐ de lǎo bǎn shuō shén me le
sents.en: What did you tell your boss?

sents.zh: 警察收集了很多对他不利的证据。
sents.p: jǐng chá shōu jí le hěn duō duì tā bù lì de zhèng jù
sents.en: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.

sents.zh: 我想我们应集中于另外的事情。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng wǒ men yīng jí zhōng yú lìng wài de shì qing
sents.en: I think we should concentrate on other things.

sents.zh: 我们有必要为上这门课买本教材吗？
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu bì yào wèi shǎng zhè mén kè mǎi běn jiào cái ma
sents.en: Will it be necessary for us to buy a book for this class?

sents.zh: 我有必要向他解释原因吗？
sents.p: wǒ yǒu bì yào xiàng tā jiě shì yuán yīn ma
sents.en: Is it necessary for me to explain the reason to him?

sents.zh: 为抢救病人医生已尽力了。
sents.p: wèi qiǎng jiù bìng rén yī shēng yǐ jìn lì le
sents.en: The doctor tried every possible means to save his patient.

sents.zh: 我来问个有点傻的问题。
sents.p: wǒ lái wèn gè yǒu diǎn shǎ de wèn tí
sents.en: Let me ask a stupid question.

sents.zh: 我不像你想的那么傻。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiàng nǐ xiǎng de nà me shǎ
sents.en: I'm not as stupid as you think I am.

sents.zh: 他有权出入美国大使馆。
sents.p: tā yǒu quán chū rù měi guó dà shǐ guǎn
sents.en: He has access to the American Embassy.

sents.zh: 我们知道我们的权利。
sents.p: wǒ men zhī dào wǒ men de quán lì
sents.en: We know our rights.

sents.zh: 我父亲爱世上的每一个人。
sents.p: wǒ fù qīn ài shì shǎng de měi yī gè rén
sents.en: My father loves everyone in the world.

sents.zh: 救护车把伤者送往了最近的医院。
sents.p: jiù hù chē bǎ shāng zhě sòng wǎng le zuì jìn de yī yuàn
sents.en: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.

sents.zh: 他冒着生命危险救了那条狗。
sents.p: tā mào zhe shēng mìng wēi xiǎn jiù le nà tiáo gǒu
sents.en: He rescued the dog at the risk of his own life.

sents.zh: 他从重感冒中恢复了过来。
sents.p: tā cóng zhòng gǎn mào zhōng huī fù le guò lái
sents.en: He has recovered from his bad cold.

sents.zh: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào zěn me huī fù yǐ shān chú de wén jiàn ma
sents.en: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?

sents.zh: 她或许知道我们在这儿。
sents.p: tā huò xǔ zhī dào wǒ men zài zhèr
sents.en: She might know that we are here.

sents.zh: 我或许可以修好它。
sents.p: wǒ huò xǔ kě yǐ xiū hǎo tā
sents.en: I might be able to fix that.

sents.zh: 不是每个人都意识到这点。
sents.p: bù shì měi gè rén dōu yì shí dào zhè diǎn
sents.en: Not everyone noticed.

sents.zh: 他已经意识到它了。
sents.p: tā yǐ jīng yì shí dào tā le
sents.en: He already knew about it.

sents.zh: 我必须努力学习，才能追上其他学生。
sents.p: wǒ bì xū nǔ lì xué xí cái néng duī shǎng qí tā xué sheng
sents.en: I had to study hard to keep up with the other students.

sents.zh: 我看见一只猫追着一只狗跑。
sents.p: wǒ kàn jiàn yī zhǐ māo duī zhe yī zhǐ gǒu páo
sents.en: I see a cat chasing a dog.

sents.zh: 道路结冰导致了很多起事故。
sents.p: dào lù jié bīng dǎo zhì le hěn duō qǐ shì gù
sents.en: Many accidents resulted from the icy conditions of the road.

sents.zh: 那事故是他的粗心导致的。
sents.p: nà shì gù shì tā de cū xīn dǎo zhì de
sents.en: That accident was due to his carelessness.

sents.zh: 他试图把注意力集中在信上。
sents.p: tā shì tú bǎ zhù yì lì jí zhōng zài xìn shǎng
sents.en: He tried to concentrate on the letter.

sents.zh: 我没发现任何我该道歉的理由。
sents.p: wǒ méi fā xiàn rèn hé wǒ gāi dào qiàn de lǐ yóu
sents.en: I don't see any reason why I have to apologize.

sents.zh: 我没有特别的理由去做。
sents.p: wǒ méi yǒu tè bié de lǐ yóu qù zuò
sents.en: I have no particular reason to do so.

units.title: Media and technology
units.intro: Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

items.en: contrary; in reverse; inside out or upside down

ex.zh: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。
ex.p: wǒ gǎn qíng shǎng zhī chí dàn shì lǐ xìng shǎng fǎn duì
ex.en: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.

ex.zh: 大多数美国人似乎不反对我直呼其名。
ex.p: dà duō shù měi guó rén sì hū bù fǎn duì wǒ zhí hū qí míng
ex.en: Most Americans do not object to my calling them by their first names.

ex.zh: 他的发音远非完美。
ex.p: tā de fā yīn yuǎn fēi wán měi
ex.en: His pronunciation is far from perfect.

ex.zh: 你做了一项完美的工作。
ex.p: nǐ zuò le yī xiàng wán měi de gōng zuò
ex.en: You've done a perfect job.

items.en: to pass on; to spread; to transmit

ex.zh: 他们传统的生活方式不再存在。
ex.p: tā men chuán tǒng de shēng huó fāng shì bù zài cún zài
ex.en: Their traditional life style no longer exists.

ex.zh: 我们在电视上宣传我们的产品。
ex.p: wǒ men zài diàn shì shǎng xuān chuán wǒ men de chǎn pǐn
ex.en: We advertise our products on TV.

ex.zh: 他们不会伤害我们。
ex.p: tā men bù huì shāng hài wǒ men
ex.en: They won't hurt us.

ex.zh: 她很容易受到感情上的伤害。
ex.p: tā hěn róng yì shòu dào gǎn qíng shǎng de shāng hài
ex.en: Her feelings are easily hurt.

ex.zh: 我知道你不想去的真实原因。
ex.p: wǒ zhī dào nǐ bù xiǎng qù de zhēn shí yuán yīn
ex.en: I know the real reason you don't want to go.

ex.zh: 请把真实的情况说出来。
ex.p: qǐng bǎ zhēn shí de qíng kuàng shuō chū lái
ex.en: Please tell the truth.

ex.zh: 请把他所说的记录下来。
ex.p: qǐng bǎ tā suǒ shuō de jì lù xià lai
ex.en: Please write down what he says.

items.en: space; room; (fig.) scope; leeway; (astronomy) outer space
(of water) to dash against; to mix with water; to infuse

ex.zh: 他穿着衣服冲进房间。
ex.p: tā chuān zhuó yī fu chōng jìn fáng jiān
ex.en: He rushed into the room with his coat on.

ex.zh: 每个人都向我们冲来。
ex.p: měi gè rén dōu xiàng wǒ men chōng lái
ex.en: Everybody rushed towards us.

items.en: to look forward to; to await; expectation

ex.zh: 我期待听到你在这件事上的想法。
ex.p: wǒ qī dài tīng dào nǐ zài zhè jiàn shì shǎng de xiǎng fǎ
ex.en: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.

ex.zh: 我们很期待见到您和您的家人。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn qī dài jiàn dào nín hé nín de jiā rén
ex.en: We are looking forward to seeing you and your family.

ex.zh: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。
ex.p: yǒu shí hou kǒu wù duì zhèng zhì jiā lái shuō shì zhì mìng de
ex.en: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.

ex.zh: 政治家从来不告诉我们他们的别有用心。
ex.p: zhèng zhì jiā cóng lái bù gào sù wǒ men tā men de bié yǒu yòng xīn
ex.en: Politicians never tell us their inner thoughts.

ex.zh: 她朝我丢葡萄，我试着用嘴接住它们。
ex.p: tā cháo wǒ diū pú tao wǒ shì zhe yòng zuǐ jiē zhù tā men
ex.en: She tossed me grapes and I tried to catch them with my mouth.

ex.zh: 那个朝我们跑过来的男孩是谁？
ex.p: nà gè cháo wǒ men páo guò lái de nán hái shì shéi
ex.en: Who is that boy running toward us?

ex.zh: 这药没有副作用。
ex.p: zhè yào méi yǒu fù zuò yòng
ex.en: This medicine has no side effects.

ex.zh: 他继承了他父亲的事业。
ex.p: tā jì chéng le tā fù qīn de shì yè
ex.en: He took over his father's business.

ex.zh: 她父亲把一生都贡献给科学事业了。
ex.p: tā fù qīn bǎ yī shēng dōu gòng xiàn gěi kē xué shì yè le
ex.en: Her father devoted his life to science.

items.en: to admit; to concede; to recognize

ex.zh: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。
ex.p: wǒ chéng rèn zhè kě néng bù shì zuì hǎo de fāng fǎ
ex.en: I admit this may not be the best way of doing it.

ex.zh: 你能承认你错了是很伟大的。
ex.p: nǐ néng chéng rèn nǐ cuò le shì hěn wěi dà de
ex.en: It's very big of you to admit you're wrong.

items.en: to implement; to carry out; to execute

ex.zh: 我们必须执行他的命令。
ex.p: wǒ men bì xū zhí xíng tā de mìng lìng
ex.en: We must execute his orders.

ex.zh: 我相信他的执行能力。
ex.p: wǒ xiāng xìn tā de zhí xíng néng lì
ex.en: I trust his executive ability.

ex.zh: 他不在这儿你不觉得这很奇怪吗？
ex.p: tā bù zài zhèr nǐ bù jué de zhè hěn qí guài ma
ex.en: Don't you think it's strange that he's not here?

ex.zh: 我看见那儿有个奇怪的女人。
ex.p: wǒ kàn jiàn nàr yǒu gè qí guài de nǚ rén
ex.en: I saw a strange woman there.

ex.zh: 你现在感到痛苦吗？
ex.p: nǐ xiàn zài gǎn dào tòng kǔ ma
ex.en: Are you in pain now?

ex.zh: 显然，今天什么事都有可能发生。
ex.p: xiǎn rán jīn tiān shén me shì dōu yǒu kě néng fā shēng
ex.en: Apparently, there is nothing that cannot happen today.

ex.zh: 这显然是今年出版的最好的小说。
ex.p: zhè xiǎn rán shì jīn nián chū bǎn de zuì hǎo de xiǎo shuō
ex.en: This is by far the best novel that has been published this year.

ex.zh: 我们必须保持家庭传统。
ex.p: wǒ men bì xū bǎo chí jiā tíng chuán tǒng
ex.en: We must keep up the family traditions.

ex.zh: 他们传统的生活方式不再存在。
ex.p: tā men chuán tǒng de shēng huó fāng shì bù zài cún zài
ex.en: Their traditional life style no longer exists.

ex.zh: 因为健康状况不佳，他没去成旅行。
ex.p: yīn wèi jiàn kāng zhuàng kuàng bù jiā tā méi qù chéng lǚ xíng
ex.en: Poor health prohibited him from traveling.

items.en: to share (let others have some of sth good)

ex.zh: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。
ex.p: nǐ bù yīng gāi zài shè jiāo wǎng luò shǎng fēn xiǎng guò duō sī rén xìn xī
ex.en: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.

ex.zh: 他们不是在打架，而是在排练戏剧。
ex.p: tā men bù shì zài dǎ jià ér shì zài pái liàn xì jù
ex.en: They aren't quarreling, but are rehearsing a play.

ex.zh: 我有大量的书在我的书架上。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu dà liàng de shū zài wǒ de shū jià shǎng
ex.en: I have numerous books on my bookshelf.

items.en: to turn over; to flip over; to overturn

ex.zh: 你用了多少时间来翻译这本书？
ex.p: nǐ yòng le duō shǎo shí jiān lái fān yì zhè běn shū
ex.en: How long did it take you to translate this book?

ex.zh: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。
ex.p: shì jiè jiù xiàng shì yī běn shū zǒu yī bù děng yú fān le yī xié
ex.en: The world is just like a book, and every step you take is like turning a page.

items.en: huge; great; grand; worthy of the greatest admiration; important (contribution e

ex.zh: 他是世界上最伟大的科学家之一。
ex.p: tā shì shì jiè shǎng zuì wěi dà de kē xué jiā zhī yī
ex.en: He is numbered among the greatest scientists in the world.

ex.zh: 他是日本最伟大的艺术家之一。
ex.p: tā shì rì běn zuì wěi dà de yì shù jiā zhī yī
ex.en: He is one of the greatest artists in Japan.

ex.zh: 我不知道他来这里的确切时间。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào tā lái zhè lǐ dí què qiē shí jiān
ex.en: I don't know for certain when he will come.

ex.zh: 电视的确有一些缺点。
ex.p: diàn shì dí què yǒu yī xiē quē diǎn
ex.en: It is true that television also has some disadvantages.

items.en: classifier for small spheres, pearls, corn grains, teeth, hearts, satellites etc

ex.zh: 我想要一颗糖。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào yī kē táng
ex.en: I want a piece of candy.

items.en: identity; role; capacity (as in "in his capacity as a ..." 以…份)
full of; brimming with; very full

ex.zh: 我心里充满着快乐。
ex.p: wǒ xīn li chōng mǎn zhe kuài lè
ex.en: My heart was filled with happiness.

ex.zh: 他依旧充满活力。
ex.p: tā yī jiù chōng mǎn huó lì
ex.en: He is still very much alive.

items.en: to connect; to relate to; to tie up

ex.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
ex.p: wàn yī yǒu jǐn jí qíng kuàng lián xì wǒ de dài lǐ rén
ex.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.

ex.zh: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。
ex.p: jǐn jí qíng kuàng xià nín kě yǐ lián xì wǒ
ex.en: You can contact me in case of emergency.

ex.zh: 我不禁想我的儿子一直都在生。
ex.p: wǒ bù jīn xiǎng wǒ de ér zi yī zhí dōu zài shēng
ex.en: I cannot help thinking that my son is still alive.

ex.zh: 过去，我父亲常常喝酒直到深夜。
ex.p: guò qù wǒ fù qīn cháng cháng hē jiǔ zhí dào shēn yè
ex.en: My father used to drink till late at night.

ex.zh: 这个国家的主要产品之一是咖啡。
ex.p: zhè gè guó jiā de zhǔ yào chǎn pǐn zhī yī shì kā fēi
ex.en: One of the main products of this country is coffee.

ex.zh: 这些产品的品质是一样的。
ex.p: zhè xiē chǎn pǐn de pǐn zhì shì yī yàng de
ex.en: The quality of these products is the same.

ex.zh: 她跑得很快是为了赶上其他成员。
ex.p: tā páo de hěn kuài shì wèi le gǎn shàng qí tā chéng yuán
ex.en: She ran very fast to catch up with the other members.

ex.zh: 仅三分之一的成员出席了会议。
ex.p: jǐn sān fēn zhī yī de chéng yuán chū xí le huì yì
ex.en: Only one third of the members turned up at the meeting.

ex.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。
ex.p: wàn yī chuán yùn chí le wǒ men yǒu tè bié de chí dào bǎo xiǎn
ex.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.

ex.zh: 保险箱的钥匙在我这儿。
ex.p: bǎo xiǎn xiāng de yào shi zài wǒ zhèr
ex.en: I have the key to the safe.

items.en: to test (machinery etc); to test (a person's skill in a particular area); a test

ex.zh: 我的意见是，你该再次参加测试。
ex.p: wǒ de yì jiàn shì nǐ gāi zài cì cān jiā cè shì
ex.en: I think you should take the test again.

ex.zh: 我觉得这个测试很难。
ex.p: wǒ jué de zhè gè cè shì hěn nán
ex.en: I found the test difficult.

items.en: a decade of a century (e.g. the Sixties); age; era

ex.zh: 我们需要称职的领导人。
ex.p: wǒ men xū yào chèn zhí de lǐng dǎo rén
ex.en: We need competent leaders.

ex.zh: 我正在为我的妈妈寻找礼物。
ex.p: wǒ zhèng zài wèi wǒ de mā ma xún zhǎo lǐ wù
ex.en: I am looking for a present for my mother.

ex.zh: 我应该寻找什么？
ex.p: wǒ yīng gāi xún zhǎo shén me
ex.en: What should I look for?

ex.zh: 她理所当然的取得了胜利。
ex.p: tā lǐ suǒ dāng rán de qǔ dé le shèng lì
ex.en: She's sure to succeed.

ex.zh: 正义终将胜利。
ex.p: zhèng yì zhōng jiāng shèng lì
ex.en: Justice will prevail in the end.

ex.zh: 谁是你最喜爱的电视明星？
ex.p: shéi shì nǐ zuì xǐ ài de diàn shì míng xīng
ex.en: Who's your favorite TV star?

ex.zh: 我的兄弟和我在一个班级。
ex.p: wǒ de xiōng dì hé wǒ zài yī gè bān jí
ex.en: My brother and I are in the same class.

ex.zh: 记住我的级别在你的之上。
ex.p: jì zhu wǒ de jí bié zài nǐ de zhī shǎng
ex.en: Remember that I outrank you.

ex.zh: 在某种程度上你是对的，但我还是有疑问。
ex.p: zài mǒu zhǒng chéng dù shǎng nǐ shì duì de dàn wǒ hái shi yǒu yí wèn
ex.en: In a way you're right, but I still have doubts.

ex.zh: 一个国家纸的产量和它的文明程度密切相关。
ex.p: yī gè guó jiā zhǐ de chǎn liàng hé tā de wén míng chéng dù mì qiè xiāng guān
ex.en: The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.

items.en: to substitute; to act on behalf of others; to replace

ex.zh: 我不在的时候，他将是我的代理人。
ex.p: wǒ bù zài de shí hou tā jiāng shì wǒ de dài lǐ rén
ex.en: He will be my deputy while I am away.

ex.zh: 我必须不惜一切代价帮助她。
ex.p: wǒ bì xū bù xī yī qiè dài jià bāng zhù tā
ex.en: I must help her at any cost.

items.en: theory; to argue; to take notice of

ex.zh: 这个理论对我来说太难了，理解不了。
ex.p: zhè gè lǐ lùn duì wǒ lái shuō tài nán le lǐ jiě bù liǎo
ex.en: This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.

ex.zh: 我不想听你的理论。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng yǐn nǐ de lǐ lùn
ex.en: I don't want to hear your theories.

ex.zh: 我不喜欢以这种方式被对待。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan yǐ zhè zhǒng fāng shì bèi duì dài
ex.en: I don't like being treated like this.

ex.zh: 笔记本电脑比台式电脑好。
ex.p: bǐ jì běn diàn nǎo bǐ tái shì diàn nǎo hǎo
ex.en: A laptop is better than a desktop.

items.en: to declare; to announce; to proclaim

ex.zh: 他宣布与她订婚。
ex.p: tā xuān bù yú tā dìng hūn
ex.en: He announced his engagement to her.

items.en: to create; to bring about; to produce

ex.zh: 这药创造了奇迹。
ex.p: zhè yào chuàng zào le qí jì
ex.en: The medicine worked marvels.

items.en: to transfer; to move (troops or cadres); to investigate

ex.zh: 这台琴应该好多年没调过音了。
ex.p: zhè tái qín yīng gāi hǎo duō nián méi diào guò yīn le
ex.en: This piano has probably not been tuned for years.

ex.zh: 收音机太响了。你不能把音量调低一点吗？
ex.p: shōu yīn jī tài xiǎng le nǐ bù néng bǎ yīn liàng diào dī yī diǎn ma
ex.en: The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?
