lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第74单元

Media and technology

Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。
sents.p: wǒ gǎn qíng shǎng zhī chí dàn shì lǐ xìng shǎng fǎn duì
sents.en: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.

sents.zh: 大多数美国人似乎不反对我直呼其名。
sents.p: dà duō shù měi guó rén sì hū bù fǎn duì wǒ zhí hū qí míng
sents.en: Most Americans do not object to my calling them by their first names.

sents.zh: 他的发音远非完美。
sents.p: tā de fā yīn yuǎn fēi wán měi
sents.en: His pronunciation is far from perfect.

sents.zh: 你做了一项完美的工作。
sents.p: nǐ zuò le yī xiàng wán měi de gōng zuò
sents.en: You've done a perfect job.

sents.zh: 他们传统的生活方式不再存在。
sents.p: tā men chuán tǒng de shēng huó fāng shì bù zài cún zài
sents.en: Their traditional life style no longer exists.

sents.zh: 我们在电视上宣传我们的产品。
sents.p: wǒ men zài diàn shì shǎng xuān chuán wǒ men de chǎn pǐn
sents.en: We advertise our products on TV.

sents.zh: 他们不会伤害我们。
sents.p: tā men bù huì shāng hài wǒ men
sents.en: They won't hurt us.

sents.zh: 她很容易受到感情上的伤害。
sents.p: tā hěn róng yì shòu dào gǎn qíng shǎng de shāng hài
sents.en: Her feelings are easily hurt.

sents.zh: 我知道你不想去的真实原因。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào nǐ bù xiǎng qù de zhēn shí yuán yīn
sents.en: I know the real reason you don't want to go.

sents.zh: 请把真实的情况说出来。
sents.p: qǐng bǎ zhēn shí de qíng kuàng shuō chū lái
sents.en: Please tell the truth.

sents.zh: 请把他所说的记录下来。
sents.p: qǐng bǎ tā suǒ shuō de jì lù xià lai
sents.en: Please write down what he says.

sents.zh: 他穿着衣服冲进房间。
sents.p: tā chuān zhuó yī fu chōng jìn fáng jiān
sents.en: He rushed into the room with his coat on.

sents.zh: 每个人都向我们冲来。
sents.p: měi gè rén dōu xiàng wǒ men chōng lái
sents.en: Everybody rushed towards us.

sents.zh: 我期待听到你在这件事上的想法。
sents.p: wǒ qī dài tīng dào nǐ zài zhè jiàn shì shǎng de xiǎng fǎ
sents.en: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.

sents.zh: 我们很期待见到您和您的家人。
sents.p: wǒ men hěn qī dài jiàn dào nín hé nín de jiā rén
sents.en: We are looking forward to seeing you and your family.

sents.zh: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。
sents.p: yǒu shí hou kǒu wù duì zhèng zhì jiā lái shuō shì zhì mìng de
sents.en: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.

sents.zh: 政治家从来不告诉我们他们的别有用心。
sents.p: zhèng zhì jiā cóng lái bù gào sù wǒ men tā men de bié yǒu yòng xīn
sents.en: Politicians never tell us their inner thoughts.

sents.zh: 她朝我丢葡萄，我试着用嘴接住它们。
sents.p: tā cháo wǒ diū pú tao wǒ shì zhe yòng zuǐ jiē zhù tā men
sents.en: She tossed me grapes and I tried to catch them with my mouth.

sents.zh: 那个朝我们跑过来的男孩是谁？
sents.p: nà gè cháo wǒ men páo guò lái de nán hái shì shéi
sents.en: Who is that boy running toward us?

sents.zh: 这药没有副作用。
sents.p: zhè yào méi yǒu fù zuò yòng
sents.en: This medicine has no side effects.

sents.zh: 他继承了他父亲的事业。
sents.p: tā jì chéng le tā fù qīn de shì yè
sents.en: He took over his father's business.

sents.zh: 她父亲把一生都贡献给科学事业了。
sents.p: tā fù qīn bǎ yī shēng dōu gòng xiàn gěi kē xué shì yè le
sents.en: Her father devoted his life to science.

sents.zh: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。
sents.p: wǒ chéng rèn zhè kě néng bù shì zuì hǎo de fāng fǎ
sents.en: I admit this may not be the best way of doing it.

sents.zh: 你能承认你错了是很伟大的。
sents.p: nǐ néng chéng rèn nǐ cuò le shì hěn wěi dà de
sents.en: It's very big of you to admit you're wrong.

sents.zh: 我们必须执行他的命令。
sents.p: wǒ men bì xū zhí xíng tā de mìng lìng
sents.en: We must execute his orders.

sents.zh: 我相信他的执行能力。
sents.p: wǒ xiāng xìn tā de zhí xíng néng lì
sents.en: I trust his executive ability.

sents.zh: 他不在这儿你不觉得这很奇怪吗？
sents.p: tā bù zài zhèr nǐ bù jué de zhè hěn qí guài ma
sents.en: Don't you think it's strange that he's not here?

sents.zh: 我看见那儿有个奇怪的女人。
sents.p: wǒ kàn jiàn nàr yǒu gè qí guài de nǚ rén
sents.en: I saw a strange woman there.

sents.zh: 你现在感到痛苦吗？
sents.p: nǐ xiàn zài gǎn dào tòng kǔ ma
sents.en: Are you in pain now?

sents.zh: 显然，今天什么事都有可能发生。
sents.p: xiǎn rán jīn tiān shén me shì dōu yǒu kě néng fā shēng
sents.en: Apparently, there is nothing that cannot happen today.

sents.zh: 这显然是今年出版的最好的小说。
sents.p: zhè xiǎn rán shì jīn nián chū bǎn de zuì hǎo de xiǎo shuō
sents.en: This is by far the best novel that has been published this year.

sents.zh: 我们必须保持家庭传统。
sents.p: wǒ men bì xū bǎo chí jiā tíng chuán tǒng
sents.en: We must keep up the family traditions.

sents.zh: 因为健康状况不佳，他没去成旅行。
sents.p: yīn wèi jiàn kāng zhuàng kuàng bù jiā tā méi qù chéng lǚ xíng
sents.en: Poor health prohibited him from traveling.

sents.zh: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。
sents.p: nǐ bù yīng gāi zài shè jiāo wǎng luò shǎng fēn xiǎng guò duō sī rén xìn xī
sents.en: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.

sents.zh: 他们不是在打架，而是在排练戏剧。
sents.p: tā men bù shì zài dǎ jià ér shì zài pái liàn xì jù
sents.en: They aren't quarreling, but are rehearsing a play.

sents.zh: 我有大量的书在我的书架上。
sents.p: wǒ yǒu dà liàng de shū zài wǒ de shū jià shǎng
sents.en: I have numerous books on my bookshelf.

sents.zh: 你用了多少时间来翻译这本书？
sents.p: nǐ yòng le duō shǎo shí jiān lái fān yì zhè běn shū
sents.en: How long did it take you to translate this book?

sents.zh: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。
sents.p: shì jiè jiù xiàng shì yī běn shū zǒu yī bù děng yú fān le yī xié
sents.en: The world is just like a book, and every step you take is like turning a page.

sents.zh: 他是世界上最伟大的科学家之一。
sents.p: tā shì shì jiè shǎng zuì wěi dà de kē xué jiā zhī yī
sents.en: He is numbered among the greatest scientists in the world.

sents.zh: 他是日本最伟大的艺术家之一。
sents.p: tā shì rì běn zuì wěi dà de yì shù jiā zhī yī
sents.en: He is one of the greatest artists in Japan.

sents.zh: 我不知道他来这里的确切时间。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào tā lái zhè lǐ dí què qiē shí jiān
sents.en: I don't know for certain when he will come.

sents.zh: 电视的确有一些缺点。
sents.p: diàn shì dí què yǒu yī xiē quē diǎn
sents.en: It is true that television also has some disadvantages.

sents.zh: 我想要一颗糖。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yào yī kē táng
sents.en: I want a piece of candy.

sents.zh: 我心里充满着快乐。
sents.p: wǒ xīn li chōng mǎn zhe kuài lè
sents.en: My heart was filled with happiness.

sents.zh: 他依旧充满活力。
sents.p: tā yī jiù chōng mǎn huó lì
sents.en: He is still very much alive.

sents.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
sents.p: wàn yī yǒu jǐn jí qíng kuàng lián xì wǒ de dài lǐ rén
sents.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.

sents.zh: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。
sents.p: jǐn jí qíng kuàng xià nín kě yǐ lián xì wǒ
sents.en: You can contact me in case of emergency.

sents.zh: 我不禁想我的儿子一直都在生。
sents.p: wǒ bù jīn xiǎng wǒ de ér zi yī zhí dōu zài shēng
sents.en: I cannot help thinking that my son is still alive.

sents.zh: 过去，我父亲常常喝酒直到深夜。
sents.p: guò qù wǒ fù qīn cháng cháng hē jiǔ zhí dào shēn yè
sents.en: My father used to drink till late at night.

sents.zh: 这个国家的主要产品之一是咖啡。
sents.p: zhè gè guó jiā de zhǔ yào chǎn pǐn zhī yī shì kā fēi
sents.en: One of the main products of this country is coffee.

sents.zh: 这些产品的品质是一样的。
sents.p: zhè xiē chǎn pǐn de pǐn zhì shì yī yàng de
sents.en: The quality of these products is the same.

sents.zh: 她跑得很快是为了赶上其他成员。
sents.p: tā páo de hěn kuài shì wèi le gǎn shàng qí tā chéng yuán
sents.en: She ran very fast to catch up with the other members.

sents.zh: 仅三分之一的成员出席了会议。
sents.p: jǐn sān fēn zhī yī de chéng yuán chū xí le huì yì
sents.en: Only one third of the members turned up at the meeting.

sents.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。
sents.p: wàn yī chuán yùn chí le wǒ men yǒu tè bié de chí dào bǎo xiǎn
sents.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.

sents.zh: 保险箱的钥匙在我这儿。
sents.p: bǎo xiǎn xiāng de yào shi zài wǒ zhèr
sents.en: I have the key to the safe.

sents.zh: 我的意见是，你该再次参加测试。
sents.p: wǒ de yì jiàn shì nǐ gāi zài cì cān jiā cè shì
sents.en: I think you should take the test again.

sents.zh: 我觉得这个测试很难。
sents.p: wǒ jué de zhè gè cè shì hěn nán
sents.en: I found the test difficult.

sents.zh: 我们需要称职的领导人。
sents.p: wǒ men xū yào chèn zhí de lǐng dǎo rén
sents.en: We need competent leaders.

sents.zh: 我正在为我的妈妈寻找礼物。
sents.p: wǒ zhèng zài wèi wǒ de mā ma xún zhǎo lǐ wù
sents.en: I am looking for a present for my mother.

sents.zh: 我应该寻找什么？
sents.p: wǒ yīng gāi xún zhǎo shén me
sents.en: What should I look for?

sents.zh: 她理所当然的取得了胜利。
sents.p: tā lǐ suǒ dāng rán de qǔ dé le shèng lì
sents.en: She's sure to succeed.

sents.zh: 正义终将胜利。
sents.p: zhèng yì zhōng jiāng shèng lì
sents.en: Justice will prevail in the end.

sents.zh: 谁是你最喜爱的电视明星？
sents.p: shéi shì nǐ zuì xǐ ài de diàn shì míng xīng
sents.en: Who's your favorite TV star?

sents.zh: 我的兄弟和我在一个班级。
sents.p: wǒ de xiōng dì hé wǒ zài yī gè bān jí
sents.en: My brother and I are in the same class.

sents.zh: 记住我的级别在你的之上。
sents.p: jì zhu wǒ de jí bié zài nǐ de zhī shǎng
sents.en: Remember that I outrank you.

sents.zh: 在某种程度上你是对的，但我还是有疑问。
sents.p: zài mǒu zhǒng chéng dù shǎng nǐ shì duì de dàn wǒ hái shi yǒu yí wèn
sents.en: In a way you're right, but I still have doubts.

sents.zh: 一个国家纸的产量和它的文明程度密切相关。
sents.p: yī gè guó jiā zhǐ de chǎn liàng hé tā de wén míng chéng dù mì qiè xiāng guān
sents.en: The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.

sents.zh: 我不在的时候，他将是我的代理人。
sents.p: wǒ bù zài de shí hou tā jiāng shì wǒ de dài lǐ rén
sents.en: He will be my deputy while I am away.

sents.zh: 我必须不惜一切代价帮助她。
sents.p: wǒ bì xū bù xī yī qiè dài jià bāng zhù tā
sents.en: I must help her at any cost.

sents.zh: 这个理论对我来说太难了，理解不了。
sents.p: zhè gè lǐ lùn duì wǒ lái shuō tài nán le lǐ jiě bù liǎo
sents.en: This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.

sents.zh: 我不想听你的理论。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng yǐn nǐ de lǐ lùn
sents.en: I don't want to hear your theories.

sents.zh: 我不喜欢以这种方式被对待。
sents.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan yǐ zhè zhǒng fāng shì bèi duì dài
sents.en: I don't like being treated like this.

sents.zh: 笔记本电脑比台式电脑好。
sents.p: bǐ jì běn diàn nǎo bǐ tái shì diàn nǎo hǎo
sents.en: A laptop is better than a desktop.

sents.zh: 他宣布与她订婚。
sents.p: tā xuān bù yú tā dìng hūn
sents.en: He announced his engagement to her.

sents.zh: 这药创造了奇迹。
sents.p: zhè yào chuàng zào le qí jì
sents.en: The medicine worked marvels.

sents.zh: 这台琴应该好多年没调过音了。
sents.p: zhè tái qín yīng gāi hǎo duō nián méi diào guò yīn le
sents.en: This piano has probably not been tuned for years.

sents.zh: 收音机太响了。你不能把音量调低一点吗？
sents.p: shōu yīn jī tài xiǎng le nǐ bù néng bǎ yīn liàng diào dī yī diǎn ma
sents.en: The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?

units.title: Media and technology
units.intro: Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

ex.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
ex.p: wèi le cān jiā huá chuán bǐ sài yī zhī xīn de duì wǔ zǔ chéng le
ex.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.

ex.zh: 我喜欢在队伍里。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan zài duì wǔ lǐ
ex.en: I like being on the team.

ex.zh: 他命令我立刻离开这个房间。
ex.p: tā mìng lìng wǒ lì kè lí kāi zhè gè fáng jiān
ex.en: He commanded me to leave the room immediately.

ex.zh: 他的医生命令他休息。
ex.p: tā de yī shēng mìng lìng tā xiū xi
ex.en: His doctor ordered him to rest.

items.en: to burn; to cook; to stew

ex.zh: 我烧得很厉害。
ex.p: wǒ shāo de hěn lì hai
ex.en: I have a high fever.

ex.zh: 我烧掉了一切。
ex.p: wǒ shāo diào le yī qiè
ex.en: I burnt everything.

ex.zh: 事故似乎和厚厚的积雪有关。
ex.p: shì gù sì hū hé hòu hòu de jī xuě yǒu guān
ex.en: The accident seemed to have something to do with the heavy snow.

ex.zh: 交通事故的数量似乎在增长。
ex.p: jiāo tōng shì gù de shù liàng sì hū zài zēng zhǎng
ex.en: The number of traffic accidents seems to be on the increase.

ex.zh: 人们都说，东京是座很安全的城市。
ex.p: rén men dōu shuō dōng jīng shì zuò hěn ān quán de chéng shì
ex.en: It's said that Tokyo is a very safe city.

ex.zh: 我所想要的是一点平和和安静。
ex.p: wǒ suǒ xiǎng yào de shì yī diǎn píng hé hé ān jìng
ex.en: What I want is some peace and quiet.

ex.zh: 我认为考试破坏教育。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi kǎo shì pò huài jiào yù
ex.en: I think exams ruin education.

ex.zh: 她挥着她的手，直到火车消失在视线之外。
ex.p: tā huī zhe tā de shǒu zhí dào huǒ chē xiāo shī zài shì xiàn zhī wài
ex.en: She waved her hand until the train was out of sight.

ex.zh: 从山上走来一只巨大的怪物。
ex.p: cóng shān shǎng zǒu lái yī zhǐ jù dà de guài wu
ex.en: A huge monster is coming down the mountain.

ex.zh: 这是一个巨大的挑战。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè jù dà de tiǎo zhàn
ex.en: That's a huge challenge.

ex.zh: 你在你的床下面藏了多少钱？
ex.p: nǐ zài nǐ de chuáng xià miàn zàng le duō shǎo qián
ex.en: How much money do you have hidden under your bed?

ex.zh: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng kàn kàn nín de yóu piào shōu cáng
ex.en: I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.

ex.zh: 我喜欢火龙果。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan huǒ lóng guǒ
ex.en: I like dragon fruit.

items.en: to satisfy; to meet (the needs of); satisfied

ex.zh: 尽管他很富有，他还是不满足。
ex.p: jǐn guǎn tā hěn fù yǒu tā hái shi bù mǎn jù
ex.en: Despite his riches, he's not contented.

ex.zh: 你会发现难以满足她。
ex.p: nǐ huì fā xiàn nán yǐ mǎn zú tā
ex.en: You'll find it difficult to meet her requirements.

items.en: to join; to fit; to mate

ex.zh: 这个实验室配备了最新的计算机。
ex.p: zhè gè shí yàn shì pèi bèi le zuì xīn de jì suàn jī
ex.en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.

ex.zh: 这家工厂生产汽车配件。
ex.p: zhè jiā gōng chǎng shēng chǎn qì chē pèi jiàn
ex.en: This factory manufactures automobile parts.

ex.zh: 他买土地目的是要造房子。
ex.p: tā mǎi tǔ dì mù dì shì yào zào fáng zi
ex.en: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.

ex.zh: 他威胁要公开。
ex.p: tā wēi xié yào gōng kāi
ex.en: He threatened to make it public.

ex.zh: 我在国外旅行的时候，我老婆老给我打电话。
ex.p: wǒ zài guó wài lǚ xíng de shí hou wǒ lǎo pó lǎo gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
ex.en: My wife often telephones me when I'm traveling in another country.

ex.zh: 我不想做你老婆了。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zuò nǐ lǎo pó le
ex.en: I no longer wish to be your wife.

ex.zh: 没人知道等待我们的是什么。
ex.p: méi rén zhī dào děng dài wǒ men de shì shén me
ex.en: No one knew what awaited us.

ex.zh: 我屏住了呼吸等待着。
ex.p: wǒ píng zhù le hū xī děng dài zhe
ex.en: I held my breath and waited.

ex.zh: 没有挑战就没有收获。
ex.p: méi yǒu tiǎo zhàn jiù méi yǒu shōu huò
ex.en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

ex.zh: 这是一个巨大的挑战。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè jù dà de tiǎo zhàn
ex.en: That's a huge challenge.

ex.zh: 军队占领了整片领土。
ex.p: jūn duì zhàn lǐng le zhěng piān lǐng tǔ
ex.en: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.

ex.zh: 房子现在没被占住。
ex.p: fáng zi xiàn zài méi bèi zhàn zhù
ex.en: The house isn't occupied now.

items.en: secret; private; confidential; clandestine; a secret

ex.zh: 他把她的秘密告诉了他的朋友。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā de mì mì gào sù le tā de péng you
ex.en: He betrayed her secret to his friends.

ex.zh: 我们打算让你知道这个秘密。
ex.p: wǒ men dǎ suàn ràng nǐ zhī dào zhè gè mì mì
ex.en: We intended to let you in on the secret.

ex.zh: 我曾经像猪一样吃。
ex.p: wǒ céng jīng xiàng zhū yī yàng chī
ex.en: I used to eat like a pig.

ex.zh: 猪肉不适合我。
ex.p: zhū ròu bù shì gě wǒ
ex.en: Pork doesn't agree with me.

items.en: to signify; to mean; to imply

ex.zh: 这很可能意味着战争。
ex.p: zhè hěn kě néng yì wèi zhe zhàn zhēng
ex.en: This probably means war.

ex.zh: 沉默就意味着同意。
ex.p: chén mò jiù yì wèi zhe tóng yì
ex.en: Silence gives consent.

ex.zh: 老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。
ex.p: lǎo líng huā de rén kǒu xū yào gēng duō yī liáo bǎo jiàn zhī chū
ex.en: An aging population will require more spending on health care.

ex.zh: 我不能确保这一切会发生。
ex.p: wǒ bù néng què bǎo zhè yī qiè huì fā shēng
ex.en: I can't guarantee that that's going to happen.

ex.zh: 那个团体为难民们提供食品供给。
ex.p: nà gè tuán tǐ wéi nán mín men tí gōng shí pǐn gōng jǐ
ex.en: The organization furnished the refugees with food.

ex.zh: 带孩子团体去图书馆一点问题都没有。
ex.p: dài hái zi tuán tǐ qù tú shū guǎn yī diǎn wèn tí dōu méi yǒu
ex.en: Taking the group of children to the library was no problem.

ex.zh: 他为他的迟到制造了一个借口。
ex.p: tā wèi tā de chí dào zhì zào le yī gè jiè kǒu
ex.en: He invented an excuse for being late.

ex.zh: 他们知道如何制造原子弹。
ex.p: tā men zhī dào rú hé zhì zào yuán zǐ dàn
ex.en: They know how to make an atomic bomb.

ex.zh: 她迷路了，紧接着天开始下雨了。
ex.p: tā mí lù le jǐn jiē zhe tiān kāi shǐ xià yǔ le
ex.en: She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.

ex.zh: 我没有一次演讲的时候是不紧张的。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī cì yǎn jiǎng de shí hou shì bù jǐn zhāng de
ex.en: I never make a speech without being nervous.

items.en: to draw out; to pull out from in between; to remove part of the whole

ex.zh: 如果您想抽烟的话，您必须出去。
ex.p: rú guǒ nín xiǎng chōu yān de huà nín bì xū chū qù
ex.en: You must go outside if you want to smoke.

ex.zh: 这些天我会抽一天来看你的。
ex.p: zhè xiē tiān wǒ huì chōu yī tiān lái kàn nǐ de
ex.en: I'll come and see you one of these days.

ex.zh: 想象一下，假如你有一台时光机。
ex.p: xiǎng xiàng yī xià jiǎ rú nǐ yǒu yī tái shí guāng jī
ex.en: Imagine that you have a time machine.

ex.zh: 你可以想象在月球上行走吗？
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ xiǎng xiàng zài yuè qiú shǎng xíng zǒu ma
ex.en: Can you imagine walking on the moon?

items.en: to require; to need; to want

ex.zh: 你真的需要提问题来知道答案吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhēn de xū yào tí wèn tí lái zhī dào dá àn ma
ex.en: Do you really need to ask the question to know the answer?

ex.zh: 你还以为我不需要那么做，不是吗？
ex.p: nǐ hái yǐ wéi wǒ bù xū yào nà me zuò bù shì ma
ex.en: You thought I didn't need to do that, didn't you?

ex.zh: 你会需要一个特殊的工具来做这件事。
ex.p: nǐ huì xū yào yī gè tè shū de gōng jù lái zuò zhè jiàn shì
ex.en: You'll need a special tool to do it.

ex.zh: 你具体需要些什么？
ex.p: nǐ jù tǐ xū yào xiē shén me
ex.en: What do you need exactly?

ex.zh: 如果他年轻一点，他将很适合这个职位。
ex.p: rú guǒ tā nián qīng yī diǎn tā jiāng hěn shì hé zhè gè zhí wèi
ex.en: If he were a little younger, he would be eligible for the post.

ex.zh: 有时候，发生的事情并不是合情合理的。
ex.p: yǒu shí hou fā shēng de shì qing bìng bù shì hé qíng hé lǐ de
ex.en: Sometimes things that happen do not make sense.

ex.zh: 一个有名的建筑师造了这个房子。
ex.p: yī gè yǒu míng de jiàn zhù shī zào le zhè gè fáng zi

ex.zh: 这里现在有了许多新建筑。
ex.p: zhè lǐ xiàn zài yǒu le xǔ duō xīn jiàn zhù
ex.en: There are a lot of new buildings here now.

ex.zh: 她已经无法用语言表达她的感觉了。

ex.zh: 我爱你胜过其他任何一个人。

ex.p: què bǎo qīn zì tián xiě zhù cè biǎo gé

ex.p: nǐ dào dǐ wèi shén me bǎ nǐ xīn jiàn de fáng zi mài le

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第75单元

Media and technology

Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
sents.p: wèi le cān jiā huá chuán bǐ sài yī zhī xīn de duì wǔ zǔ chéng le
sents.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.

sents.zh: 我喜欢在队伍里。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan zài duì wǔ lǐ
sents.en: I like being on the team.

sents.zh: 他命令我立刻离开这个房间。
sents.p: tā mìng lìng wǒ lì kè lí kāi zhè gè fáng jiān
sents.en: He commanded me to leave the room immediately.

sents.zh: 他的医生命令他休息。
sents.p: tā de yī shēng mìng lìng tā xiū xi
sents.en: His doctor ordered him to rest.

sents.zh: 我烧得很厉害。
sents.p: wǒ shāo de hěn lì hai
sents.en: I have a high fever.

sents.zh: 我烧掉了一切。
sents.p: wǒ shāo diào le yī qiè
sents.en: I burnt everything.

sents.zh: 事故似乎和厚厚的积雪有关。
sents.p: shì gù sì hū hé hòu hòu de jī xuě yǒu guān
sents.en: The accident seemed to have something to do with the heavy snow.

sents.zh: 交通事故的数量似乎在增长。
sents.p: jiāo tōng shì gù de shù liàng sì hū zài zēng zhǎng
sents.en: The number of traffic accidents seems to be on the increase.

sents.zh: 人们都说，东京是座很安全的城市。
sents.p: rén men dōu shuō dōng jīng shì zuò hěn ān quán de chéng shì
sents.en: It's said that Tokyo is a very safe city.

sents.zh: 我所想要的是一点平和和安静。
sents.p: wǒ suǒ xiǎng yào de shì yī diǎn píng hé hé ān jìng
sents.en: What I want is some peace and quiet.

sents.zh: 我认为考试破坏教育。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi kǎo shì pò huài jiào yù
sents.en: I think exams ruin education.

sents.zh: 她挥着她的手，直到火车消失在视线之外。
sents.p: tā huī zhe tā de shǒu zhí dào huǒ chē xiāo shī zài shì xiàn zhī wài
sents.en: She waved her hand until the train was out of sight.

sents.zh: 从山上走来一只巨大的怪物。
sents.p: cóng shān shǎng zǒu lái yī zhǐ jù dà de guài wu
sents.en: A huge monster is coming down the mountain.

sents.zh: 这是一个巨大的挑战。
sents.p: zhè shì yī gè jù dà de tiǎo zhàn
sents.en: That's a huge challenge.

sents.zh: 你在你的床下面藏了多少钱？
sents.p: nǐ zài nǐ de chuáng xià miàn zàng le duō shǎo qián
sents.en: How much money do you have hidden under your bed?

sents.zh: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng kàn kàn nín de yóu piào shōu cáng
sents.en: I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.

sents.zh: 我喜欢火龙果。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan huǒ lóng guǒ
sents.en: I like dragon fruit.

sents.zh: 尽管他很富有，他还是不满足。
sents.p: jǐn guǎn tā hěn fù yǒu tā hái shi bù mǎn jù
sents.en: Despite his riches, he's not contented.

sents.zh: 你会发现难以满足她。
sents.p: nǐ huì fā xiàn nán yǐ mǎn zú tā
sents.en: You'll find it difficult to meet her requirements.

sents.zh: 这个实验室配备了最新的计算机。
sents.p: zhè gè shí yàn shì pèi bèi le zuì xīn de jì suàn jī
sents.en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.

sents.zh: 这家工厂生产汽车配件。
sents.p: zhè jiā gōng chǎng shēng chǎn qì chē pèi jiàn
sents.en: This factory manufactures automobile parts.

sents.zh: 他买土地目的是要造房子。
sents.p: tā mǎi tǔ dì mù dì shì yào zào fáng zi
sents.en: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.

sents.zh: 他威胁要公开。
sents.p: tā wēi xié yào gōng kāi
sents.en: He threatened to make it public.

sents.zh: 我在国外旅行的时候，我老婆老给我打电话。
sents.p: wǒ zài guó wài lǚ xíng de shí hou wǒ lǎo pó lǎo gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
sents.en: My wife often telephones me when I'm traveling in another country.

sents.zh: 我不想做你老婆了。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zuò nǐ lǎo pó le
sents.en: I no longer wish to be your wife.

sents.zh: 没人知道等待我们的是什么。
sents.p: méi rén zhī dào děng dài wǒ men de shì shén me
sents.en: No one knew what awaited us.

sents.zh: 我屏住了呼吸等待着。
sents.p: wǒ píng zhù le hū xī děng dài zhe
sents.en: I held my breath and waited.

sents.zh: 没有挑战就没有收获。
sents.p: méi yǒu tiǎo zhàn jiù méi yǒu shōu huò
sents.en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

sents.zh: 军队占领了整片领土。
sents.p: jūn duì zhàn lǐng le zhěng piān lǐng tǔ
sents.en: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.

sents.zh: 房子现在没被占住。
sents.p: fáng zi xiàn zài méi bèi zhàn zhù
sents.en: The house isn't occupied now.

sents.zh: 他把她的秘密告诉了他的朋友。
sents.p: tā bǎ tā de mì mì gào sù le tā de péng you
sents.en: He betrayed her secret to his friends.

sents.zh: 我们打算让你知道这个秘密。
sents.p: wǒ men dǎ suàn ràng nǐ zhī dào zhè gè mì mì
sents.en: We intended to let you in on the secret.

sents.zh: 我曾经像猪一样吃。
sents.p: wǒ céng jīng xiàng zhū yī yàng chī
sents.en: I used to eat like a pig.

sents.zh: 猪肉不适合我。
sents.p: zhū ròu bù shì gě wǒ
sents.en: Pork doesn't agree with me.

sents.zh: 这很可能意味着战争。
sents.p: zhè hěn kě néng yì wèi zhe zhàn zhēng
sents.en: This probably means war.

sents.zh: 沉默就意味着同意。
sents.p: chén mò jiù yì wèi zhe tóng yì
sents.en: Silence gives consent.

sents.zh: 老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。
sents.p: lǎo líng huā de rén kǒu xū yào gēng duō yī liáo bǎo jiàn zhī chū
sents.en: An aging population will require more spending on health care.

sents.zh: 我不能确保这一切会发生。
sents.p: wǒ bù néng què bǎo zhè yī qiè huì fā shēng
sents.en: I can't guarantee that that's going to happen.

sents.zh: 那个团体为难民们提供食品供给。
sents.p: nà gè tuán tǐ wéi nán mín men tí gōng shí pǐn gōng jǐ
sents.en: The organization furnished the refugees with food.

sents.zh: 带孩子团体去图书馆一点问题都没有。
sents.p: dài hái zi tuán tǐ qù tú shū guǎn yī diǎn wèn tí dōu méi yǒu
sents.en: Taking the group of children to the library was no problem.

sents.zh: 他为他的迟到制造了一个借口。
sents.p: tā wèi tā de chí dào zhì zào le yī gè jiè kǒu
sents.en: He invented an excuse for being late.

sents.zh: 他们知道如何制造原子弹。
sents.p: tā men zhī dào rú hé zhì zào yuán zǐ dàn
sents.en: They know how to make an atomic bomb.

sents.zh: 她迷路了，紧接着天开始下雨了。
sents.p: tā mí lù le jǐn jiē zhe tiān kāi shǐ xià yǔ le
sents.en: She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.

sents.zh: 我没有一次演讲的时候是不紧张的。
sents.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī cì yǎn jiǎng de shí hou shì bù jǐn zhāng de
sents.en: I never make a speech without being nervous.

sents.zh: 如果您想抽烟的话，您必须出去。
sents.p: rú guǒ nín xiǎng chōu yān de huà nín bì xū chū qù
sents.en: You must go outside if you want to smoke.

sents.zh: 这些天我会抽一天来看你的。
sents.p: zhè xiē tiān wǒ huì chōu yī tiān lái kàn nǐ de
sents.en: I'll come and see you one of these days.

sents.zh: 想象一下，假如你有一台时光机。
sents.p: xiǎng xiàng yī xià jiǎ rú nǐ yǒu yī tái shí guāng jī
sents.en: Imagine that you have a time machine.

sents.zh: 你可以想象在月球上行走吗？
sents.p: nǐ kě yǐ xiǎng xiàng zài yuè qiú shǎng xíng zǒu ma
sents.en: Can you imagine walking on the moon?

sents.zh: 你真的需要提问题来知道答案吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhēn de xū yào tí wèn tí lái zhī dào dá àn ma
sents.en: Do you really need to ask the question to know the answer?

sents.zh: 你还以为我不需要那么做，不是吗？
sents.p: nǐ hái yǐ wéi wǒ bù xū yào nà me zuò bù shì ma
sents.en: You thought I didn't need to do that, didn't you?

sents.zh: 你会需要一个特殊的工具来做这件事。
sents.p: nǐ huì xū yào yī gè tè shū de gōng jù lái zuò zhè jiàn shì
sents.en: You'll need a special tool to do it.

sents.zh: 你具体需要些什么？
sents.p: nǐ jù tǐ xū yào xiē shén me
sents.en: What do you need exactly?

sents.zh: 如果他年轻一点，他将很适合这个职位。
sents.p: rú guǒ tā nián qīng yī diǎn tā jiāng hěn shì hé zhè gè zhí wèi
sents.en: If he were a little younger, he would be eligible for the post.

sents.zh: 有时候，发生的事情并不是合情合理的。
sents.p: yǒu shí hou fā shēng de shì qing bìng bù shì hé qíng hé lǐ de
sents.en: Sometimes things that happen do not make sense.

sents.zh: 一个有名的建筑师造了这个房子。
sents.p: yī gè yǒu míng de jiàn zhù shī zào le zhè gè fáng zi
sents.en: A famous architect built this house.

sents.zh: 这里现在有了许多新建筑。
sents.p: zhè lǐ xiàn zài yǒu le xǔ duō xīn jiàn zhù
sents.en: There are a lot of new buildings here now.

sents.zh: 大自然在我们的生活中扮演着重要的角色。
sents.p: dà zì rán zài wǒ men de shēng huó zhōng bàn yǎn zhuó zhòng yào de jué sè
sents.en: Nature plays an important role in our life.

sents.zh: 她已经无法用语言表达她的感觉了。
sents.p: tā yǐ jīng wú fǎ yòng yǔ yán biǎo dá tā de gǎn jué le
sents.en: She was at a loss for words to express her feeling.

sents.zh: 你想表达什么？
sents.p: nǐ xiǎng biǎo dá shén me
sents.en: What do you mean?

sents.zh: 我在这项计划上投入了所有精力。
sents.p: wǒ zài zhè xiàng jì huà shǎng tóu rù le suǒ yǒu jīng lì
sents.en: I've put all of my energy into this plan.

sents.zh: 人们认为，他完全能胜任这个工作。
sents.p: rén men rèn wéi tā wán quán néng shèng rèn zhè gè gōng zuò
sents.en: He was considered very qualified for the job.

sents.zh: 我爱你胜过其他任何一个人。
sents.p: wǒ ài nǐ shèng guò qí tā rèn hé yī gè rén
sents.en: I love you more than anyone else.

sents.zh: 确保亲自填写注册表格。
sents.p: què bǎo qīn zì tián xiě zhù cè biǎo gé
sents.en: Be sure to fill out the registration form in person.

sents.zh: 你到底为什么把你新建的房子卖了？
sents.p: nǐ dào dǐ wèi shén me bǎ nǐ xīn jiàn de fáng zi mài le
sents.en: Why on earth did you sell your newly-built house?

sents.zh: 如果你需要我的建议，我很愿意告诉你。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ xū yào wǒ de jiàn yì wǒ hěn yuàn yì gào sù nǐ
sents.en: If you need my advice, I'd be glad to give it to you.

units.title: Media and technology
units.intro: Grammar focus: 一旦; 从而; 以便; summarizing an article

ex.zh: 幸运的是他有足够的钱来付账。
ex.p: xìng yùn de shì tā yǒu zú gòu de qián lái fù zhàng
ex.en: Luckily he had enough money to pay the bill.

ex.zh: 你年龄足够大了，该了解更多。
ex.p: nǐ nián líng zú gòu dà le gāi liǎo jiě gēng duō
ex.en: You're old enough to know better.

items.en: right (i.e. an entitlement to sth); (classical) power and wealth

ex.zh: 我们知道我们的权利。
ex.p: wǒ men zhī dào wǒ men de quán lì
ex.en: We know our rights.

items.en: to take (a picture); to shoot (a film)

ex.zh: 他们根据情报采取行动。
ex.p: tā men gēn jù qíng bào cǎi qǔ xíng dòng
ex.en: They acted on the information.

ex.zh: 我们采取了强有力的预防措施。
ex.p: wǒ men cǎi qǔ le qiáng yǒu lì de yù fáng cuò shī
ex.en: We took strong measures to prevent it.

ex.zh: 在我的邻近区域有一个大超市。
ex.p: zài wǒ de lín jìn qū yù yǒu yī gè dà chāo shì
ex.en: There's a big supermarket in my neighborhood.

ex.zh: 这片区域很少下雪。
ex.p: zhè piān qū yù hěn shǎo xià xuě
ex.en: It rarely snows in this area.

items.en: period of time; time; time period

ex.zh: 他旅行期间，写了旅游日记。
ex.p: tā lǚ xíng qī jiān xiě le lǚ yóu rì jì
ex.en: He kept a diary during the trip.

ex.zh: 暑假期间，我在邮局工作。
ex.p: shǔ jià qī jiān wǒ zài yóu jú gōng zuò
ex.en: I worked in a post office during the summer vacation.

ex.zh: 他在工作中出了意外。
ex.p: tā zài gōng zuò zhōng chū le yì wài
ex.en: He had an accident at work.

ex.zh: 这真是很意外。
ex.p: zhè zhēn shì hěn yì wài

sents.zh: 那持续了多久了？
sents.p: nà chí xù le duō jiǔ le
sents.en: How long has it been going on?

sents.zh: 热情具有传染性。
sents.p: rè qíng jù yǒu chuán rǎn xìng
sents.en: Enthusiasm is contagious.

sents.zh: 老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。
sents.p: lǎo líng huā de rén kǒu xū yào gēng duō yī liáo bǎo jiàn zhī chū
sents.en: An aging population will require more spending on health care.

sents.zh: 不要再假装一切都好了，不是这样的！
sents.p: bù yào zài jiǎ zhuāng yī qiè dōu hǎo le bù shì zhè yàng de
sents.en: Stop pretending that everything's okay. It's not.

sents.zh: 他对他所做的一切感到后悔。
sents.p: tā duì tā suǒ zuò de yī qiè gǎn dào hòu huǐ
sents.en: He regrets what he did.

sents.zh: 在我六岁的时候，我第一次被带去看马戏。
sents.p: zài wǒ liù suì de shí hou wǒ dì yī cì bèi dài qù kàn mǎ xì
sents.en: At the age of six, I was taken to a circus for the first time.

sents.zh: 我觉得我不太喜欢这游戏。
sents.p: wǒ jué de wǒ bù tài xǐ huan zhè yóu xì
sents.en: I don't think I like this game very much.

sents.zh: 别用铅笔签合同。
sents.p: bié yòng qiān bǐ qiān hé tong
sents.en: Don't sign the contract in pencil.

sents.zh: 他们的合同在这个月底到期。
sents.p: tā men de hé tong zài zhè gè yuè dǐ dào qī
sents.en: Their contract is to run out at the end of this month.

sents.zh: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。
sents.p: wén zhāng de fā biǎo bèi yù dìng zài jiào shòu shēng rì nà tiān
sents.en: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.

sents.zh: 它发表在哪里？
sents.p: tā fā biǎo zài nǎ lǐ
sents.en: Where was it published?

sents.zh: 你处于危险之中。
sents.p: nǐ chǔ yú wēi xiǎn zhī zhōng
sents.en: You were in danger.

sents.zh: 桥处于修理中。
sents.p: qiáo chǔ yú xiū lǐ zhōng
sents.en: The bridge is being repaired.

sents.zh: 一个国家纸的产量和它的文明程度密切相关。
sents.p: yī gè guó jiā zhǐ de chǎn liàng hé tā de wén míng chéng dù mì qiè xiāng guān
sents.en: The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.

sents.zh: 这简直是太可惜了，他们没有买火险。
sents.p: zhè jiǎn zhí shì tài kě xī le tā men méi yǒu mǎi huǒ xiǎn
sents.en: It's a crying shame that they weren't insured against fire.

sents.zh: 可以在地图上展示给我看吗？
sents.p: kě yǐ zài dì tú shǎng zhǎn shì gěi wǒ kàn ma
sents.en: Can you show me on the map?

sents.zh: 有时候，我们应该后退一步想一想。
sents.p: yǒu shí hou wǒ men yīng gāi hòu tuì yī bù xiǎng yī xiǎng
sents.en: Once in a while, we should take a step back and think.

sents.zh: 他退休的时候，他儿子接手了他的生意。
sents.p: tā tuì xiū de shí hou tā ér zi jiē shǒu le tā de shēng yì
sents.en: When he retired, his son took over his business.

sents.zh: 这使我们更强大。
sents.p: zhè shǐ wǒ men gēng qiáng dà
sents.en: This makes us stronger.

sents.zh: 我们使用了强大的措施来预防。
sents.p: wǒ men shǐ yòng le qiáng dà de cuò shī lái yù fáng
sents.en: We took strong measures to prevent it.

sents.zh: 塑料代替了许多传统的原料。
sents.p: sù liào dài tì le xǔ duō chuán tǒng de yuán liào
sents.en: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.

sents.zh: 她用人造黄油代替了黄油。
sents.p: tā yòng rén zào huáng yóu dài tì le huáng yóu
sents.en: She substituted margarine for butter.

sents.zh: 两三年就想掌握法语是很困难的。
sents.p: liǎng sān nián jiù xiǎng zhǎng wò fǎ yǔ shì hěn kùn nan de
sents.en: It's quite difficult to master French in 2 or 3 years.

sents.zh: 要掌握法语一点都不容易。
sents.p: yào zhǎng wò fǎ yǔ yī diǎn dōu bù róng yì
sents.en: It's not at all easy to master French.

sents.zh: 警察收集了很多对他不利的证据。
sents.p: jǐng chá shōu jí le hěn duō duì tā bù lì de zhèng jù
sents.en: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.

sents.zh: 很幸运地，我在机场遇到了我的老朋友。
sents.p: hěn xìng yùn de wǒ zài jī chǎng yù dào le wǒ de lǎo péng you
sents.en: Quite by chance, I met my old friend at the airport.

sents.zh: 我非常非常幸运。
sents.p: wǒ fēi cháng fēi cháng xìng yùn
sents.en: I was very, very lucky.

sents.zh: 我想找一种提升记忆力的方法。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī zhǒng tí shēng jì yì lì de fāng fǎ
sents.en: I'd like to find a way to improve my memory.

sents.zh: 我现在仅有的东西就是我的记忆了。
sents.p: wǒ xiàn zài jǐn yǒu de dōng xī jiù shì wǒ de jì yì le
sents.en: The only thing I have now are memories.

sents.zh: 我们需要更多员工。
sents.p: wǒ men xū yào gēng duō yuán gōng
sents.en: We need more staff.

sents.zh: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。
sents.p: rú hé kè fú rì yuán shēng gāo shì gè dà wèn tí
sents.en: How to overcome the high value of the yen is a big problem.

sents.zh: 太阳从东边升起，西边落下。
sents.p: tài yang cóng dōng bian shēng qǐ xī biān luò xià
sents.en: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

sents.zh: 他的父母经营一家酒店。
sents.p: tā de fù mǔ jīng yíng yī jiā jiǔ diàn
sents.en: His parents ran a hotel.

units.title: Economy and consumption
units.intro: Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

ex.zh: 我当初要是买音乐会的票就好了。
ex.p: wǒ dāng chū yào shi mǎi yīn yuè huì de piào jiù hǎo le
ex.en: I wish I had bought a ticket for the concert.

ex.zh: 他已经不是我最初见他那时的那个人了。
ex.p: tā yǐ jīng bù shì wǒ zuì chū jiàn tā nà shí de nà gè rén le
ex.en: He is not the man that he was when I first knew him.

items.en: to display; to exhibit; to bring out implicit or innate qualities

ex.zh: 发挥您的想象力。
ex.p: fā huī nín de xiǎng xiàng lì
ex.en: Use your imagination.

ex.zh: 你必须独立完成。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū dú lì wán chéng
ex.en: You have to do it by yourself.

ex.zh: 要完成实验，三个月太短了。
ex.p: yào wán chéng shí yàn sān gè yuè tài duǎn le
ex.en: Three months is too short a time to finish the experiment.

ex.zh: 实验室里的空调坏了。
ex.p: shí yàn shì lǐ de kōng tiáo huài le
ex.en: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.

ex.zh: 语言是人们与他人交流的手段。
ex.p: yǔ yán shì rén men yú tā rén jiāo liú de shǒu duàn
ex.en: Language is the means by which people communicate with others.

ex.zh: 人们通常不喜欢他们不理解的事物。
ex.p: rén men tōng cháng bù xǐ huan tā men bù lǐ xiè de shì wù
ex.en: People usually don't like what they don't understand.

ex.zh: 我通常星期天要到中午才起床。
ex.p: wǒ tōng cháng xīng qī tiān yào dào zhōng wǔ cái qǐ chuáng
ex.en: I usually don't get up until noon on Sundays.

items.en: to target; to focus on; to be aimed at or against

ex.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi jìn zhǐ zhēn duì ér tóng de guǎng gào
ex.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.

items.en: on the eve of; to be about to; to be on the verge of

ex.zh: 这场谈论即将对污染问题展开讨论。
ex.p: zhè cháng tán lùn jí jiāng duì wū rǎn wèn tí zhǎn kāi tǎo lùn
ex.en: The talks will deal with the problem of pollution.

ex.zh: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。
ex.p: shí jiān shì shì jiè shǎng zuì bǎo guì de dōng xī
ex.en: Time is the most precious thing in the world.

ex.zh: 有些宝宝甚至在一岁之前就学习游泳了。
ex.p: yǒu xiē bǎo bao shèn zhì zài yī suì zhī qián jiù xué xí yóu yǒng le
ex.en: Some babies learn to swim even before they are one year old.

items.en: regret; to regret; to be sorry that

ex.zh: 我们很遗憾没能帮助你们。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn yí hàn méi néng bāng zhù nǐ men
ex.en: We are sorry we can't help you.

ex.zh: 有人死了的时候真是遗憾。
ex.p: yǒu rén sǐ le de shí hou zhēn shì yí hàn
ex.en: It's a pity when somebody dies.

ex.zh: 你能帮我说明一下规则吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng bāng wǒ shuō míng yī xià guī zé ma
ex.en: Will you explain the rule to me?

ex.zh: 我不喜欢学习不规则动词。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan xué xí bù guī zé dòng cí
ex.en: I don't like learning irregular verbs.

ex.zh: 请问在欧洲最高的山是哪儿呢？
ex.p: qǐng wèn zài oū zhōu zuì gāo de shān shì nǎr ne
ex.en: What's the tallest mountain in Europe?

ex.zh: 去哪里可以买到欧洲的地图？
ex.p: qù nǎ lǐ kě yǐ mǎi dào oū zhōu de dì tú
ex.en: Where can I go to get a map of Europe?

ex.zh: 他的死对我们公司是一个巨大的损失。
ex.p: tā de sǐ duì wǒ men gōng sī shì yī gè jù dà de sǔn shī
ex.en: His death was a great loss to our firm.

ex.zh: 有时候，发生的事情并不是合情合理的。
ex.p: yǒu shí hou fā shēng de shì qing bìng bù shì hé qíng hé lǐ de
ex.en: Sometimes things that happen do not make sense.

ex.zh: 这个价格不合理。
ex.p: zhè gè jià gé bù hé lǐ
ex.en: The price isn't reasonable.

items.en: to cheat; to swindle; to deceive

ex.zh: 他说他没有进房间，那是骗人的。
ex.p: tā shuō tā méi yǒu jìn fáng jiān nà shì piàn rén de
ex.en: He said he did not enter the room, which was a lie.

ex.zh: 它是给容易上当受骗的人的。
ex.p: tā shì gěi róng yì shàng dàng shòu piàn de rén de
ex.en: That's for suckers.

ex.zh: 她现在依然依靠父母生活。
ex.p: tā xiàn zài yī rán yī kào fù mǔ shēng huó
ex.en: She's still dependent on her parents.

ex.zh: 你依然和父母住一起吗？
ex.p: nǐ yī rán hé fù mǔ zhù yī qǐ ma
ex.en: Are you still living with your parents?

items.en: mature; ripe; to mature; to ripen

ex.zh: 我和他们意见一致。
ex.p: wǒ hé tā men yì jiàn yī zhì
ex.en: I think the same as they do.

ex.zh: 选举一致通过了。
ex.p: xuǎn jǔ yī zhì tōng guò le
ex.en: The vote is unanimous.

items.en: to trust; to have confidence in

ex.zh: 你们除了信任对方，没什么要做的了。
ex.p: nǐ men chú le xìn rèn duì fāng méi shén me yào zuò de le
ex.en: All you can do is trust one another.

ex.zh: 你是我唯一可以信任的人。
ex.p: nǐ shì wǒ wéi yī kě yǐ xìn rèn de rén
ex.en: You're the only person I can trust.

ex.zh: 你今年做的最刺激的事是什么？
ex.p: nǐ jīn nián zuò de zuì cì jī de shì shì shén me
ex.en: What's the most exciting thing you've done this year?

items.en: to sell; to market; sales (representative, agreement etc)

ex.zh: 谁负责销售部门？
ex.p: shéi fù zé xiāo shòu bù mén
ex.en: Who's in charge of the sales section?

ex.zh: 今年销售会翻番。
ex.p: jīn nián xiāo shòu huì fān fān
ex.en: Sales should double this year.

items.en: buying and selling; business; business transactions
to sell; to offer for sale; to put on the market

ex.zh: 这房子不出售。
ex.p: zhè fáng zi bù chū shòu
ex.en: This house isn't for sale.

ex.zh: 油价上涨的可能性很高。
ex.p: yóu jià shàng zhǎng de kě néng xìng hěn gāo
ex.en: There is a good chance that gasoline prices will go up.

ex.zh: 我正在把价格涨一倍。
ex.p: wǒ zhèng zài bǎ jià gé zhǎng yī bèi
ex.en: I'm doubling my prices.

ex.zh: 我该用短一点的用户名的。
ex.p: wǒ gāi yòng duǎn yī diǎn de yòng hù míng de
ex.en: I should've chosen a shorter username.

ex.zh: 我想不到好的用户名
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng bù dào hǎo de yòng hù míng
ex.en: I can't think of a good username.

items.en: expense; cost; to spend (time or money)

ex.zh: 你估计做那件事需要花费你多少时间呢？
ex.p: nǐ gū jì zuò nà jiàn shì xū yào huā fèi nǐ duō shǎo shí jiān ne
ex.en: How much time do you estimate it'll take you to do that?

ex.zh: 我购买一本书花费了三十美元。
ex.p: wǒ gòu mǎi yī běn shū huā fèi le sān shí měi yuán
ex.en: I spent thirty dollars on a book.

items.en: to deposit money (in a bank etc); bank savings; bank deposit

ex.zh: 你们什么时候开始营业？
ex.p: nǐ men shén me shí hou kāi shǐ yíng yè
ex.en: What time do you open?

ex.zh: 银行星期六不营业。
ex.p: yín háng xīng qī liù bù yíng yè
ex.en: The bank is not open on Saturdays.

items.en: preferably; one would prefer to...(or not to...); would rather
to appreciate (in value); to increase in price
rather than...; 与其 A 如 B (rather than A, better to B)

ex.zh: 与其让我在他手下干，我宁愿辞职。
ex.p: yǔ qí ràng wǒ zài tā shǒu xià gàn wǒ nìng yuàn cí zhí
ex.en: I would rather quit than work under him.

items.en: money given to children as a gift on Chinese New Year's Eve

sents.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.

sents.zh: 这场谈论即将对污染问题展开讨论。
sents.p: zhè cháng tán lùn jí jiāng duì wū rǎn wèn tí zhǎn kāi tǎo lùn
sents.en: The talks will deal with the problem of pollution.

sents.zh: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。
sents.p: shí jiān shì shì jiè shǎng zuì bǎo guì de dōng xī
sents.en: Time is the most precious thing in the world.

sents.zh: 有些宝宝甚至在一岁之前就学习游泳了。
sents.p: yǒu xiē bǎo bao shèn zhì zài yī suì zhī qián jiù xué xí yóu yǒng le
sents.en: Some babies learn to swim even before they are one year old.

sents.zh: 我们很遗憾没能帮助你们。
sents.p: wǒ men hěn yí hàn méi néng bāng zhù nǐ men
sents.en: We are sorry we can't help you.

sents.zh: 有人死了的时候真是遗憾。
sents.p: yǒu rén sǐ le de shí hou zhēn shì yí hàn
sents.en: It's a pity when somebody dies.

sents.zh: 你能帮我说明一下规则吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng bāng wǒ shuō míng yī xià guī zé ma
sents.en: Will you explain the rule to me?

sents.zh: 我不喜欢学习不规则动词。
sents.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan xué xí bù guī zé dòng cí
sents.en: I don't like learning irregular verbs.

sents.zh: 请问在欧洲最高的山是哪儿呢？
sents.p: qǐng wèn zài oū zhōu zuì gāo de shān shì nǎr ne
sents.en: What's the tallest mountain in Europe?

sents.zh: 去哪里可以买到欧洲的地图？
sents.p: qù nǎ lǐ kě yǐ mǎi dào oū zhōu de dì tú
sents.en: Where can I go to get a map of Europe?

sents.zh: 他的死对我们公司是一个巨大的损失。
sents.p: tā de sǐ duì wǒ men gōng sī shì yī gè jù dà de sǔn shī
sents.en: His death was a great loss to our firm.

sents.zh: 有时候，发生的事情并不是合情合理的。
sents.p: yǒu shí hou fā shēng de shì qing bìng bù shì hé qíng hé lǐ de
sents.en: Sometimes things that happen do not make sense.

sents.zh: 这个价格不合理。
sents.p: zhè gè jià gé bù hé lǐ
sents.en: The price isn't reasonable.

sents.zh: 他说他没有进房间，那是骗人的。
sents.p: tā shuō tā méi yǒu jìn fáng jiān nà shì piàn rén de
sents.en: He said he did not enter the room, which was a lie.

sents.zh: 它是给容易上当受骗的人的。
sents.p: tā shì gěi róng yì shàng dàng shòu piàn de rén de
sents.en: That's for suckers.

sents.zh: 她现在依然依靠父母生活。
sents.p: tā xiàn zài yī rán yī kào fù mǔ shēng huó
sents.en: She's still dependent on her parents.

sents.zh: 你依然和父母住一起吗？
sents.p: nǐ yī rán hé fù mǔ zhù yī qǐ ma
sents.en: Are you still living with your parents?

sents.zh: 我和他们意见一致。
sents.p: wǒ hé tā men yì jiàn yī zhì
sents.en: I think the same as they do.

sents.zh: 选举一致通过了。
sents.p: xuǎn jǔ yī zhì tōng guò le
sents.en: The vote is unanimous.

sents.zh: 你们除了信任对方，没什么要做的了。
sents.p: nǐ men chú le xìn rèn duì fāng méi shén me yào zuò de le
sents.en: All you can do is trust one another.

sents.zh: 你是我唯一可以信任的人。
sents.p: nǐ shì wǒ wéi yī kě yǐ xìn rèn de rén
sents.en: You're the only person I can trust.

sents.zh: 你今年做的最刺激的事是什么？
sents.p: nǐ jīn nián zuò de zuì cì jī de shì shì shén me
sents.en: What's the most exciting thing you've done this year?

sents.zh: 谁负责销售部门？
sents.p: shéi fù zé xiāo shòu bù mén
sents.en: Who's in charge of the sales section?

sents.zh: 今年销售会翻番。
sents.p: jīn nián xiāo shòu huì fān fān
sents.en: Sales should double this year.

sents.zh: 这房子不出售。
sents.p: zhè fáng zi bù chū shòu
sents.en: This house isn't for sale.

sents.zh: 油价上涨的可能性很高。
sents.p: yóu jià shàng zhǎng de kě néng xìng hěn gāo
sents.en: There is a good chance that gasoline prices will go up.

sents.zh: 我正在把价格涨一倍。
sents.p: wǒ zhèng zài bǎ jià gé zhǎng yī bèi
sents.en: I'm doubling my prices.

sents.zh: 我该用短一点的用户名的。
sents.p: wǒ gāi yòng duǎn yī diǎn de yòng hù míng de
sents.en: I should've chosen a shorter username.

sents.zh: 我想不到好的用户名
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng bù dào hǎo de yòng hù míng
sents.en: I can't think of a good username.

sents.zh: 你估计做那件事需要花费你多少时间呢？
sents.p: nǐ gū jì zuò nà jiàn shì xū yào huā fèi nǐ duō shǎo shí jiān ne
sents.en: How much time do you estimate it'll take you to do that?

sents.zh: 我购买一本书花费了三十美元。
sents.p: wǒ gòu mǎi yī běn shū huā fèi le sān shí měi yuán
sents.en: I spent thirty dollars on a book.

sents.zh: 你们什么时候开始营业？
sents.p: nǐ men shén me shí hou kāi shǐ yíng yè
sents.en: What time do you open?

sents.zh: 银行星期六不营业。
sents.p: yín háng xīng qī liù bù yíng yè
sents.en: The bank is not open on Saturdays.

sents.zh: 与其让我在他手下干，我宁愿辞职。
sents.p: yǔ qí ràng wǒ zài tā shǒu xià gàn wǒ nìng yuàn cí zhí
sents.en: I would rather quit than work under him.

units.title: Economy and consumption
units.intro: Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

items.en: anyway; in any case; to come over from the enemy's side
to stick; to paste; to post (e.g. on a blog)

ex.zh: 请不要忘记寄信前要在上面贴邮票。
ex.p: qǐng bù yào wàng jì jì xìn qián yào zài shàng miàn tiē yóu piào
ex.en: Please don't forget to put a stamp on the letter before mailing it.

ex.zh: 别忘了在你的信上贴张邮票。
ex.p: bié wàng le zài nǐ de xìn shǎng tiē zhāng yóu piào
ex.en: Don't forget to put a stamp on your letter.

items.en: as quickly as possible; as soon as possible

ex.zh: 收到此邮件后请尽快给我答复。
ex.p: shōu dào cǐ yóu jiàn hòu qǐng jǐn kuài gěi wǒ dá fù
ex.en: Please send me a reply as soon as you receive this mail.

ex.zh: 我会尽快给你打电话的。
ex.p: wǒ huì jǐn kuài gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de
ex.en: I'll call you as soon as I can.

ex.zh: 将你需要的药物写在这张纸上。
ex.p: jiāng nǐ xū yào de yào wù xiě zài zhè zhāng zhǐ shǎng
ex.en: Write down the medicine you need on this piece of paper.

ex.zh: 药物的作用还不确定。
ex.p: yào wù de zuò yòng hái bù què dìng
ex.en: Whether the medicine will work or not is uncertain.

items.en: to go a step further; (develop, understand, improve etc) more; further

ex.zh: 我能闻到他呼吸中的酒精味。
ex.p: wǒ néng wén dào tā hū xī zhōng de jiǔ jīng wèi
ex.en: I could smell the alcohol on his breath.

ex.zh: 所有人都屏住呼吸关注着谁会赢得总统竞选。
ex.p: suǒ yǒu rén dōu píng zhù hū xī guān zhù zhe shéi huì yíng dé zǒng tǒng jìng xuǎn
ex.en: Everyone held their breath to see who would win the presidential election.

ex.zh: 我知道，我做了很可怕的事。
ex.p: wǒ zhī dào wǒ zuò le hěn kě pà de shì
ex.en: I know I did an awful thing.

ex.zh: 这是一个可怕的错误。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè kě pà de cuò wù
ex.en: This is a terrible mistake.

ex.zh: 出去之前确认一下所有的灯都关了。
ex.p: chū qù zhī qián què rèn yī xià suǒ yǒu de dēng dōu guān le
ex.en: Make sure to turn off all the lights before going out.

items.en: to protect; to defend; to guard against

ex.zh: 消防车到达之前，房子就全烧了。
ex.p: xiāo fáng chē dào dá zhī qián fáng zi jiù quán shāo le
ex.en: The house burned to the ground before the fire truck arrived.

ex.zh: 他们试图冲破敌军防线。
ex.p: tā men shì tú chōng pò dí jūn fáng xiàn
ex.en: They attempted to break through the enemy line.

ex.zh: 舞台上有著名音乐家吗？
ex.p: wǔ tái shǎng yǒu zhù míng yīn yuè jiā ma
ex.en: Are there any famous musicians on the stage?

ex.zh: 他的化学很差。
ex.p: tā de huà xué hěn chà
ex.en: He is poor at chemistry.

ex.zh: 软件正在不断进化。
ex.p: ruǎn jiàn zhèng zài bù duàn jìn huà
ex.en: Software is constantly evolving.

ex.zh: 他不是那么出色的作家我想他知道这一点。
ex.p: tā bù shì nà me chū sè de zuò jiā wǒ xiǎng tā zhī dào zhè yī diǎn
ex.en: He's not such a great writer and I think he knows it.

ex.zh: 他是位出色的作家。
ex.p: tā shì wèi chū sè de zuò jiā
ex.en: He is a good writer.

ex.zh: 如果你不能有孩子，你总能领养。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù néng yǒu hái zi nǐ zǒng néng lǐng yǎng
ex.en: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.

ex.zh: 日本在某些领域赶上了美国。
ex.p: rì běn zài mǒu xiē lǐng yù gǎn shàng le měi guó
ex.en: Japan has caught up with America in some fields.

items.en: to boil; to roll; to take a hike

ex.zh: 滚出我的房子。
ex.p: gǔn chū wǒ de fáng zi
ex.en: Get out of my house.

ex.zh: 她沉迷于摇滚乐。
ex.p: tā chén mí yú yáo gǔn lè
ex.en: She is absorbed in rock music.

items.en: (of a plant) to produce (fruit or seeds)

ex.zh: 我想和一个像她那样的女孩结婚。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng hé yī gè xiàng tā nà yàng de nǚ hái jié hūn
ex.en: I want to marry a girl like her.

ex.zh: 你想我们先结婚还是先生孩子？
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng wǒ men xiān jié hūn hái shi xiān sheng hái zi
ex.en: Do you want to get married first or have a child first?

items.en: a speech; to speak; to talk

ex.zh: 我也有权讲话。
ex.p: wǒ yě yǒu quán jiǎng huà
ex.en: I have the right to speak, too.

ex.zh: 总统在电视上对国民讲话。
ex.p: zǒng tǒng zài diàn shì shǎng duì guó mín jiǎng huà
ex.en: The President spoke to the nation on TV.

ex.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
ex.p: wàn yī yǒu jǐn jí qíng kuàng lián xì wǒ de dài lǐ rén
ex.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.

ex.zh: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。
ex.p: jǐn jí qíng kuàng xià nín kě yǐ lián xì wǒ
ex.en: You can contact me in case of emergency.

items.en: to disseminate; to give publicity to; propaganda

ex.zh: 我们在电视上宣传我们的产品。
ex.p: wǒ men zài diàn shì shǎng xuān chuán wǒ men de chǎn pǐn
ex.en: We advertise our products on TV.

items.en: to knock against; to bump into; to run into

ex.zh: 我差点被卡车撞到。
ex.p: wǒ chà diǎn bèi kǎ chē zhuàng dào
ex.en: I almost got hit by a truck.

ex.zh: 我不怪你撞到他。
ex.p: wǒ bù guài nǐ zhuàng dào tā
ex.en: I don't blame you for hitting him.

ex.zh: 在学校时我学了中文是个优势。
ex.p: zài xué xiào shí wǒ xué le zhōng wén shì gè yōu shì
ex.en: It was an advantage having learned Chinese while I was in school.

items.en: at any time; at all times; at the right time; whenever necessary

ex.zh: 人随时可能死去。
ex.p: rén suí shí kě néng sǐ qù
ex.en: Every man is a potential corpse.

ex.zh: 我随时可以开始。
ex.p: wǒ suí shí kě yǐ kāi shǐ
ex.en: I can start anytime.

items.en: to pay; to expend; to invest (energy or time)

ex.zh: 我们怎样才能将其付出实践？
ex.p: wǒ men zěn yàng cái néng jiāng qí fù chū shí jiàn
ex.en: How can we put it into practice?

ex.zh: 祝你下一次好运。
ex.p: zhù nǐ xià yī cì hǎo yùn
ex.en: Better luck next time.

items.en: to rule; to govern; to manage

ex.zh: 有些人说日本是个男性统治的社会。
ex.p: yǒu xiē rén shuō rì běn shì gè nán xìng tǒng zhì de shè huì
ex.en: Some people say Japan is a male-dominated society.

ex.zh: 我认为你该吃火腿三明治。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi nǐ gāi chī huǒ tuǐ sān míng zhì
ex.en: I think you should eat a ham sandwich.

ex.zh: 我们使用了强大的措施来预防。
ex.p: wǒ men shǐ yòng le qiáng dà de cuò shī lái yù fáng
ex.en: We took strong measures to prevent it.

ex.zh: 我们采取了强有力的预防措施。
ex.p: wǒ men cǎi qǔ le qiáng yǒu lì de yù fáng cuò shī
ex.en: We took strong measures to prevent it.

ex.zh: 他是个富有才能的年轻导演。
ex.p: tā shì gè fù yǒu cái néng de nián qīng dǎo yǎn
ex.en: He's a talented young director.

ex.zh: 如果没有太阳，那所有生物都会死。
ex.p: rú guǒ méi yǒu tài yang nà suǒ yǒu shēng wù dū huì sǐ
ex.en: If there was no sun, all the animals would be dead.

ex.zh: 这博物馆里面没有活的生物。
ex.p: zhè bó wù guǎn lǐ miàn méi yǒu huó de shēng wù
ex.en: There are no live animals in the museum.

ex.zh: 老板对你的工作有很高的评价。
ex.p: lǎo bǎn duì nǐ de gōng zuò yǒu hěn gāo de píng jià
ex.en: The boss has a good opinion of your work.

ex.zh: 我迷路了，能不能请您帮我一下？
ex.p: wǒ mí lù le néng bù néng qǐng nín bāng wǒ yī xià
ex.en: I am lost. Can you help me, please?

ex.zh: 不论去哪，我都会迷路。
ex.p: bù lùn qù nǎ wǒ dū huì mí lù
ex.en: No matter where I go, I get lost.

ex.zh: 令我吃惊的是，他很容易就想出了一个方案。
ex.p: líng wǒ chī jīng de shì tā hěn róng yì jiù xiǎng chū le yī gè fāng àn
ex.en: To my surprise, he easily came up with a plan.

ex.zh: 我们的方案在最后的时刻失败了。
ex.p: wǒ men de fāng àn zài zuì hòu de shí kè shī bài le
ex.en: Our plans fell through at the last minute.

items.en: to owe; to lack; (literary) to be deficient in

ex.zh: 关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。
ex.p: guān yú nà jiàn shì nǐ qiàn wǒ yī gè dào qiàn
ex.en: You owe me an apology for that.

ex.zh: 你欠我一个人情。
ex.p: nǐ qiàn wǒ yī gè rén qíng
ex.en: You owe me a favor.

ex.zh: 你觉得他会对什么主题感兴趣？
ex.p: nǐ jué de tā huì duì shén me zhǔ tí gǎn xìng qù
ex.en: What subject do you think he is interested in?

ex.zh: 那场会议主题是什么？
ex.p: nà cháng huì yì zhǔ tí shì shén me
ex.en: What was that meeting about?

ex.zh: 巴士不总是能准点到达。
ex.p: bā shì bù zǒng shì néng zhǔn diǎn dào dá
ex.en: The bus doesn't always come on time.

ex.zh: 我走之后他到达了。
ex.p: wǒ zǒu zhī hòu tā dào dá le
ex.en: He arrived after I had left.

ex.zh: 在主任不在的时候，办公室由谁来负责？
ex.p: zài zhǔ rèn bù zài de shí hou bàn gōng shì yóu shéi lái fù zé
ex.en: Who is in charge of the office while the boss is away?

items.en: to avert; to prevent; to avoid

ex.zh: 我们应该不惜代价避免战争。
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi bù xī dài jià bì miǎn zhàn zhēng
ex.en: We must avoid war at all cost.

ex.zh: 我宁愿避免这种事。
ex.p: wǒ nìng yuàn bì miǎn zhè zhǒng shì
ex.en: I'd rather avoid it.

items.en: to produce; to manufacture; to give birth to a child

ex.zh: 日本生产很多好相机。
ex.p: rì běn shēng chǎn hěn duō hǎo xiàng jī
ex.en: Japan produces a lot of good cameras.

ex.zh: 生产日期在盖子上。
ex.p: shēng chǎn rì qī zài gài zi shǎng
ex.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.

ex.zh: 这位老师用试验论证了这个想法。
ex.p: zhè wèi lǎo shī yòng shì yàn lùn zhèng le zhè gè xiǎng fǎ
ex.en: The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.

ex.zh: 他买的第一项东西是一个闹钟。
ex.p: tā mǎi de dì yī xiàng dōng xī shì yī gè nào zhōng
ex.en: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.

ex.zh: 他们一直闹笑话。
ex.p: tā men yī zhí nào xiào hua
ex.en: They were always making jokes.

ex.zh: 人类是唯一能够彼此交谈的动物。
ex.p: rén lèi shì wéi yī néng gòu bǐ cǐ jiāo tán de dòng wù
ex.en: Man is the only animal that can talk.

ex.zh: 人类是唯一彼此交谈的动物。
ex.p: rén lèi shì wéi yī bǐ cǐ jiāo tán de dòng wù
ex.en: Man is the only animal that talks.

ex.zh: 我强力推荐它。
ex.p: wǒ qiáng lì tuī jiàn tā
ex.en: I recommend it strongly.

ex.zh: 你推荐我买哪个？
ex.p: nǐ tuī jiàn wǒ mǎi nǎ gè
ex.en: Which one would you recommend I buy?

items.en: to guide; to give directions; to direct

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第78单元

Economy and consumption

Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 请不要忘记寄信前要在上面贴邮票。
sents.p: qǐng bù yào wàng jì jì xìn qián yào zài shàng miàn tiē yóu piào
sents.en: Please don't forget to put a stamp on the letter before mailing it.

sents.zh: 别忘了在你的信上贴张邮票。
sents.p: bié wàng le zài nǐ de xìn shǎng tiē zhāng yóu piào
sents.en: Don't forget to put a stamp on your letter.

sents.zh: 收到此邮件后请尽快给我答复。
sents.p: shōu dào cǐ yóu jiàn hòu qǐng jǐn kuài gěi wǒ dá fù
sents.en: Please send me a reply as soon as you receive this mail.

sents.zh: 我会尽快给你打电话的。
sents.p: wǒ huì jǐn kuài gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de
sents.en: I'll call you as soon as I can.

sents.zh: 将你需要的药物写在这张纸上。
sents.p: jiāng nǐ xū yào de yào wù xiě zài zhè zhāng zhǐ shǎng
sents.en: Write down the medicine you need on this piece of paper.

sents.zh: 药物的作用还不确定。
sents.p: yào wù de zuò yòng hái bù què dìng
sents.en: Whether the medicine will work or not is uncertain.

sents.zh: 我能闻到他呼吸中的酒精味。
sents.p: wǒ néng wén dào tā hū xī zhōng de jiǔ jīng wèi
sents.en: I could smell the alcohol on his breath.

sents.zh: 所有人都屏住呼吸关注着谁会赢得总统竞选。
sents.p: suǒ yǒu rén dōu píng zhù hū xī guān zhù zhe shéi huì yíng dé zǒng tǒng jìng xuǎn
sents.en: Everyone held their breath to see who would win the presidential election.

sents.zh: 我知道，我做了很可怕的事。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào wǒ zuò le hěn kě pà de shì
sents.en: I know I did an awful thing.

sents.zh: 这是一个可怕的错误。
sents.p: zhè shì yī gè kě pà de cuò wù
sents.en: This is a terrible mistake.

sents.zh: 出去之前确认一下所有的灯都关了。
sents.p: chū qù zhī qián què rèn yī xià suǒ yǒu de dēng dōu guān le
sents.en: Make sure to turn off all the lights before going out.

sents.zh: 消防车到达之前，房子就全烧了。
sents.p: xiāo fáng chē dào dá zhī qián fáng zi jiù quán shāo le
sents.en: The house burned to the ground before the fire truck arrived.

sents.zh: 他们试图冲破敌军防线。
sents.p: tā men shì tú chōng pò dí jūn fáng xiàn
sents.en: They attempted to break through the enemy line.

sents.zh: 舞台上有著名音乐家吗？
sents.p: wǔ tái shǎng yǒu zhù míng yīn yuè jiā ma
sents.en: Are there any famous musicians on the stage?

sents.zh: 他的化学很差。
sents.p: tā de huà xué hěn chà
sents.en: He is poor at chemistry.

sents.zh: 软件正在不断进化。
sents.p: ruǎn jiàn zhèng zài bù duàn jìn huà
sents.en: Software is constantly evolving.

sents.zh: 他不是那么出色的作家我想他知道这一点。
sents.p: tā bù shì nà me chū sè de zuò jiā wǒ xiǎng tā zhī dào zhè yī diǎn
sents.en: He's not such a great writer and I think he knows it.

sents.zh: 他是位出色的作家。
sents.p: tā shì wèi chū sè de zuò jiā
sents.en: He is a good writer.

sents.zh: 如果你不能有孩子，你总能领养。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù néng yǒu hái zi nǐ zǒng néng lǐng yǎng
sents.en: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.

sents.zh: 日本在某些领域赶上了美国。
sents.p: rì běn zài mǒu xiē lǐng yù gǎn shàng le měi guó
sents.en: Japan has caught up with America in some fields.

sents.zh: 滚出我的房子。
sents.p: gǔn chū wǒ de fáng zi
sents.en: Get out of my house.

sents.zh: 她沉迷于摇滚乐。
sents.p: tā chén mí yú yáo gǔn lè
sents.en: She is absorbed in rock music.

sents.zh: 我想和一个像她那样的女孩结婚。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng hé yī gè xiàng tā nà yàng de nǚ hái jié hūn
sents.en: I want to marry a girl like her.

sents.zh: 你想我们先结婚还是先生孩子？
sents.p: nǐ xiǎng wǒ men xiān jié hūn hái shi xiān sheng hái zi
sents.en: Do you want to get married first or have a child first?

sents.zh: 我也有权讲话。
sents.p: wǒ yě yǒu quán jiǎng huà
sents.en: I have the right to speak, too.

sents.zh: 总统在电视上对国民讲话。
sents.p: zǒng tǒng zài diàn shì shǎng duì guó mín jiǎng huà
sents.en: The President spoke to the nation on TV.

sents.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
sents.p: wàn yī yǒu jǐn jí qíng kuàng lián xì wǒ de dài lǐ rén
sents.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.

sents.zh: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。
sents.p: jǐn jí qíng kuàng xià nín kě yǐ lián xì wǒ
sents.en: You can contact me in case of emergency.

sents.zh: 我们在电视上宣传我们的产品。
sents.p: wǒ men zài diàn shì shǎng xuān chuán wǒ men de chǎn pǐn
sents.en: We advertise our products on TV.

sents.zh: 我差点被卡车撞到。
sents.p: wǒ chà diǎn bèi kǎ chē zhuàng dào
sents.en: I almost got hit by a truck.

sents.zh: 我不怪你撞到他。
sents.p: wǒ bù guài nǐ zhuàng dào tā
sents.en: I don't blame you for hitting him.

sents.zh: 在学校时我学了中文是个优势。
sents.p: zài xué xiào shí wǒ xué le zhōng wén shì gè yōu shì
sents.en: It was an advantage having learned Chinese while I was in school.

sents.zh: 人随时可能死去。
sents.p: rén suí shí kě néng sǐ qù
sents.en: Every man is a potential corpse.

sents.zh: 我随时可以开始。
sents.p: wǒ suí shí kě yǐ kāi shǐ
sents.en: I can start anytime.

sents.zh: 我们怎样才能将其付出实践？
sents.p: wǒ men zěn yàng cái néng jiāng qí fù chū shí jiàn
sents.en: How can we put it into practice?

sents.zh: 祝你下一次好运。
sents.p: zhù nǐ xià yī cì hǎo yùn
sents.en: Better luck next time.

sents.zh: 有些人说日本是个男性统治的社会。
sents.p: yǒu xiē rén shuō rì běn shì gè nán xìng tǒng zhì de shè huì
sents.en: Some people say Japan is a male-dominated society.

sents.zh: 我认为你该吃火腿三明治。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi nǐ gāi chī huǒ tuǐ sān míng zhì
sents.en: I think you should eat a ham sandwich.

sents.zh: 我们使用了强大的措施来预防。
sents.p: wǒ men shǐ yòng le qiáng dà de cuò shī lái yù fáng
sents.en: We took strong measures to prevent it.

sents.zh: 我们采取了强有力的预防措施。
sents.p: wǒ men cǎi qǔ le qiáng yǒu lì de yù fáng cuò shī
sents.en: We took strong measures to prevent it.

sents.zh: 他是个富有才能的年轻导演。
sents.p: tā shì gè fù yǒu cái néng de nián qīng dǎo yǎn
sents.en: He's a talented young director.

sents.zh: 如果没有太阳，那所有生物都会死。
sents.p: rú guǒ méi yǒu tài yang nà suǒ yǒu shēng wù dū huì sǐ
sents.en: If there was no sun, all the animals would be dead.

sents.zh: 这博物馆里面没有活的生物。
sents.p: zhè bó wù guǎn lǐ miàn méi yǒu huó de shēng wù
sents.en: There are no live animals in the museum.

sents.zh: 老板对你的工作有很高的评价。
sents.p: lǎo bǎn duì nǐ de gōng zuò yǒu hěn gāo de píng jià
sents.en: The boss has a good opinion of your work.

sents.zh: 我迷路了，能不能请您帮我一下？
sents.p: wǒ mí lù le néng bù néng qǐng nín bāng wǒ yī xià
sents.en: I am lost. Can you help me, please?

sents.zh: 不论去哪，我都会迷路。
sents.p: bù lùn qù nǎ wǒ dū huì mí lù
sents.en: No matter where I go, I get lost.

sents.zh: 令我吃惊的是，他很容易就想出了一个方案。
sents.p: líng wǒ chī jīng de shì tā hěn róng yì jiù xiǎng chū le yī gè fāng àn
sents.en: To my surprise, he easily came up with a plan.

sents.zh: 我们的方案在最后的时刻失败了。
sents.p: wǒ men de fāng àn zài zuì hòu de shí kè shī bài le
sents.en: Our plans fell through at the last minute.

sents.zh: 关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。
sents.p: guān yú nà jiàn shì nǐ qiàn wǒ yī gè dào qiàn
sents.en: You owe me an apology for that.

sents.zh: 你欠我一个人情。
sents.p: nǐ qiàn wǒ yī gè rén qíng
sents.en: You owe me a favor.

sents.zh: 你觉得他会对什么主题感兴趣？
sents.p: nǐ jué de tā huì duì shén me zhǔ tí gǎn xìng qù
sents.en: What subject do you think he is interested in?

sents.zh: 那场会议主题是什么？
sents.p: nà cháng huì yì zhǔ tí shì shén me
sents.en: What was that meeting about?

sents.zh: 巴士不总是能准点到达。
sents.p: bā shì bù zǒng shì néng zhǔn diǎn dào dá
sents.en: The bus doesn't always come on time.

sents.zh: 我走之后他到达了。
sents.p: wǒ zǒu zhī hòu tā dào dá le
sents.en: He arrived after I had left.

sents.zh: 在主任不在的时候，办公室由谁来负责？
sents.p: zài zhǔ rèn bù zài de shí hou bàn gōng shì yóu shéi lái fù zé
sents.en: Who is in charge of the office while the boss is away?

sents.zh: 我们应该不惜代价避免战争。
sents.p: wǒ men yīng gāi bù xī dài jià bì miǎn zhàn zhēng
sents.en: We must avoid war at all cost.

sents.zh: 我宁愿避免这种事。
sents.p: wǒ nìng yuàn bì miǎn zhè zhǒng shì
sents.en: I'd rather avoid it.

sents.zh: 日本生产很多好相机。
sents.p: rì běn shēng chǎn hěn duō hǎo xiàng jī
sents.en: Japan produces a lot of good cameras.

sents.zh: 生产日期在盖子上。
sents.p: shēng chǎn rì qī zài gài zi shǎng
sents.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.

sents.zh: 这位老师用试验论证了这个想法。
sents.p: zhè wèi lǎo shī yòng shì yàn lùn zhèng le zhè gè xiǎng fǎ
sents.en: The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.

sents.zh: 他买的第一项东西是一个闹钟。
sents.p: tā mǎi de dì yī xiàng dōng xī shì yī gè nào zhōng
sents.en: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.

sents.zh: 他们一直闹笑话。
sents.p: tā men yī zhí nào xiào hua
sents.en: They were always making jokes.

sents.zh: 人类是唯一能够彼此交谈的动物。
sents.p: rén lèi shì wéi yī néng gòu bǐ cǐ jiāo tán de dòng wù
sents.en: Man is the only animal that can talk.

sents.zh: 人类是唯一彼此交谈的动物。
sents.p: rén lèi shì wéi yī bǐ cǐ jiāo tán de dòng wù
sents.en: Man is the only animal that talks.

sents.zh: 我强力推荐它。
sents.p: wǒ qiáng lì tuī jiàn tā
sents.en: I recommend it strongly.

sents.zh: 你推荐我买哪个？
sents.p: nǐ tuī jiàn wǒ mǎi nǎ gè
sents.en: Which one would you recommend I buy?

units.title: Economy and consumption
units.intro: Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

ex.zh: 生产日期在盖子上。
ex.p: shēng chǎn rì qī zài gài zi shǎng
ex.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.

ex.zh: 不是所有国家都加入了联合国。
ex.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu guó jiā dōu jiā rù le lián hé guó
ex.en: Not every country belongs to the U.N.

items.en: to sauté; to stir-fry; to speculate

ex.zh: 你们不能炒了我们。
ex.p: nǐ men bù néng chǎo le wǒ men
ex.en: You can't fire us.

ex.zh: 你不能炒了我们。
ex.p: nǐ bù néng chǎo le wǒ men
ex.en: You can't fire us.

ex.zh: 我的录像机可以拍高清视频。
ex.p: wǒ de lù xiàng jī kě yǐ pāi gāo qīng shì pín
ex.en: My camera can shoot high-definition video.

ex.zh: 我很高兴我们录用了你来担任这份工作。
ex.p: wǒ hěn gāo xìng wǒ men lù yòng le nǐ lái dān rèn zhè fèn gōng zuò
ex.en: I'm glad we hired you for this job.

ex.zh: 她用一个微笑迎接了我。
ex.p: tā yòng yī gè wēi xiào yíng jiē le wǒ
ex.en: She greeted me with a smile.

ex.zh: 她已经不向我微笑了。
ex.p: tā yǐ jīng bù xiàng wǒ wēi xiào le
ex.en: She doesn't smile for me anymore.

items.en: to assemble; to combine; to compose

ex.zh: 她持有与我不同的观点。
ex.p: tā chí yǒu yú wǒ bù tóng de guān diǎn
ex.en: She has a view that is different from mine.

ex.zh: 我不期望，他们能够支持我的观点。
ex.p: wǒ bù qī wàng tā men néng gòu zhī chí wǒ de guān diǎn
ex.en: I don't expect that they will support my view.

items.en: nice surprise; to be pleasantly surprised

ex.zh: 为什么任何人应该感到惊喜？
ex.p: wèi shén me rèn hé rén yīng gāi gǎn dào jīng xǐ
ex.en: Why should anyone be surprised?

ex.zh: 这是一个惊喜。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè jīng xǐ
ex.en: It's a surprise.

ex.zh: 这朵花散发出强烈的香味。
ex.p: zhè duǒ huā sàn fā chū qiáng liè de xiāng wèi
ex.en: This flower gives off a strong fragrance.

items.en: to fight for; to strive for; to win over

ex.zh: 你认为那公平吗？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi nà gōng píng ma
ex.en: Do you think that was fair?

ex.zh: 那是不公平的。
ex.p: nà shì bù gōng píng de
ex.en: That's not fair.

ex.zh: “洞里发生了什么？我很好奇。”“我一点也不知道。”
ex.p: dòng lǐ fā shēng le shén me wǒ hěn hào qí wǒ yī diǎn yě bù zhī dào
ex.en: "What's going on in the cave? I'm curious." "I have no idea."

ex.zh: 你的袜子破了一个洞呀。
ex.p: nǐ de wà zi pò le yī gè dòng ya
ex.en: There is a hole in your sock.

ex.zh: 我今天早晨感觉良好。
ex.p: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo chén gǎn jué liáng hǎo
ex.en: I'm feeling good this morning.

ex.zh: 我今晚感觉良好。
ex.p: wǒ jīn wǎn gǎn jué liáng hǎo
ex.en: I felt good tonight.

items.en: to reflect on; to ponder over

ex.zh: 真正的科学家不会这样去思考。
ex.p: zhēn zhèng de kē xué jiā bù huì zhè yàng qù sī kǎo
ex.en: A true scientist would not approach the question this way.

ex.zh: 他正在思考他未来的生活。
ex.p: tā zhèng zài sī kǎo tā wèi lái de shēng huó
ex.en: He was meditating on his future life.

ex.zh: 来抽签决定谁先走吧。
ex.p: lái chōu qiān jué dìng shéi xiān zǒu ba
ex.en: Let's draw lots to decide who goes first.

ex.zh: 我今天签了租约。
ex.p: wǒ jīn tiān qiān le zū yāo
ex.en: I signed the lease today.

ex.zh: 自从他离开去法国，已经有两个月了。
ex.p: zì cóng tā lí kāi qù fǎ guó yǐ jīng yǒu liǎng gè yuè le
ex.en: Two months have passed since he left for France.

ex.zh: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。
ex.p: zì cóng shǒu shù hòu wǒ fù qīn yī zhí chǔ yú liáng hǎo de zhuàng tài
ex.en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.

ex.zh: 无论我多么努力尝试，我都无法做到比她更好。
ex.p: wú lùn wǒ duō me nǔ lì cháng shì wǒ dōu wú fǎ zuò dào bǐ tā gēng hǎo
ex.en: However hard I try, I can't do it any better than she can.

ex.zh: 她总是尝试新事物。
ex.p: tā zǒng shì cháng shì xīn shì wù
ex.en: She is always trying new things.

ex.zh: 她该接受她的命运。
ex.p: tā gāi jiē shòu tā de mìng yùn
ex.en: She had to accept her fate.

ex.zh: 数千人受此疾病所害。
ex.p: shù qiān rén shòu cǐ jí bìng suǒ hài
ex.en: Several thousand people became victims of this disease.

ex.zh: 没有药物能够治疗这种疾病。
ex.p: méi yǒu yào wù néng gòu zhì liáo zhè zhǒng jí bìng
ex.en: No medicine can cure this disease.

ex.zh: 她上女子高中。
ex.p: tā shǎng nǚ zǐ gāo zhōng
ex.en: She goes to a girls' high school.

units.intro: Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

ex.zh: 在我看来，他是有道理的。
ex.p: zài wǒ kàn lai tā shì yǒu dào li de
ex.en: In my opinion, he is correct.

ex.zh: 也许您有道理。
ex.p: yě xǔ nín yǒu dào li
ex.en: Maybe you're right.

ex.zh: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。
ex.p: zhè jī nián duì zuò yè liáo fǎ de xū qiú zài xùn sù zēng zhǎng
ex.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.

ex.zh: 谢谢您的迅速回复。
ex.p: xiè xie nín de xùn sù huí fù
ex.en: Thanks for your quick answer.

ex.zh: 你说得你好像什么都知道似的。
ex.p: nǐ shuō de nǐ hǎo xiàng shén me dōu zhī dào shì de
ex.en: You talk as if you knew everything.

ex.zh: 死了就像做梦似的。
ex.p: sǐ le jiù xiàng zuò mèng shì de
ex.en: Death is like dreaming.

ex.zh: 我必须去睡觉了！我明天早上有课。
ex.p: wǒ bì xū qù shuì jiào le wǒ míng tiān zǎo shang yǒu kè
ex.en: I have to get to sleep! I've got classes tomorrow.

ex.zh: 你必须在到期前完成这项工作。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū zài dào qī qián wán chéng zhè xiàng gōng zuò
ex.en: You must get the job done before the deadline.

ex.zh: 许多男生和女生都出席了。
ex.p: xǔ duō nán shēng hé nǚ shēng dōu chū xí le
ex.en: Many boys and girls were present.

ex.zh: 全班同学每周出席一次。
ex.p: quán bān tóng xué měi zhōu chū xí yī cì
ex.en: The whole class is present once a week.

ex.zh: 你说的话给我留下了很深刻的印象。
ex.p: nǐ shuō de huà gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn kè de yìn xiàng
ex.en: What you said left a deep impression on me.

ex.zh: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。
ex.p: yǎn jiǎng zhě jīng cǎi de yǎn shuō gěi wǒ men liú xià le shēn kè de yìn xiàng

sents.p: zhè shì wǒ suǒ jiàn guò de zuì dà xíng de gòu zào le
sents.en: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.

sents.zh: 我对人造语言不是很感兴趣。
sents.p: wǒ duì rén zào yǔ yán bù shì hěn gǎn xìng qù
sents.en: I'm not very interested in artificial languages.

sents.zh: 您可以再重复一遍刚才说的话吗？
sents.p: nín kě yǐ zài chóng fù yī biàn gāng cái shuō de huà ma
sents.en: Could you please repeat what you just said?

sents.zh: 能不能请你重复一下？
sents.p: néng bù néng qǐng nǐ chóng fù yī xià
sents.en: Can you repeat that, please?

sents.zh: 她有很强的个性。
sents.p: tā yǒu hěn qiáng de gè xìng
sents.en: She has a strong personality.

sents.zh: 你能把我的名字加到等候批准的申请人名单上吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng bǎ wǒ de míng zi jiā dào děng hòu pī zhǔn de shēn qǐng rén míng dān shǎng ma
sents.en: Could you put my name on the waiting list?

sents.zh: 我不确定该前进还是后退。
sents.p: wǒ bù què dìng gāi qián jìn hái shi hòu tuì
sents.en: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.

sents.zh: 我准备再前进一点。
sents.p: wǒ zhǔn bèi zài qián jìn yī diǎn
sents.en: I've decided to go a little further.

sents.zh: 他和许多其他人一样问了我同样的问题。
sents.p: tā hé xǔ duō qí tā rén yī yàng wèn le wǒ tóng yàng de wèn tí
sents.en: He asked me questions similar to those asked by many others.

sents.zh: 我有问题，就像其他人一样。
sents.p: wǒ yǒu wèn tí jiù xiàng qí tā rén yī yàng
sents.en: I have problems, just like everybody else.

sents.zh: 他甚至骂我傻瓜。
sents.p: tā shèn zhì mà wǒ shǎ guā
sents.en: He even called me an idiot.

sents.zh: 我怎么可能是机器人呢？机器人不会做梦。
sents.p: wǒ zěn me kě néng shì jī qì rén ne jī qì rén bù huì zuò mèng
sents.en: How could I be a robot? Robots can't dream.

sents.zh: 我认为这机器需要修理。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi zhè jī qì xū yào xiū lǐ
sents.en: I think this machine is in need of repair.

sents.zh: 她永远也做不到保守秘密。
sents.p: tā yǒng yuǎn yě zuò bù dào bǎo shǒu mì mì
sents.en: She can never keep a secret.

sents.zh: 总体上说，日本人很保守。
sents.p: zǒng tǐ shǎng shuō rì běn rén hěn bǎo shǒu
sents.en: On the whole, the Japanese are conservative.

sents.zh: 冬天有很多老人在冰上滑倒。
sents.p: dōng tiān yǒu hěn duō lǎo rén zài bīng shǎng huá dào
sents.en: In the winter, many older people slip on ice and fall down.

sents.zh: 他每年冬天在北海道滑雪。
sents.p: tā měi nián dōng tiān zài běi hǎi dào huá xuě
sents.en: He skis in Hokkaido every winter.

sents.zh: 他能为你暗箱操作。
sents.p: tā néng wèi nǐ àn xiāng cāo zuò
sents.en: He can pull strings for you.

sents.zh: 你最喜欢的操作系统是哪个？
sents.p: nǐ zuì xǐ huan de cāo zuò xì tǒng shì nǎ gè
sents.en: What's your favorite operating system?

sents.zh: 我下定决心要在三年之内达成目标。
sents.p: wǒ xià dìng jué xīn yào zài sān nián zhī nèi dá chéng mù biāo
sents.en: I have made up my mind to achieve my goals in three years.

sents.zh: 我们要达成一些协定。
sents.p: wǒ men yào dá chéng yī xiē xié dìng
sents.en: We have to come to some agreement.

sents.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。
sents.p: zì wǒ huái yí shì cōng ming de dì yī biāo zhì
sents.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.

sents.zh: 一个是日本人，另一个是意大利人。
sents.p: yī gè shì rì běn rén lìng yī gè shì yì dà lì rén
sents.en: One is Japanese and the other is Italian.

sents.zh: 几乎所有的日本人头发都是黑色的。
sents.p: jī hū suǒ yǒu de rì běn rén tóu fa dōu shì hēi sè de
sents.en: Nearly all Japanese have dark hair.

sents.zh: 只有个别人才懂了我的意思。
sents.p: zhǐ yǒu gè bié rén cái dǒng le wǒ de yì si
sents.en: Only a few people understood me.

sents.zh: 这家里应该没有男人才对。
sents.p: zhè jiā lǐ yīng gāi méi yǒu nán rén cái duì
sents.en: There aren't supposed to be any men in this house.

sents.zh: 她是个有有魅力的女性。
sents.p: tā shì gè yǒu yǒu mèi lì de nǚ xìng
sents.en: She is a charming woman.

sents.zh: 你低估了你的魅力。
sents.p: nǐ dī gū le nǐ de mèi lì
sents.en: You underestimate your charisma.

sents.zh: 桌子上有一本关于舞蹈的书。
sents.p: zhuō zi shǎng yǒu yī běn guān yú wǔ dǎo de shū
sents.en: There's a book about dancing on the desk.

sents.zh: 我恐怕不是个很好的伙伴。
sents.p: wǒ kǒng pà bù shì gè hěn hǎo de huǒ bàn
sents.en: I'm afraid I wouldn't be very good company.

sents.zh: 你想要伙伴吗？
sents.p: nǐ xiǎng yào huǒ bàn ma
sents.en: Do you want some company?

sents.zh: 你能容忍他做事的方式么？
sents.p: nǐ néng róng rěn tā zuò shì de fāng shì me
sents.en: Can you put up with the way he behaves?

sents.zh: 我无法忍受她傲慢的态度。
sents.p: wǒ wú fǎ rěn shòu tā ào màn de tài du
sents.en: I couldn't put up with her arrogant behavior.

sents.zh: 双方本周举行会谈。
sents.p: shuāng fāng běn zhōu jǔ xíng huì tán
sents.en: The two sides hold talks this week.

sents.zh: 他在口袋里摸着找他的钱包。
sents.p: tā zài kǒu dài lǐ mō zhe zhǎo tā de qián bāo
sents.en: He felt in his pocket for his wallet.

sents.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
sents.p: wèi le cān jiā huá chuán bǐ sài yī zhī xīn de duì wǔ zǔ chéng le
sents.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.

units.title: Economy and consumption
units.intro: Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

ex.zh: 结婚是所有离婚的主要原因。
ex.p: jié hūn shì suǒ yǒu lí hūn de zhǔ yào yuán yīn
ex.en: Marriage is the main cause of all divorces.

ex.zh: 她告诉他说，她想要离婚。
ex.p: tā gào sù tā shuō tā xiǎng yào lí hūn
ex.en: She told him she wanted a divorce.

items.en: to withdraw; to abort; to quit

ex.zh: 我不该退出的。
ex.p: wǒ bù gāi tuì chū de
ex.en: I shouldn't have logged off.

ex.zh: 我把它忘在车库里了。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ tā wàng zài chē kù lǐ le
ex.en: I forgot it in the garage.

ex.zh: 我们现在缺乏库存。
ex.p: wǒ men xiàn zài quē fá kù cún
ex.en: We're out of stock now.

items.en: to quarrel; to make a noise; noisy

ex.zh: 他们争吵后，一周都没有再说话。
ex.p: tā men zhēng chǎo hòu yī zhōu dōu méi yǒu zài shuō huà
ex.en: After they argued, they didn't speak to each other for a week.

ex.zh: 他们总是为了小事吵架。
ex.p: tā men zǒng shì wèi le xiǎo shì chǎo jià
ex.en: They always fight over little things.

ex.zh: 他有权得到奖励。
ex.p: tā yǒu quán dé dào jiǎng lì
ex.en: He is entitled to receive the reward.

items.en: to bear; to support; to inherit

ex.zh: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
ex.p: hú shǎng de bīng tài bó le chéng shòu bù liǎo nǐ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.

ex.zh: 这冰太薄不能承受你的重量。
ex.p: zhè bīng tài bó bù néng chéng shòu nǐ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.

items.en: (name of states and dynasties at several different periods)

ex.zh: 这套房子设施便利齐全。
ex.p: zhè tào fáng zi shè shī biàn lì qí quán
ex.en: The house has all the conveniences.

ex.zh: 她把头发拍整齐了。
ex.p: tā bǎ tóu fa pāi zhěng qí le
ex.en: She patted her hair into place.

ex.zh: 日本的人口密度很高。
ex.p: rì běn de rén kǒu mì dù hěn gāo
ex.en: Japan has a high population density.

ex.zh: 日本的人口比英国多。
ex.p: rì běn de rén kǒu bǐ yīng guó duō
ex.en: The population of Japan is larger than that of Britain.

items.en: to consult; to seek advice; consultation

ex.zh: 美貌只是表面性的东西。
ex.p: měi mào zhǐ shì biǎo miàn xìng de dōng xī
ex.en: Beauty is but skin deep.

ex.zh: 重力将一切带下地球表面。
ex.p: zhòng lì jiāng yī qiè dài xià dì qiú biǎo miàn
ex.en: Gravity brings everything down to Earth.

items.en: to obey; to follow; to arrange

ex.zh: 一切都很顺利。
ex.p: yī qiè dōu hěn shùn lì
ex.en: Everything went well.

ex.zh: 祝您一路顺风。
ex.p: zhù nín yī lù shùn fēng
ex.en: I hope you have a good trip.

items.en: to scale (a height); to ascend; to mount

ex.zh: 我一直想登富士山。
ex.p: wǒ yī zhí xiǎng dēng fù shì shān
ex.en: I've always wanted to climb Mt. Fuji.

ex.zh: 明天，他将登上月球。
ex.p: míng tiān tā jiāng dēng shǎng yuè qiú
ex.en: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.

ex.zh: 不幸的是，她不在。
ex.p: bù xìng de shì tā bù zài
ex.en: Unfortunately, she is absent.

ex.zh: 她看起来不幸福。
ex.p: tā kàn qǐ lai bù xìng fú
ex.en: She looks unhappy.

items.en: to lead; to be in front
to rise; to go up; to ascend

ex.zh: 酒的消费每年都在上升。
ex.p: jiǔ de xiāo fèi měi nián dōu zài shàng shēng
ex.en: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.

ex.zh: 河的水位上升了。
ex.p: hé de shuǐ wèi shàng shēng le
ex.en: The river's water level has risen.

ex.zh: 他住在公园周围的某个地方。
ex.p: tā zhù zài gōng yuán zhōu wéi de mǒu gè dì fāng
ex.en: He lives somewhere around the park.

ex.zh: 我被小孩围着非常不舒服。
ex.p: wǒ bèi xiǎo hái wéi zhe fēi cháng bù shū fu
ex.en: I'm very uncomfortable around children.

items.en: itinerary; route; political line (e.g. right revisionist road)

ex.zh: 我碰到一个对能剧感兴趣的美国人。
ex.p: wǒ pèng dào yī gè duì néng jù gǎn xìng qù de měi guó rén
ex.en: I met an American who was interested in Noh plays.

ex.zh: 我都没想过会在这里碰见你。
ex.p: wǒ dōu méi xiǎng guò huì zài zhè lǐ pèng jiàn nǐ
ex.en: I didn't expect to see you at a place like this.

ex.zh: 她为我们煮了一顿美味的晚餐。
ex.p: tā wèi wǒ men zhǔ le yī dùn měi wèi de wǎn cān
ex.en: She cooked us a delicious dinner.

ex.zh: 我给我们煮了些咖啡。
ex.p: wǒ gěi wǒ men zhǔ le xiē kā fēi
ex.en: I've made us some coffee.

items.en: to care about; equivalent of 在于

ex.zh: 她不在乎她的穿著。
ex.p: tā bù zài hu tā de chuān zhù
ex.en: She doesn't care how she dresses.

ex.zh: 我不在乎是否下雪。
ex.p: wǒ bù zài hu shì fǒu xià xuě
ex.en: I don't care if it snows.

items.en: (of planes etc) to fly; flying; flight

ex.zh: 我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。
ex.p: wǒ de mèng xiǎng shì chéng wéi yī míng fēi xíng yuán
ex.en: My dream is to become a pilot.

items.en: to compare; to dispute; compared to

ex.zh: 如果你不计较太多，生活会更容易些。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù jì jiào tài duō shēng huó huì gēng róng yì xiē
ex.en: Life would be so much better if you didn't care so much.

ex.zh: 我认为采用他的计划对我们比较好。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi cǎi yòng tā de jì huà duì wǒ men bǐ jiào hǎo
ex.en: I think it's better for us to adopt his plan.

ex.zh: 因为我付不了租金，我就向他请求帮助。
ex.p: yīn wèi wǒ fù bù liǎo zū jīn wǒ jiù xiàng tā qǐng qiú bāng zhù
ex.en: Since I couldn't pay the rent, I asked him for help.

items.en: to commemorate; to honor the memory of; memento; keepsake; souvenir

ex.zh: 你觉得她最想要什么纪念品？
ex.p: nǐ jué de tā zuì xiǎng yào shén me jì niàn pǐn
ex.en: What souvenir do you think she would like most?

ex.zh: 这将是我环绕美国旅行中一个很好的纪念品。
ex.p: zhè jiāng shì wǒ huán rào měi guó lǚ xíng zhōng yī gè hěn hǎo de jì niàn pǐn
ex.en: This will be a good souvenir of my trip around the United States.

ex.zh: 如果她和你结婚了，她现在会很幸福。
ex.p: rú guǒ tā hé nǐ jié hūn le tā xiàn zài huì hěn xìng fú
ex.en: If she had married you, she would be happy now.

ex.zh: 不言自明，金钱买不到幸福。
ex.p: bù yán zì míng jīn qián mǎi bù dào xìng fú
ex.en: It goes without saying that money can't buy happiness.

ex.zh: 日本上班族工作得非常辛苦。
ex.p: rì běn shàng bān zú gōng zuò de fēi cháng xīn kǔ
ex.en: Japanese office workers work very hard.

ex.zh: 不要插手我的私生活。
ex.p: bù yào chā shǒu wǒ de sī shēng huó
ex.en: Don't pry into my private life.

ex.zh: 这本书有精美的插图。
ex.p: zhè běn shū yǒu jīng měi de chā tú
ex.en: This book is beautifully illustrated.

items.en: to part; to leave each other

ex.zh: 我们的数学老师在黑板上画了一个圆。
ex.p: wǒ men de shù xué lǎo shī zài hēi bǎn shǎng huà le yī gè yuán
ex.en: Our math teacher drew a circle on the blackboard.

ex.zh: 我们买了张圆桌。
ex.p: wǒ men mǎi le zhāng yuán zhuō
ex.en: We bought a round table.

ex.zh: 你的袜子好臭。
ex.p: nǐ de wà zi hǎo chòu
ex.en: Your socks stink.

ex.zh: 你身上发臭了。
ex.p: nǐ shēn shang fā chòu le
ex.en: You stink.

items.en: long term; long time; long range (of a forecast)

ex.zh: 他的每首歌都长期备受欢迎。
ex.p: tā de měi shǒu gē dōu cháng qī bèi shòu huān yíng
ex.en: Every one of his songs was a hit.

ex.zh: 她的每首歌都长期备受欢迎。
ex.p: tā de měi shǒu gē dōu cháng qī bèi shòu huān yíng
ex.en: Every one of her songs was a hit.

ex.zh: 我可以借你的灰色西装吗？
ex.p: wǒ kě yǐ jiè nǐ de huī sè xī zhuāng ma
ex.en: Could I borrow your gray suit?

ex.zh: 他会让你吃灰的。
ex.p: tā huì ràng nǐ chī huī de
ex.en: He will make you eat dirt.

items.en: to pile up; to heap up; a mass
to keep; to retain; to have reservations (about sth)

ex.zh: 请保留我的位置
ex.p: qǐng bǎo liú wǒ de wèi zhi
ex.en: Please save my place.

items.en: article; commodity; product; goods; grade; rank; kind; type; variety

ex.zh: 谁买这种艺术品？
ex.p: shéi mǎi zhè zhǒng yì shù pǐn
ex.en: Who buys this type of art?

ex.zh: 啤酒论品脱卖。
ex.p: pí jiǔ lùn pǐn tuō mài
ex.en: Beer is sold by the pint.
