lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第82单元

Economy and consumption

Grammar focus: 与其…不如; 宁可…也不

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 结婚是所有离婚的主要原因。
sents.p: jié hūn shì suǒ yǒu lí hūn de zhǔ yào yuán yīn
sents.en: Marriage is the main cause of all divorces.

sents.zh: 她告诉他说，她想要离婚。
sents.p: tā gào sù tā shuō tā xiǎng yào lí hūn
sents.en: She told him she wanted a divorce.

sents.zh: 我不该退出的。
sents.p: wǒ bù gāi tuì chū de
sents.en: I shouldn't have logged off.

sents.zh: 我把它忘在车库里了。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ tā wàng zài chē kù lǐ le
sents.en: I forgot it in the garage.

sents.zh: 我们现在缺乏库存。
sents.p: wǒ men xiàn zài quē fá kù cún
sents.en: We're out of stock now.

sents.zh: 他们争吵后，一周都没有再说话。
sents.p: tā men zhēng chǎo hòu yī zhōu dōu méi yǒu zài shuō huà
sents.en: After they argued, they didn't speak to each other for a week.

sents.zh: 他们总是为了小事吵架。
sents.p: tā men zǒng shì wèi le xiǎo shì chǎo jià
sents.en: They always fight over little things.

sents.zh: 他有权得到奖励。
sents.p: tā yǒu quán dé dào jiǎng lì
sents.en: He is entitled to receive the reward.

sents.zh: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
sents.p: hú shǎng de bīng tài bó le chéng shòu bù liǎo nǐ de zhòng liàng
sents.en: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.

sents.zh: 这冰太薄不能承受你的重量。
sents.p: zhè bīng tài bó bù néng chéng shòu nǐ de zhòng liàng
sents.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.

sents.zh: 这套房子设施便利齐全。
sents.p: zhè tào fáng zi shè shī biàn lì qí quán
sents.en: The house has all the conveniences.

sents.zh: 她把头发拍整齐了。
sents.p: tā bǎ tóu fa pāi zhěng qí le
sents.en: She patted her hair into place.

sents.zh: 日本的人口密度很高。
sents.p: rì běn de rén kǒu mì dù hěn gāo
sents.en: Japan has a high population density.

sents.zh: 日本的人口比英国多。
sents.p: rì běn de rén kǒu bǐ yīng guó duō
sents.en: The population of Japan is larger than that of Britain.

sents.zh: 美貌只是表面性的东西。
sents.p: měi mào zhǐ shì biǎo miàn xìng de dōng xī
sents.en: Beauty is but skin deep.

sents.zh: 重力将一切带下地球表面。
sents.p: zhòng lì jiāng yī qiè dài xià dì qiú biǎo miàn
sents.en: Gravity brings everything down to Earth.

sents.zh: 一切都很顺利。
sents.p: yī qiè dōu hěn shùn lì
sents.en: Everything went well.

sents.zh: 祝您一路顺风。
sents.p: zhù nín yī lù shùn fēng
sents.en: I hope you have a good trip.

sents.zh: 我一直想登富士山。
sents.p: wǒ yī zhí xiǎng dēng fù shì shān
sents.en: I've always wanted to climb Mt. Fuji.

sents.zh: 明天，他将登上月球。
sents.p: míng tiān tā jiāng dēng shǎng yuè qiú
sents.en: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.

sents.zh: 不幸的是，她不在。
sents.p: bù xìng de shì tā bù zài
sents.en: Unfortunately, she is absent.

sents.zh: 她看起来不幸福。
sents.p: tā kàn qǐ lai bù xìng fú
sents.en: She looks unhappy.

sents.zh: 酒的消费每年都在上升。
sents.p: jiǔ de xiāo fèi měi nián dōu zài shàng shēng
sents.en: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.

sents.zh: 河的水位上升了。
sents.p: hé de shuǐ wèi shàng shēng le
sents.en: The river's water level has risen.

sents.zh: 他住在公园周围的某个地方。
sents.p: tā zhù zài gōng yuán zhōu wéi de mǒu gè dì fāng
sents.en: He lives somewhere around the park.

sents.zh: 我被小孩围着非常不舒服。
sents.p: wǒ bèi xiǎo hái wéi zhe fēi cháng bù shū fu
sents.en: I'm very uncomfortable around children.

sents.zh: 我碰到一个对能剧感兴趣的美国人。
sents.p: wǒ pèng dào yī gè duì néng jù gǎn xìng qù de měi guó rén
sents.en: I met an American who was interested in Noh plays.

sents.zh: 我都没想过会在这里碰见你。
sents.p: wǒ dōu méi xiǎng guò huì zài zhè lǐ pèng jiàn nǐ
sents.en: I didn't expect to see you at a place like this.

sents.zh: 她为我们煮了一顿美味的晚餐。
sents.p: tā wèi wǒ men zhǔ le yī dùn měi wèi de wǎn cān
sents.en: She cooked us a delicious dinner.

sents.zh: 我给我们煮了些咖啡。
sents.p: wǒ gěi wǒ men zhǔ le xiē kā fēi
sents.en: I've made us some coffee.

sents.zh: 她不在乎她的穿著。
sents.p: tā bù zài hu tā de chuān zhù
sents.en: She doesn't care how she dresses.

sents.zh: 我不在乎是否下雪。
sents.p: wǒ bù zài hu shì fǒu xià xuě
sents.en: I don't care if it snows.

sents.zh: 我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。
sents.p: wǒ de mèng xiǎng shì chéng wéi yī míng fēi xíng yuán
sents.en: My dream is to become a pilot.

sents.zh: 如果你不计较太多，生活会更容易些。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù jì jiào tài duō shēng huó huì gēng róng yì xiē
sents.en: Life would be so much better if you didn't care so much.

sents.zh: 我认为采用他的计划对我们比较好。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi cǎi yòng tā de jì huà duì wǒ men bǐ jiào hǎo
sents.en: I think it's better for us to adopt his plan.

sents.zh: 因为我付不了租金，我就向他请求帮助。
sents.p: yīn wèi wǒ fù bù liǎo zū jīn wǒ jiù xiàng tā qǐng qiú bāng zhù
sents.en: Since I couldn't pay the rent, I asked him for help.

sents.zh: 你觉得她最想要什么纪念品？
sents.p: nǐ jué de tā zuì xiǎng yào shén me jì niàn pǐn
sents.en: What souvenir do you think she would like most?

sents.zh: 这将是我环绕美国旅行中一个很好的纪念品。
sents.p: zhè jiāng shì wǒ huán rào měi guó lǚ xíng zhōng yī gè hěn hǎo de jì niàn pǐn
sents.en: This will be a good souvenir of my trip around the United States.

sents.zh: 如果她和你结婚了，她现在会很幸福。
sents.p: rú guǒ tā hé nǐ jié hūn le tā xiàn zài huì hěn xìng fú
sents.en: If she had married you, she would be happy now.

sents.zh: 不言自明，金钱买不到幸福。
sents.p: bù yán zì míng jīn qián mǎi bù dào xìng fú
sents.en: It goes without saying that money can't buy happiness.

sents.zh: 日本上班族工作得非常辛苦。
sents.p: rì běn shàng bān zú gōng zuò de fēi cháng xīn kǔ
sents.en: Japanese office workers work very hard.

sents.zh: 不要插手我的私生活。
sents.p: bù yào chā shǒu wǒ de sī shēng huó
sents.en: Don't pry into my private life.

sents.zh: 这本书有精美的插图。
sents.p: zhè běn shū yǒu jīng měi de chā tú
sents.en: This book is beautifully illustrated.

sents.zh: 我们的数学老师在黑板上画了一个圆。
sents.p: wǒ men de shù xué lǎo shī zài hēi bǎn shǎng huà le yī gè yuán
sents.en: Our math teacher drew a circle on the blackboard.

sents.zh: 我们买了张圆桌。
sents.p: wǒ men mǎi le zhāng yuán zhuō
sents.en: We bought a round table.

sents.zh: 你的袜子好臭。
sents.p: nǐ de wà zi hǎo chòu
sents.en: Your socks stink.

sents.zh: 你身上发臭了。
sents.p: nǐ shēn shang fā chòu le
sents.en: You stink.

sents.zh: 他的每首歌都长期备受欢迎。
sents.p: tā de měi shǒu gē dōu cháng qī bèi shòu huān yíng
sents.en: Every one of his songs was a hit.

sents.zh: 她的每首歌都长期备受欢迎。
sents.p: tā de měi shǒu gē dōu cháng qī bèi shòu huān yíng
sents.en: Every one of her songs was a hit.

sents.zh: 我可以借你的灰色西装吗？
sents.p: wǒ kě yǐ jiè nǐ de huī sè xī zhuāng ma
sents.en: Could I borrow your gray suit?

sents.zh: 他会让你吃灰的。
sents.p: tā huì ràng nǐ chī huī de
sents.en: He will make you eat dirt.

sents.zh: 请保留我的位置
sents.p: qǐng bǎo liú wǒ de wèi zhi
sents.en: Please save my place.

sents.zh: 谁买这种艺术品？
sents.p: shéi mǎi zhè zhǒng yì shù pǐn
sents.en: Who buys this type of art?

sents.zh: 啤酒论品脱卖。
sents.p: pí jiǔ lùn pǐn tuō mài
sents.en: Beer is sold by the pint.

units.title: Health, science and environment
units.intro: Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

ex.zh: 他的兴趣爱好是收集旧邮票。
ex.p: tā de xìng qù ài hào shì shōu jí jiù yóu piào
ex.en: His hobby is collecting old stamps.

ex.zh: 她为一本书收集材料。
ex.p: tā wèi yī běn shū shōu jí cái liào
ex.en: She's collecting material for a book.

ex.zh: 我对昨天晚上发生的事情感到非常的抱歉。
ex.p: wǒ duì zuó tiān wǎn shang fā shēng de shì qing gǎn dào fēi cháng de bào qiàn
ex.en: I'm really sorry about what happened last night.

items.en: to be called; to be known as; to call it "..."

ex.zh: 一百年称为一个世纪。
ex.p: yī bǎi nián chēng wéi yī gè shì jì
ex.en: One hundred years is called a century.

ex.zh: 这条路上的车辆不多。
ex.p: zhè tiáo lù shang de chē liàng bù duō
ex.en: There isn't much traffic on this road.

items.en: in those days; then; in those years

ex.zh: 暴风雪使得我们难以返回营地。
ex.p: bào fēng xuě shǐ de wǒ men nán yǐ fǎn huí yíng de
ex.en: We found it very hard going back to our base camp in the blizzard.

ex.zh: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu quán sōu chá nǐ de gōng yù
ex.en: We have a warrant to search your apartment.

ex.zh: 我正忙著找公寓。
ex.p: wǒ zhēng máng zhù zhǎo gōng yù
ex.en: I'm busy looking for an apartment.

ex.zh: 很快人群就在他周围聚集了起来。
ex.p: hěn kuài rén qún jiù zài tā zhōu wéi jù jí le qǐ lai
ex.en: A crowd soon gathered around him.

items.en: to rely on sth (for support etc); to depend on

ex.zh: 他经济上依靠他的太太。
ex.p: tā jīng jì shǎng yī kào tā de tài tai
ex.en: He relies on his wife financially.

ex.zh: 我的老婆孩子都依靠我。
ex.p: wǒ de lǎo pó hái zi dōu yī kào wǒ
ex.en: My wife and children depend on me.

items.en: weak; feeble; young; inferior; not as good as

ex.zh: 风暴几个小时没有减弱了。
ex.p: fēng bào jī gè xiǎo shí méi yǒu jiǎn ruò le
ex.en: The storm didn't abate for several hours.

items.en: to give birth; to reproduce; to produce

ex.zh: 他冒着失去所有财产的危险。
ex.p: tā mào zhe shī qù suǒ yǒu cái chǎn de wēi xiǎn
ex.en: He risked losing all his fortune.

ex.zh: 他把他的财产传给了他儿子。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā de cái chǎn chuán gěi le tā ér zi
ex.en: He passed his property on to his son.

ex.zh: 我最近一直睡眠不足。
ex.p: wǒ zuì jìn yī zhí shuì mián bù zú
ex.en: I haven't been getting enough sleep lately.

items.en: to sound an alarm; to report sth to the police

ex.zh: 想报警的是谁？
ex.p: xiǎng bào jǐng de shì shéi
ex.en: Whose idea was it to call the police?

items.en: to pilot (ship, airplane etc); to drive

ex.zh: 你还没到可以拿驾驶执照的年龄。
ex.p: nǐ hái méi dào kě yǐ ná jià shǐ zhí zhào de nián líng
ex.en: You're not old enough to get a driver's license.

ex.zh: 你知道怎么驾驶这玩意儿吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào zěn me jià shǐ zhè wán yìr ma
ex.en: Do you know how to drive this thing?

items.en: to count; to calculate; to compute

ex.zh: 桌上的计算器是我的。
ex.p: zhuō shǎng de jì suàn qì shì wǒ de
ex.en: The calculator on the table is mine.

ex.zh: 这个实验室配备了最新的计算机。
ex.p: zhè gè shí yàn shì pèi bèi le zuì xīn de jì suàn jī
ex.en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.

items.en: to exploit (a resource); to open up (for development); to develop
first of the ten Heavenly Stems 干

ex.zh: 咬指甲是个坏习惯。
ex.p: yǎo zhǐ jia shì gè huài xí guàn
ex.en: Biting your fingernails is a bad habit.

ex.zh: 不要再咬指甲了。
ex.p: bù yào zài yǎo zhǐ jia le
ex.en: Stop biting your nails.

items.en: from beginning to end; all along
to strive for; to vie for; to argue or debate

ex.zh: 他写了本关于美国南北战争的书。
ex.p: tā xiě le běn guān yú měi guó nán běi zhàn zhēng de shū
ex.en: He wrote a book about the American Civil War.

ex.zh: 和他争论这件事得不出结果。
ex.p: hé tā zhēng lùn zhè jiàn shì de bù chū jiē guǒ
ex.en: It is no use arguing with him about it.

items.en: to contribute; to dedicate; to devote

ex.zh: 她父亲把一生都贡献给科学事业了。
ex.p: tā fù qīn bǎ yī shēng dōu gòng xiàn gěi kē xué shì yè le
ex.en: Her father devoted his life to science.

ex.zh: 不要把我们的计划告诉任何人。
ex.p: bù yào bǎ wǒ men de jì huà gào sù rèn hé rén
ex.en: Don't tell anyone our plan.

ex.zh: 他们的计划对我来说很有意思。
ex.p: tā men de jì huà duì wǒ lái shuō hěn yǒu yì si
ex.en: Their plan sounds interesting to me.

items.en: medicine; medical science; study of medicine

ex.zh: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。
ex.p: tā zài yī xué jiè yǒu hěn dà de yǐng xiǎng lì
ex.en: He's very influential in the world of medicine.

items.en: (of competition or fighting) intense; fierce; (of pain) acute

ex.zh: 让我们享受这平静和安宁。
ex.p: ràng wǒ men xiǎng shòu zhè píng jìng hé ān níng
ex.en: Let's just enjoy this peace and quiet.

ex.zh: 医生告诉她要静养。
ex.p: yī shēng gào sù tā yào jìng yǎng
ex.en: The doctor told her that she should take a rest.

items.en: to unfold before one's eyes; to emerge; to reveal; to display
(zoology) segment (of the body of a worm, centipede etc)
(after a noun N and before a predicate P) the reason why N P

ex.zh: 没人体会我的感受。
ex.p: méi rén tǐ huì wǒ de gǎn shòu
ex.en: Nobody knows how I feel.

items.en: as one wishes; according to one's wishes; at will

ex.zh: 稍微随意一点。
ex.p: shāo wēi suí yì yī diǎn
ex.en: Let your hair down a little.

items.en: to freeze; to feel very cold; aspic or jelly

ex.zh: 我们几乎被冻死了。
ex.p: wǒ men jī hū bèi dòng sǐ le
ex.en: We were nearly frozen to death.

ex.zh: 冰冻三尺，非一日之寒。
ex.p: bīng dòng sān chě fēi yī rì zhī hán
ex.en: Rome wasn't built in a day.

items.en: pain; (of a person) to be in pain

ex.zh: 疼痛令人难以忍受。
ex.p: téng tòng líng rén nán yǐ rěn shòu
ex.en: The pain is unbearable.

ex.zh: 这种药会减轻你的疼痛。
ex.p: zhè zhǒng yào huì jiǎn qīng nǐ de téng tòng
ex.en: This medicine will decrease your pain.

ex.zh: 他们在乡村安定了下来。
ex.p: tā men zài xiāng cūn ān dìng le xià lai
ex.en: They settled in the country.

items.en: to fill or stuff; (of a form etc) to fill in

ex.zh: 填上你的姓名和地址。
ex.p: tián shǎng nǐ de xìng míng hé dì zhǐ
ex.en: Fill in your name and address.

ex.zh: 请填好这张表格。
ex.p: qǐng tián hǎo zhè zhāng biǎo gé
ex.en: Fill out this form, please.

items.en: to embody; to reflect; to incarnate
state of an illness; patient's condition
to question; to quiz; to grill

ex.zh: 你真的需要提问题来知道答案吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhēn de xū yào tí wèn tí lái zhī dào dá àn ma
ex.en: Do you really need to ask the question to know the answer?

items.en: to contain; to embody; to include

ex.zh: 它包含了什么？
ex.p: tā bāo hán le shén me
ex.en: What does it contain?

items.en: to bring relief; to alleviate (a crisis); to dull (a pain)
from this, it can be seen that...

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第83单元

Health, science and environment

Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 他的兴趣爱好是收集旧邮票。
sents.p: tā de xìng qù ài hào shì shōu jí jiù yóu piào
sents.en: His hobby is collecting old stamps.

sents.zh: 她为一本书收集材料。
sents.p: tā wèi yī běn shū shōu jí cái liào
sents.en: She's collecting material for a book.

sents.zh: 我对昨天晚上发生的事情感到非常的抱歉。
sents.p: wǒ duì zuó tiān wǎn shang fā shēng de shì qing gǎn dào fēi cháng de bào qiàn
sents.en: I'm really sorry about what happened last night.

sents.zh: 一百年称为一个世纪。
sents.p: yī bǎi nián chēng wéi yī gè shì jì
sents.en: One hundred years is called a century.

sents.zh: 这条路上的车辆不多。
sents.p: zhè tiáo lù shang de chē liàng bù duō
sents.en: There isn't much traffic on this road.

sents.zh: 暴风雪使得我们难以返回营地。
sents.p: bào fēng xuě shǐ de wǒ men nán yǐ fǎn huí yíng de
sents.en: We found it very hard going back to our base camp in the blizzard.

sents.zh: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu quán sōu chá nǐ de gōng yù
sents.en: We have a warrant to search your apartment.

sents.zh: 我正忙著找公寓。
sents.p: wǒ zhēng máng zhù zhǎo gōng yù
sents.en: I'm busy looking for an apartment.

sents.zh: 很快人群就在他周围聚集了起来。
sents.p: hěn kuài rén qún jiù zài tā zhōu wéi jù jí le qǐ lai
sents.en: A crowd soon gathered around him.

sents.zh: 他经济上依靠他的太太。
sents.p: tā jīng jì shǎng yī kào tā de tài tai
sents.en: He relies on his wife financially.

sents.zh: 我的老婆孩子都依靠我。
sents.p: wǒ de lǎo pó hái zi dōu yī kào wǒ
sents.en: My wife and children depend on me.

sents.zh: 风暴几个小时没有减弱了。
sents.p: fēng bào jī gè xiǎo shí méi yǒu jiǎn ruò le
sents.en: The storm didn't abate for several hours.

sents.zh: 他冒着失去所有财产的危险。
sents.p: tā mào zhe shī qù suǒ yǒu cái chǎn de wēi xiǎn
sents.en: He risked losing all his fortune.

sents.zh: 他把他的财产传给了他儿子。
sents.p: tā bǎ tā de cái chǎn chuán gěi le tā ér zi
sents.en: He passed his property on to his son.

sents.zh: 我最近一直睡眠不足。
sents.p: wǒ zuì jìn yī zhí shuì mián bù zú
sents.en: I haven't been getting enough sleep lately.

sents.zh: 想报警的是谁？
sents.p: xiǎng bào jǐng de shì shéi
sents.en: Whose idea was it to call the police?

sents.zh: 你还没到可以拿驾驶执照的年龄。
sents.p: nǐ hái méi dào kě yǐ ná jià shǐ zhí zhào de nián líng
sents.en: You're not old enough to get a driver's license.

sents.zh: 你知道怎么驾驶这玩意儿吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào zěn me jià shǐ zhè wán yìr ma
sents.en: Do you know how to drive this thing?

sents.zh: 桌上的计算器是我的。
sents.p: zhuō shǎng de jì suàn qì shì wǒ de
sents.en: The calculator on the table is mine.

sents.zh: 这个实验室配备了最新的计算机。
sents.p: zhè gè shí yàn shì pèi bèi le zuì xīn de jì suàn jī
sents.en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.

sents.zh: 咬指甲是个坏习惯。
sents.p: yǎo zhǐ jia shì gè huài xí guàn
sents.en: Biting your fingernails is a bad habit.

sents.zh: 不要再咬指甲了。
sents.p: bù yào zài yǎo zhǐ jia le
sents.en: Stop biting your nails.

sents.zh: 他写了本关于美国南北战争的书。
sents.p: tā xiě le běn guān yú měi guó nán běi zhàn zhēng de shū
sents.en: He wrote a book about the American Civil War.

sents.zh: 和他争论这件事得不出结果。
sents.p: hé tā zhēng lùn zhè jiàn shì de bù chū jiē guǒ
sents.en: It is no use arguing with him about it.

sents.zh: 她父亲把一生都贡献给科学事业了。
sents.p: tā fù qīn bǎ yī shēng dōu gòng xiàn gěi kē xué shì yè le
sents.en: Her father devoted his life to science.

sents.zh: 不要把我们的计划告诉任何人。
sents.p: bù yào bǎ wǒ men de jì huà gào sù rèn hé rén
sents.en: Don't tell anyone our plan.

sents.zh: 他们的计划对我来说很有意思。
sents.p: tā men de jì huà duì wǒ lái shuō hěn yǒu yì si
sents.en: Their plan sounds interesting to me.

sents.zh: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。
sents.p: tā zài yī xué jiè yǒu hěn dà de yǐng xiǎng lì
sents.en: He's very influential in the world of medicine.

sents.zh: 让我们享受这平静和安宁。
sents.p: ràng wǒ men xiǎng shòu zhè píng jìng hé ān níng
sents.en: Let's just enjoy this peace and quiet.

sents.zh: 医生告诉她要静养。
sents.p: yī shēng gào sù tā yào jìng yǎng
sents.en: The doctor told her that she should take a rest.

sents.zh: 没人体会我的感受。
sents.p: méi rén tǐ huì wǒ de gǎn shòu
sents.en: Nobody knows how I feel.

sents.zh: 稍微随意一点。
sents.p: shāo wēi suí yì yī diǎn
sents.en: Let your hair down a little.

sents.zh: 我们几乎被冻死了。
sents.p: wǒ men jī hū bèi dòng sǐ le
sents.en: We were nearly frozen to death.

sents.zh: 冰冻三尺，非一日之寒。
sents.p: bīng dòng sān chě fēi yī rì zhī hán
sents.en: Rome wasn't built in a day.

sents.zh: 疼痛令人难以忍受。
sents.p: téng tòng líng rén nán yǐ rěn shòu
sents.en: The pain is unbearable.

sents.zh: 这种药会减轻你的疼痛。
sents.p: zhè zhǒng yào huì jiǎn qīng nǐ de téng tòng
sents.en: This medicine will decrease your pain.

sents.zh: 他们在乡村安定了下来。
sents.p: tā men zài xiāng cūn ān dìng le xià lai
sents.en: They settled in the country.

sents.zh: 填上你的姓名和地址。
sents.p: tián shǎng nǐ de xìng míng hé dì zhǐ
sents.en: Fill in your name and address.

sents.zh: 请填好这张表格。
sents.p: qǐng tián hǎo zhè zhāng biǎo gé
sents.en: Fill out this form, please.

sents.zh: 你真的需要提问题来知道答案吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhēn de xū yào tí wèn tí lái zhī dào dá àn ma
sents.en: Do you really need to ask the question to know the answer?

sents.zh: 它包含了什么？
sents.p: tā bāo hán le shén me
sents.en: What does it contain?

units.title: Health, science and environment
units.intro: Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

ex.zh: 每年都有大量新书出版。
ex.p: měi nián dōu yǒu dà liàng xīn shū chū bǎn
ex.en: A great number of books are published every year.

ex.zh: 这本书明年要出版。
ex.p: zhè běn shū míng nián yào chū bǎn
ex.en: This book will be printed next year.

items.en: to move; to shift; to change

ex.zh: 许多移民改了名字。
ex.p: xǔ duō yí mín gǎi le míng zi
ex.en: Many of the immigrants changed their names.

ex.zh: 随着时间的推移，比赛增加了规则以使之更安全。
ex.p: suí zhe shí jiān de tuī yí bǐ sài zēng jiā le guī zé yǐ shǐ zhī gēng ān quán
ex.en: As time went on, rules were added to the game to make it safer.

items.en: to survey; to measure; to conjecture

ex.zh: 我们测量了这条河的深度。
ex.p: wǒ men cè liáng le zhè tiáo hé de shēn dù
ex.en: We measured the depth of the river.

ex.zh: 我们应该进行测试。
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi jìn xíng cè shì
ex.en: We should run some tests.

ex.zh: 她有时候让她的妈妈剪头发。
ex.p: tā yǒu shí hou ràng tā de mā ma jiǎn tóu fa
ex.en: She sometimes has her mother cut her hair.

ex.zh: 你把我的头发剪得太短了。
ex.p: nǐ bǎ wǒ de tóu fa jiǎn de tài duǎn le
ex.en: You've cut my hair too short.

items.en: as the time draws near; at the last moment; temporary

ex.zh: 夜幕降临时，孩子们回家了。
ex.p: yè mù jiàng lín shí hái zi men huí jiā le
ex.en: The children returned home at dusk.

ex.zh: 正式工比临时工要好。
ex.p: zhèng shì gōng bǐ lín shí gōng yào hǎo
ex.en: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.

ex.zh: 他在教学上拥有丰富的经验。
ex.p: tā zài jiāo xué shǎng yōng yǒu fēng fù de jīng yàn
ex.en: He has a lot of teaching experience.

ex.zh: 就算我富有，我也不会给他钱。
ex.p: jiù suàn wǒ fù yǒu wǒ yě bù huì gěi tā qián
ex.en: Even if I were rich, I wouldn't give him money.

ex.zh: 你该把你的值钱物品保存在一个安全的地方。
ex.p: nǐ gāi bǎ nǐ de zhí qián wù pǐn bǎo cún zài yī gè ān quán de dì fāng
ex.en: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.

items.en: alone; by oneself; on one's own

ex.zh: 到目前为止，你认为你阅读过多少书籍？
ex.p: dào mù qián wéi zhǐ nǐ rèn wéi nǐ yuè dú guò duō shǎo shū jí
ex.en: How many books do you think you've read so far?

ex.zh: 如果地球停止自传，你认为会发生什么？
ex.p: rú guǒ dì qiú tíng zhǐ zì chuán nǐ rèn wéi huì fā shēng shén me
ex.en: What do you think would happen if the earth stopped spinning?

items.en: to ensure public security; public security; security guard

ex.zh: 请帮我叫宾馆保安。
ex.p: qǐng bāng wǒ jiào bīn guǎn bǎo ān
ex.en: Please get me hotel security.

ex.zh: 别麻烦保安了。
ex.p: bié má fan bǎo ān le
ex.en: Don't bother calling security.

ex.zh: 实验室里的空调坏了。
ex.p: shí yàn shì lǐ de kōng tiáo huài le
ex.en: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.

ex.zh: 他失去了平衡，从梯子上摔了下来。
ex.p: tā shī qù le píng héng cóng tī zi shǎng shuāi le xià lai
ex.en: He lost his balance and fell off the ladder.

ex.zh: 他失去了平衡，从自行车上摔了下来。
ex.p: tā shī qù le píng héng cóng zì xíng chē shǎng shuāi le xià lai
ex.en: He lost his balance and fell off his bicycle.

items.en: to bloom; to open; to be open (to the public)

ex.zh: 它已经开放了。
ex.p: tā yǐ jīng kāi fàng le
ex.en: It's already open.

ex.zh: 展览现在已经开放。
ex.p: zhǎn lǎn xiàn zài yǐ jīng kāi fàng
ex.en: The exhibition is now open.

items.en: to crowd in; to cram in; to force others aside

ex.zh: 我不喜欢做那个总是挤牛奶的人。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan zuò nà gè zǒng shì jǐ niú nǎi de rén
ex.en: I don't like being the one who always has to milk the cow.

ex.zh: 我们挤进了那间小房间里。
ex.p: wǒ men jǐ jìn le nà jiān xiǎo fáng jiān lǐ
ex.en: We were crowded into the small room.

ex.zh: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ suǒ jiàn guò de zuì dà xíng de gòu zào le
ex.en: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.

items.en: to put out; to come up with; to draw (conclusion)

ex.zh: 你怎样作出的解释？
ex.p: nǐ zěn yàng zuò chū de jiě shì
ex.en: How do you account for that?

ex.zh: 这个炸弹可以炸死很多人。
ex.p: zhè gè zhà dàn kě yǐ zhá sǐ hěn duō rén
ex.en: This bomb can kill many people.

ex.zh: 我觉得我的头要炸了。
ex.p: wǒ jué de wǒ de tóu yào zhá le
ex.en: I thought my head would explode.

items.en: to unfold; to spread out; to open up; to launch; to carry out
to grasp (also fig.); to seize; to hold

ex.zh: 他是这里附近酒吧和酒馆的常客。
ex.p: tā shì zhè lǐ fù jìn jiǔ bā hé jiǔ guǎn de cháng kè
ex.en: He's a regular at the bars and pubs around here.

ex.zh: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。
ex.p: wǒ de yī gè nǚ xìng péng you xǐ huan gēn wǒ yī qǐ qù tóng zhì jiǔ bā
ex.en: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.

ex.zh: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。
ex.p: bù yào yīn wèi chī de tài duō ér rǎo luàn wèi de zhèng cháng xiāo huà
ex.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.

ex.zh: 我尽量留着胃吃甜点。
ex.p: wǒ jǐn liàng liú zhe wèi chī tián diǎn
ex.en: I'm trying to save room for dessert.

ex.zh: 她很有可能会有所成就。
ex.p: tā hěn yǒu kě néng huì yǒu suǒ chéng jiù
ex.en: It's likely that she'll succeed.

items.en: to miss; to remember with longing; to long to see again

ex.zh: 难道你不想念什么吗？
ex.p: nán dào nǐ bù xiǎng niàn shén me ma
ex.en: Don't you miss anything?

ex.zh: 我会很想念你们的。
ex.p: wǒ huì hěn xiǎng niàn nǐ men de
ex.en: I'll miss you all so much.

ex.zh: 他预测会下雨。
ex.p: tā yù cè huì xià yǔ
ex.en: He predicted there would be rain.

items.en: to fix; to fasten; to set rigidly in place

ex.zh: 你有一个固定的男朋友吗？
ex.p: nǐ yǒu yī gè gù dìng de nán péng you ma
ex.en: Do you have a steady boyfriend?

ex.zh: 我在找一些固定工作。
ex.p: wǒ zài zhǎo yī xiē gù dìng gōng zuò
ex.en: I'm looking for some regular work.

items.en: country or countryside; native place; home village or town

ex.zh: 乡间有很多树。
ex.p: xiāng jiān yǒu hěn duō shù
ex.en: The countryside has many trees.

items.en: to sprinkle; to spray; to spill
to place an order; to book ahead

ex.zh: 拍照片光线不够亮。
ex.p: pāi zhào piān guāng xiàn bù gòu liàng
ex.en: There is insufficient light to take pictures.

items.en: to bow the head; to yield; to give in
to recharge (a battery); to update one's skills and knowledge

ex.zh: 这附近有没有可以给手机充电的地方？
ex.p: zhè fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu kě yǐ gěi shǒu jī chōng diàn de dì fāng
ex.en: Is there a place where I can charge my cellphone around here?

items.en: slow-witted; blockhead; log (of wood, timber etc)

ex.zh: 他用一块木头刻出一尊佛像。
ex.p: tā yòng yī kuài mù tou kè chū yī zūn fó xiàng
ex.en: He carved a Buddha statue from wood.

items.en: military skill or technique (in former times)
to lose one's love; to break up (in a romantic relationship); to feel jilted
to be willing to part with sth
traditional Chinese medical science; a doctor trained in Chinese medicine
to register (at a hospital etc); to send by registered mail

sents.zh: 随着时间的推移，比赛增加了规则以使之更安全。
sents.p: suí zhe shí jiān de tuī yí bǐ sài zēng jiā le guī zé yǐ shǐ zhī gēng ān quán
sents.en: As time went on, rules were added to the game to make it safer.

sents.zh: 我们测量了这条河的深度。
sents.p: wǒ men cè liáng le zhè tiáo hé de shēn dù
sents.en: We measured the depth of the river.

sents.zh: 我们应该进行测试。
sents.p: wǒ men yīng gāi jìn xíng cè shì
sents.en: We should run some tests.

sents.zh: 她有时候让她的妈妈剪头发。
sents.p: tā yǒu shí hou ràng tā de mā ma jiǎn tóu fa
sents.en: She sometimes has her mother cut her hair.

sents.zh: 你把我的头发剪得太短了。
sents.p: nǐ bǎ wǒ de tóu fa jiǎn de tài duǎn le
sents.en: You've cut my hair too short.

sents.zh: 夜幕降临时，孩子们回家了。
sents.p: yè mù jiàng lín shí hái zi men huí jiā le
sents.en: The children returned home at dusk.

sents.zh: 正式工比临时工要好。
sents.p: zhèng shì gōng bǐ lín shí gōng yào hǎo
sents.en: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.

sents.zh: 他在教学上拥有丰富的经验。
sents.p: tā zài jiāo xué shǎng yōng yǒu fēng fù de jīng yàn
sents.en: He has a lot of teaching experience.

sents.zh: 就算我富有，我也不会给他钱。
sents.p: jiù suàn wǒ fù yǒu wǒ yě bù huì gěi tā qián
sents.en: Even if I were rich, I wouldn't give him money.

sents.zh: 你该把你的值钱物品保存在一个安全的地方。
sents.p: nǐ gāi bǎ nǐ de zhí qián wù pǐn bǎo cún zài yī gè ān quán de dì fāng
sents.en: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.

sents.zh: 到目前为止，你认为你阅读过多少书籍？
sents.p: dào mù qián wéi zhǐ nǐ rèn wéi nǐ yuè dú guò duō shǎo shū jí
sents.en: How many books do you think you've read so far?

sents.zh: 如果地球停止自传，你认为会发生什么？
sents.p: rú guǒ dì qiú tíng zhǐ zì chuán nǐ rèn wéi huì fā shēng shén me
sents.en: What do you think would happen if the earth stopped spinning?

sents.zh: 请帮我叫宾馆保安。
sents.p: qǐng bāng wǒ jiào bīn guǎn bǎo ān
sents.en: Please get me hotel security.

sents.zh: 别麻烦保安了。
sents.p: bié má fan bǎo ān le
sents.en: Don't bother calling security.

sents.zh: 实验室里的空调坏了。
sents.p: shí yàn shì lǐ de kōng tiáo huài le
sents.en: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.

sents.zh: 他失去了平衡，从梯子上摔了下来。
sents.p: tā shī qù le píng héng cóng tī zi shǎng shuāi le xià lai
sents.en: He lost his balance and fell off the ladder.

sents.zh: 他失去了平衡，从自行车上摔了下来。
sents.p: tā shī qù le píng héng cóng zì xíng chē shǎng shuāi le xià lai
sents.en: He lost his balance and fell off his bicycle.

sents.zh: 它已经开放了。
sents.p: tā yǐ jīng kāi fàng le
sents.en: It's already open.

sents.zh: 展览现在已经开放。
sents.p: zhǎn lǎn xiàn zài yǐ jīng kāi fàng
sents.en: The exhibition is now open.

sents.zh: 我不喜欢做那个总是挤牛奶的人。
sents.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan zuò nà gè zǒng shì jǐ niú nǎi de rén
sents.en: I don't like being the one who always has to milk the cow.

sents.zh: 我们挤进了那间小房间里。
sents.p: wǒ men jǐ jìn le nà jiān xiǎo fáng jiān lǐ
sents.en: We were crowded into the small room.

sents.zh: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
sents.p: zhè shì wǒ suǒ jiàn guò de zuì dà xíng de gòu zào le
sents.en: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.

sents.zh: 你怎样作出的解释？
sents.p: nǐ zěn yàng zuò chū de jiě shì
sents.en: How do you account for that?

sents.zh: 这个炸弹可以炸死很多人。
sents.p: zhè gè zhà dàn kě yǐ zhá sǐ hěn duō rén
sents.en: This bomb can kill many people.

sents.zh: 我觉得我的头要炸了。
sents.p: wǒ jué de wǒ de tóu yào zhá le
sents.en: I thought my head would explode.

sents.zh: 他是这里附近酒吧和酒馆的常客。
sents.p: tā shì zhè lǐ fù jìn jiǔ bā hé jiǔ guǎn de cháng kè
sents.en: He's a regular at the bars and pubs around here.

sents.zh: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。
sents.p: wǒ de yī gè nǚ xìng péng you xǐ huan gēn wǒ yī qǐ qù tóng zhì jiǔ bā
sents.en: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.

sents.zh: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。
sents.p: bù yào yīn wèi chī de tài duō ér rǎo luàn wèi de zhèng cháng xiāo huà
sents.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.

sents.zh: 我尽量留着胃吃甜点。
sents.p: wǒ jǐn liàng liú zhe wèi chī tián diǎn
sents.en: I'm trying to save room for dessert.

sents.zh: 她很有可能会有所成就。
sents.p: tā hěn yǒu kě néng huì yǒu suǒ chéng jiù
sents.en: It's likely that she'll succeed.

sents.zh: 难道你不想念什么吗？
sents.p: nán dào nǐ bù xiǎng niàn shén me ma
sents.en: Don't you miss anything?

sents.zh: 我会很想念你们的。
sents.p: wǒ huì hěn xiǎng niàn nǐ men de
sents.en: I'll miss you all so much.

sents.zh: 他预测会下雨。
sents.p: tā yù cè huì xià yǔ
sents.en: He predicted there would be rain.

sents.zh: 你有一个固定的男朋友吗？
sents.p: nǐ yǒu yī gè gù dìng de nán péng you ma
sents.en: Do you have a steady boyfriend?

sents.zh: 我在找一些固定工作。
sents.p: wǒ zài zhǎo yī xiē gù dìng gōng zuò
sents.en: I'm looking for some regular work.

sents.zh: 乡间有很多树。
sents.p: xiāng jiān yǒu hěn duō shù
sents.en: The countryside has many trees.

sents.zh: 拍照片光线不够亮。
sents.p: pāi zhào piān guāng xiàn bù gòu liàng
sents.en: There is insufficient light to take pictures.

sents.zh: 这附近有没有可以给手机充电的地方？
sents.p: zhè fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu kě yǐ gěi shǒu jī chōng diàn de dì fāng
sents.en: Is there a place where I can charge my cellphone around here?

sents.zh: 他用一块木头刻出一尊佛像。
sents.p: tā yòng yī kuài mù tou kè chū yī zūn fó xiàng
sents.en: He carved a Buddha statue from wood.

units.title: Health, science and environment
units.intro: Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

ex.zh: 我注册了，现在该干什么呢？
ex.p: wǒ zhù cè le xiàn zài gāi gàn shén me ne
ex.en: What do I have to do now that I'm registered?

ex.zh: 确保亲自填写注册表格。
ex.p: què bǎo qīn zì tián xiě zhù cè biǎo gé
ex.en: Be sure to fill out the registration form in person.

items.en: to be located at; to be situated at; to lie

ex.zh: 教堂位于山脚。
ex.p: jiào táng wèi yú shān jiǎo
ex.en: The church is at the foot of a mountain.

ex.zh: 图书馆位于城市中心。
ex.p: tú shū guǎn wèi yú chéng shì zhōng xīn
ex.en: The library is in the center of the city.

ex.zh: 我不喜欢摇滚乐。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan yáo gǔn lè
ex.en: I don't like rock music.

ex.zh: 她沉迷于摇滚乐。
ex.p: tā chén mí yú yáo gǔn lè
ex.en: She is absorbed in rock music.

ex.zh: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。
ex.p: zhè jī nián duì zuò yè liáo fǎ de xū qiú zài xùn sù zēng zhǎng
ex.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.

items.en: to cultivate; to breed; to foster

ex.zh: 培养政治意识要花费时间。
ex.p: péi yǎng zhèng zhì yì shí yào huā fèi shí jiān
ex.en: Developing political awareness takes time.

ex.zh: 让我们享受这平静和安宁。
ex.p: ràng wǒ men xiǎng shòu zhè píng jìng hé ān níng
ex.en: Let's just enjoy this peace and quiet.

ex.zh: 暴风雨后，大海恢复了平静。
ex.p: bào fēng yǔ hòu dà hǎi huī fù le píng jìng
ex.en: After the storm, the sea was quiet again.

items.en: to talk (with sb); to have a conversation; talk

ex.zh: 你我之间需要来场谈话。
ex.p: nǐ wǒ zhī jiān xū yào lái cháng tán huà
ex.en: You and I need to have a talk.

ex.zh: 我录下了我们的谈话。
ex.p: wǒ lù xià le wǒ men de tán huà
ex.en: I recorded our conversation.

items.en: safe and sound; well; without mishap

ex.zh: 祝你一路平安。
ex.p: zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
ex.en: Have a safe trip.

items.en: legend; folk tale; to repeat from mouth to mouth; they say that...

ex.zh: 我深信事情会往更好的方向转变。
ex.p: wǒ shēn xìn shì qing huì wǎng gēng hǎo de fāng xiàng zhuǎn biàn
ex.en: I am convinced that things will change for the better.

items.en: so far; to this day; until now

ex.zh: 我父亲至今从未去过国外。
ex.p: wǒ fù qīn zhì jīn cóng wèi qù guò guó wài
ex.en: My father has never been abroad.

ex.zh: 我准备好了承担后果。
ex.p: wǒ zhǔn bèi hǎo le chéng dān hòu guǒ
ex.en: I'm prepared to accept the consequences.

items.en: with all one's strength; full strength; all-out (effort)

ex.zh: 你做任何事都要尽全力。
ex.p: nǐ zuò rèn hé shì dōu yào jǐn quán lì
ex.en: Do your best in anything you do.

ex.zh: 我应该尽我的全力。
ex.p: wǒ yīng gāi jǐn wǒ de quán lì
ex.en: I have to do my best.

ex.zh: 他藏到一个大石头后面了。
ex.p: tā zàng dào yī gè dà shí tou hòu mian le
ex.en: He hid himself behind a large rock.

ex.zh: 他朝着大狗扔了块石头。
ex.p: tā cháo zhe dà gǒu rēng le kuài shí tou
ex.en: He threw a stone at the big dog.

items.en: to take charge of; to manage or direct; to preside over
to close; to shut (a window etc); (of a shop, school etc) to shut down

ex.zh: 请关闭电视机。
ex.p: qǐng guān bì diàn shì jī
ex.en: Please turn off the TV.

ex.zh: 我的软件全都是开源的。
ex.p: wǒ de ruǎn jiàn quán dōu shì kāi yuán de
ex.en: All of my software is open source.

items.en: to visit; to call on; to interview

ex.zh: 每年有成千上万的外国人访问日本。
ex.p: měi nián yǒu chéng qiān shàng wàn de wài guó rén fǎng wèn rì běn
ex.en: Thousands of foreigners visit Japan every year.

ex.zh: 你会去访问其他国家吗？
ex.p: nǐ huì qù fǎng wèn qí tā guó jiā ma
ex.en: Are you going to visit any other countries?

items.en: to sign (one's name with a pen etc); to autograph; signature
to take a photograph; photography; to shoot (a movie)
to exchange; to swap; to switch (telecom)

ex.zh: 今日的朋友是明日的敌人。
ex.p: jīn rì de péng you shì míng rì de dí rén
ex.en: Today's friends are tomorrow's enemies.

items.en: to resist; to obstruct; to hinder

ex.zh: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。
ex.p: rì běn jūn duì kàn lai qiáng dà de bù kě zǔ dǎng
ex.en: The Japanese military forces seemed too strong to stop.

ex.zh: 一棵倒下的树挡住了通道。
ex.p: yī kē dǎo xià de shù dǎng zhù le tōng dào
ex.en: A fallen tree blocked the path.

items.en: to arrive at (place or time); period; to become due
to recognize; to know; to admit

ex.zh: 你应该认真考虑在这里工作的事。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi rèn zhēn kǎo lǜ zài zhè lǐ gōng zuò de shì
ex.en: You should seriously consider working here.

ex.zh: 我们都认为你的想法是行不通的。
ex.p: wǒ men dōu rèn wéi nǐ de xiǎng fǎ shì xíng bù tōng de
ex.en: We all consider your idea to be impractical.

items.en: to be present; to be on the scene

ex.zh: 不要对批评太敏感了。
ex.p: bù yào duì pī píng tài mǐn gǎn le
ex.en: Don't be too sensitive to criticism.

ex.zh: 我猜这是我们的运气坏。
ex.p: wǒ cāi zhè shì wǒ men de yùn qi huài
ex.en: I guess it was our bad luck.

ex.zh: 他给了孩子一个玩具。
ex.p: tā gěi le hái zi yī gè wán jù
ex.en: He gave the child a toy.

ex.zh: 他收起了他的玩具。
ex.p: tā shōu qǐ le tā de wán jù
ex.en: He put away his toys.

items.en: to prevent; to guard against; to take precautions

ex.zh: 他跟您年纪差不多。
ex.p: tā gēn nín nián jì chà bù duō
ex.en: He is about your age.

ex.zh: 你该考虑他的年纪。
ex.p: nǐ gāi kǎo lǜ tā de nián jì
ex.en: You must take his age into account.

items.en: to keep in the mouth; to contain

ex.zh: 这个词有两种含义。
ex.p: zhè gè cí yǒu liǎng zhǒng hán yì
ex.en: This word has two meanings.

ex.zh: 你为什么这么含糊其辞？
ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me zhè me hán hu qí cí
ex.en: Why are you being so evasive?

items.en: to adopt; to employ; to use

ex.zh: 我认为采用他的计划对我们比较好。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi cǎi yòng tā de jì huà duì wǒ men bǐ jiào hǎo
ex.en: I think it's better for us to adopt his plan.

ex.zh: 这对夫妇生了个儿子。
ex.p: zhè duì fū fù shēng le gèr zǐ
ex.en: The couple had a son.

items.en: to throw down; to fall; to drop and break

ex.zh: 她在从自行车上摔下来时伤到了脚。
ex.p: tā zài cóng zì xíng chē shǎng shuāi xià lai shí shāng dào le jiǎo
ex.en: She hurt her foot when she fell off her bicycle.

ex.zh: 你摔坏过你的眼镜吗？
ex.p: nǐ shuāi huài guò nǐ de yǎn jìng ma
ex.en: Have you ever broken your glasses?

items.en: to join; to connect; to link up; to communicate

ex.zh: 不能用手指人。
ex.p: bù néng yòng shǒu zhǐ rén
ex.en: Don't point at others.

ex.zh: 教师用手指指着我，要我跟她走。
ex.p: jiào shī yòng shǒu zhǐ zhǐ zhe wǒ yào wǒ gēn tā zǒu
ex.en: The teacher pointed her finger at me and asked me to come with her.

ex.zh: 你们怎么得出这个结论的？
ex.p: nǐ men zěn me dé chū zhè gè jié lùn de
ex.en: How do you come to that conclusion?

ex.zh: 我想找一种提升记忆力的方法。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī zhǒng tí shēng jì yì lì de fāng fǎ
ex.en: I'd like to find a way to improve my memory.

ex.zh: 他的化学很差。
ex.p: tā de huà xué hěn chà
ex.en: He is poor at chemistry.

items.en: in a word; in short; in brief

lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第85单元

Health, science and environment

Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.p: tā chén mí yú yáo gǔn lè
sents.en: She is absorbed in rock music.

sents.zh: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。
sents.p: zhè jī nián duì zuò yè liáo fǎ de xū qiú zài xùn sù zēng zhǎng
sents.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.

sents.zh: 培养政治意识要花费时间。
sents.p: péi yǎng zhèng zhì yì shí yào huā fèi shí jiān
sents.en: Developing political awareness takes time.

sents.zh: 让我们享受这平静和安宁。
sents.p: ràng wǒ men xiǎng shòu zhè píng jìng hé ān níng
sents.en: Let's just enjoy this peace and quiet.

sents.zh: 暴风雨后，大海恢复了平静。
sents.p: bào fēng yǔ hòu dà hǎi huī fù le píng jìng
sents.en: After the storm, the sea was quiet again.

sents.zh: 你我之间需要来场谈话。
sents.p: nǐ wǒ zhī jiān xū yào lái cháng tán huà
sents.en: You and I need to have a talk.

sents.zh: 我录下了我们的谈话。
sents.p: wǒ lù xià le wǒ men de tán huà
sents.en: I recorded our conversation.

sents.zh: 祝你一路平安。
sents.p: zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
sents.en: Have a safe trip.

sents.zh: 我深信事情会往更好的方向转变。
sents.p: wǒ shēn xìn shì qing huì wǎng gēng hǎo de fāng xiàng zhuǎn biàn
sents.en: I am convinced that things will change for the better.

sents.zh: 我父亲至今从未去过国外。
sents.p: wǒ fù qīn zhì jīn cóng wèi qù guò guó wài
sents.en: My father has never been abroad.

sents.zh: 我准备好了承担后果。
sents.p: wǒ zhǔn bèi hǎo le chéng dān hòu guǒ
sents.en: I'm prepared to accept the consequences.

sents.zh: 你做任何事都要尽全力。
sents.p: nǐ zuò rèn hé shì dōu yào jǐn quán lì
sents.en: Do your best in anything you do.

sents.zh: 我应该尽我的全力。
sents.p: wǒ yīng gāi jǐn wǒ de quán lì
sents.en: I have to do my best.

sents.zh: 他藏到一个大石头后面了。
sents.p: tā zàng dào yī gè dà shí tou hòu mian le
sents.en: He hid himself behind a large rock.

sents.zh: 他朝着大狗扔了块石头。
sents.p: tā cháo zhe dà gǒu rēng le kuài shí tou
sents.en: He threw a stone at the big dog.

sents.zh: 请关闭电视机。
sents.p: qǐng guān bì diàn shì jī
sents.en: Please turn off the TV.

sents.zh: 我的软件全都是开源的。
sents.p: wǒ de ruǎn jiàn quán dōu shì kāi yuán de
sents.en: All of my software is open source.

sents.zh: 每年有成千上万的外国人访问日本。
sents.p: měi nián yǒu chéng qiān shàng wàn de wài guó rén fǎng wèn rì běn
sents.en: Thousands of foreigners visit Japan every year.

sents.zh: 你会去访问其他国家吗？
sents.p: nǐ huì qù fǎng wèn qí tā guó jiā ma
sents.en: Are you going to visit any other countries?

sents.zh: 今日的朋友是明日的敌人。
sents.p: jīn rì de péng you shì míng rì de dí rén
sents.en: Today's friends are tomorrow's enemies.

sents.zh: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。
sents.p: rì běn jūn duì kàn lai qiáng dà de bù kě zǔ dǎng
sents.en: The Japanese military forces seemed too strong to stop.

sents.zh: 一棵倒下的树挡住了通道。
sents.p: yī kē dǎo xià de shù dǎng zhù le tōng dào
sents.en: A fallen tree blocked the path.

sents.zh: 你应该认真考虑在这里工作的事。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi rèn zhēn kǎo lǜ zài zhè lǐ gōng zuò de shì
sents.en: You should seriously consider working here.

sents.zh: 我们都认为你的想法是行不通的。
sents.p: wǒ men dōu rèn wéi nǐ de xiǎng fǎ shì xíng bù tōng de
sents.en: We all consider your idea to be impractical.

sents.zh: 不要对批评太敏感了。
sents.p: bù yào duì pī píng tài mǐn gǎn le
sents.en: Don't be too sensitive to criticism.

sents.zh: 我猜这是我们的运气坏。
sents.p: wǒ cāi zhè shì wǒ men de yùn qi huài
sents.en: I guess it was our bad luck.

sents.zh: 他给了孩子一个玩具。
sents.p: tā gěi le hái zi yī gè wán jù
sents.en: He gave the child a toy.

sents.zh: 他收起了他的玩具。
sents.p: tā shōu qǐ le tā de wán jù
sents.en: He put away his toys.

sents.zh: 他跟您年纪差不多。
sents.p: tā gēn nín nián jì chà bù duō
sents.en: He is about your age.

sents.zh: 你该考虑他的年纪。
sents.p: nǐ gāi kǎo lǜ tā de nián jì
sents.en: You must take his age into account.

sents.zh: 这个词有两种含义。
sents.p: zhè gè cí yǒu liǎng zhǒng hán yì
sents.en: This word has two meanings.

sents.zh: 你为什么这么含糊其辞？
sents.p: nǐ wèi shén me zhè me hán hu qí cí
sents.en: Why are you being so evasive?

sents.zh: 我认为采用他的计划对我们比较好。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi cǎi yòng tā de jì huà duì wǒ men bǐ jiào hǎo
sents.en: I think it's better for us to adopt his plan.

sents.zh: 这对夫妇生了个儿子。
sents.p: zhè duì fū fù shēng le gèr zǐ
sents.en: The couple had a son.

sents.zh: 她在从自行车上摔下来时伤到了脚。
sents.p: tā zài cóng zì xíng chē shǎng shuāi xià lai shí shāng dào le jiǎo
sents.en: She hurt her foot when she fell off her bicycle.

sents.zh: 你摔坏过你的眼镜吗？
sents.p: nǐ shuāi huài guò nǐ de yǎn jìng ma
sents.en: Have you ever broken your glasses?

sents.zh: 不能用手指人。
sents.p: bù néng yòng shǒu zhǐ rén
sents.en: Don't point at others.

sents.zh: 教师用手指指着我，要我跟她走。
sents.p: jiào shī yòng shǒu zhǐ zhǐ zhe wǒ yào wǒ gēn tā zǒu
sents.en: The teacher pointed her finger at me and asked me to come with her.

sents.zh: 你们怎么得出这个结论的？
sents.p: nǐ men zěn me dé chū zhè gè jié lùn de
sents.en: How do you come to that conclusion?

sents.zh: 我想找一种提升记忆力的方法。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī zhǒng tí shēng jì yì lì de fāng fǎ
sents.en: I'd like to find a way to improve my memory.

sents.zh: 他的化学很差。
sents.p: tā de huà xué hěn chà
sents.en: He is poor at chemistry.

units.title: Health, science and environment
units.intro: Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

ex.zh: 你能看到天空中的繁星。
ex.p: nǐ néng kàn dào tiān kōng zhōng de fán xīng
ex.en: You can see a lot of stars in the sky.

ex.zh: 天空中繁星点点。
ex.p: tiān kōng zhōng fán xīng diǎn diǎn
ex.en: The sky is full of stars.

items.en: to unify; to integrate; unified; integrated
to wind; to coil (thread); to rotate around

ex.zh: 让卫星环绕地球的是重力。
ex.p: ràng wèi xīng huán rào dì qiú de shì zhòng lì
ex.en: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.

ex.zh: 这将是我环绕美国旅行中一个很好的纪念品。
ex.p: zhè jiāng shì wǒ huán rào měi guó lǚ xíng zhōng yī gè hěn hǎo de jì niàn pǐn
ex.en: This will be a good souvenir of my trip around the United States.

ex.zh: 底特律因它的汽车工业而出名。
ex.p: de tè lǜ yīn tā de qì chē gōng yè ér chū míng
ex.en: Detroit is famous for its car industry.

ex.zh: 许多人在工业城市工作。
ex.p: xǔ duō rén zài gōng yè chéng shì gōng zuò
ex.en: Many people work in industrial towns.

ex.zh: 这套房子设施便利齐全。
ex.p: zhè tào fáng zi shè shī biàn lì qí quán
ex.en: The house has all the conveniences.

ex.zh: 我腰疼，不能打网球。
ex.p: wǒ yāo téng bù néng dá wǎng qiú
ex.en: I can't play tennis because my back hurts.

items.en: to complain; to grumble; to harbor a complaint

ex.zh: 有些乘客抱怨服务态度不好。
ex.p: yǒu xiē chéng kè bào yuàn fú wù tài du bù hǎo
ex.en: Some passengers complained about the service.

ex.zh: 他从早到晚只是在抱怨。
ex.p: tā cóng zǎo dào wǎn zhǐ shì zài bào yuàn
ex.en: He does nothing but complain from morning till night.

items.en: to go for; to engage in; to undertake

ex.zh: 你应该开始从事高尔夫。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi kāi shǐ cóng shì gāo ěr fu
ex.en: You should take up golf.

items.en: unrelated; having nothing to do (with sth else)

ex.zh: 你怎么想无关紧要。
ex.p: nǐ zěn me xiǎng wú guān jǐn yào
ex.en: It doesn't matter what you think.

ex.zh: 此事与我无关。
ex.p: cǐ shì yú wǒ wú guān
ex.en: This has nothing to do with me.

ex.zh: 这是您的义务。
ex.p: zhè shì nín de yì wù
ex.en: That's your responsibility.

ex.zh: 这是一个奇迹。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè qí jì
ex.en: This is a miracle.

ex.zh: 这药创造了奇迹。
ex.p: zhè yào chuàng zào le qí jì
ex.en: The medicine worked marvels.

items.en: to use; to put to use

ex.zh: 在她的帮助下，我的法语逐渐进步了。
ex.p: zài tā de bāng zhù xià wǒ de fǎ yǔ zhú jiàn jìn bù le
ex.en: With her help, my French improved little by little.

items.en: to set about (a task); to hit; to punch

ex.zh: 医生决定立刻动手术。
ex.p: yī shēng jué dìng lì kè dòng shǒu shù
ex.en: The doctor decided to operate at once.

items.en: to be close to; to approach; to draw near

ex.zh: 她一整天都沉默不语。
ex.p: tā yī zhěng tiān dōu chén mò bù yǔ
ex.en: She remained silent all day.

ex.zh: 自从他不知道该说什么的时候，便一直沉默着。
ex.p: zì cóng tā bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me de shí hou biàn yī zhí chén mò zhe
ex.en: Since he didn't know what to say, he remained silent.

ex.zh: 火车应当准点到。
ex.p: huǒ chē yīng dāng zhǔn diǎn dào
ex.en: The train should be on time.

ex.zh: 他觉得我理所应当知道答案。
ex.p: tā jué de wǒ lǐ suǒ yīng dāng zhī dào dá àn
ex.en: He took it for granted that I knew the answer.

items.en: to associate (with); to have contact (with); to hang out (with)
too bad; how terrible; what bad luck

ex.zh: 我还没觉得有那么糟糕。
ex.p: wǒ hái méi jué de yǒu nà me zāo gāo
ex.en: I didn't think it was so bad.

ex.zh: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。
ex.p: ràng shì qing gēng zāo gāo de shì tā méi yǒu zhù yì dào tā dǎ rǎo dào le lín jū
ex.en: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.

items.en: in the sky; in the air

ex.zh: 你能看到天空中的繁星。
ex.p: nǐ néng kàn dào tiān kōng zhōng de fán xīng
ex.en: You can see a lot of stars in the sky.

ex.zh: 天空中繁星点点。
ex.p: tiān kōng zhōng fán xīng diǎn diǎn
ex.en: The sky is full of stars.

items.en: to link; to join; to connect
a copy of a film; film; motion picture; movie
to tear open; to tear down; to tear apart

ex.zh: 没有人会为这个旧建筑物的拆除而落泪。
ex.p: méi yǒu rén huì wèi zhè gè jiù jiàn zhù wù de chāi chú ér là lèi
ex.en: Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.

items.en: to retire (from the workforce); to go into retirement

ex.zh: 我父亲六十岁就要退休了。
ex.p: wǒ fù qīn liù shí suì jiù yào tuì xiū le
ex.en: My father will retire at the age of sixty.

ex.zh: 我没有一点退休的念头。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī diǎn tuì xiū de niàn tou
ex.en: I don't have the slightest intention of retiring.

items.en: to treat as; to regard as

ex.zh: 从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。
ex.p: cóng tiān shàng kàn xià lai zhè tiáo hé xiàng yī tiáo jù shé
ex.en: Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.

items.en: to separate; to partition; to stand or lie between

ex.zh: 在火车的间隔中有漫长的等待。
ex.p: zài huǒ chē de jiàn gé zhōng yǒu màn cháng de děng dài
ex.en: There is a long wait between trains.

ex.zh: 他们之间隔着很远的距离。
ex.p: tā men zhī jiān gé zhe hěn yuǎn de jù lí
ex.en: They are separated by a great distance.

items.en: to equal; to be tantamount to

ex.zh: 二乘以二等于四。
ex.p: èr chéng yǐ èr děng yú sì
ex.en: Two times two is four.

ex.zh: 一加二等于三。
ex.p: yī jiā èr děng yú sān
ex.en: One plus two equals three.

ex.zh: 我明白这概念。
ex.p: wǒ míng bai zhè gài niàn
ex.en: I understand the concept.

ex.zh: 这条河是欧洲最宽的。
ex.p: zhè tiáo hé shì oū zhōu zuì kuān de
ex.en: This river is the widest in Europe.

items.en: statistics; to count; to add up
to create; to produce; to write

ex.zh: 抱歉，我不是本地人。
ex.p: bào qiàn wǒ bù shì běn dì rén
ex.en: I am sorry. I am not from here.

ex.zh: 据说他爸爸在外国去世了。
ex.p: jù shuō tā bà ba zài wài guó qù shì le
ex.en: It is said that his father died in a foreign country.

sents.p: zhè yào chuàng zào le qí jì
sents.en: The medicine worked marvels.

sents.zh: 在她的帮助下，我的法语逐渐进步了。
sents.p: zài tā de bāng zhù xià wǒ de fǎ yǔ zhú jiàn jìn bù le
sents.en: With her help, my French improved little by little.

sents.zh: 医生决定立刻动手术。
sents.p: yī shēng jué dìng lì kè dòng shǒu shù
sents.en: The doctor decided to operate at once.

sents.zh: 她一整天都沉默不语。
sents.p: tā yī zhěng tiān dōu chén mò bù yǔ
sents.en: She remained silent all day.

sents.zh: 自从他不知道该说什么的时候，便一直沉默着。
sents.p: zì cóng tā bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me de shí hou biàn yī zhí chén mò zhe
sents.en: Since he didn't know what to say, he remained silent.

sents.zh: 火车应当准点到。
sents.p: huǒ chē yīng dāng zhǔn diǎn dào
sents.en: The train should be on time.

sents.zh: 他觉得我理所应当知道答案。
sents.p: tā jué de wǒ lǐ suǒ yīng dāng zhī dào dá àn
sents.en: He took it for granted that I knew the answer.

sents.zh: 我还没觉得有那么糟糕。
sents.p: wǒ hái méi jué de yǒu nà me zāo gāo
sents.en: I didn't think it was so bad.

sents.zh: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。
sents.p: ràng shì qing gēng zāo gāo de shì tā méi yǒu zhù yì dào tā dǎ rǎo dào le lín jū
sents.en: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.

sents.zh: 没有人会为这个旧建筑物的拆除而落泪。
sents.p: méi yǒu rén huì wèi zhè gè jiù jiàn zhù wù de chāi chú ér là lèi
sents.en: Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.

sents.zh: 我父亲六十岁就要退休了。
sents.p: wǒ fù qīn liù shí suì jiù yào tuì xiū le
sents.en: My father will retire at the age of sixty.

sents.zh: 我没有一点退休的念头。
sents.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī diǎn tuì xiū de niàn tou
sents.en: I don't have the slightest intention of retiring.

sents.zh: 从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。
sents.p: cóng tiān shàng kàn xià lai zhè tiáo hé xiàng yī tiáo jù shé
sents.en: Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.

sents.zh: 在火车的间隔中有漫长的等待。
sents.p: zài huǒ chē de jiàn gé zhōng yǒu màn cháng de děng dài
sents.en: There is a long wait between trains.

sents.zh: 他们之间隔着很远的距离。
sents.p: tā men zhī jiān gé zhe hěn yuǎn de jù lí
sents.en: They are separated by a great distance.

sents.zh: 二乘以二等于四。
sents.p: èr chéng yǐ èr děng yú sì
sents.en: Two times two is four.

sents.zh: 一加二等于三。
sents.p: yī jiā èr děng yú sān
sents.en: One plus two equals three.

sents.zh: 我明白这概念。
sents.p: wǒ míng bai zhè gài niàn
sents.en: I understand the concept.

sents.zh: 这条河是欧洲最宽的。
sents.p: zhè tiáo hé shì oū zhōu zuì kuān de
sents.en: This river is the widest in Europe.

sents.zh: 抱歉，我不是本地人。
sents.p: bào qiàn wǒ bù shì běn dì rén
sents.en: I am sorry. I am not from here.

sents.zh: 据说他爸爸在外国去世了。
sents.p: jù shuō tā bà ba zài wài guó qù shì le
sents.en: It is said that his father died in a foreign country.

units.intro: Grammar focus: 之所以…是因为; 由此可见

ex.zh: 你成功与否取决于你自身的努力。
ex.p: nǐ chéng gōng yǔ fǒu qǔ jué yú nǐ zì shēn de nǔ lì
ex.en: Whether you succeed or not depends on your own efforts.

ex.zh: 她照顾她的父亲直到他去世。
ex.p: tā zhào gu tā de fù qīn zhí dào tā qù shì
ex.en: She cared for her father until his death.

ex.zh: 他去世三年了。
ex.p: tā qù shì sān nián le
ex.en: He has been dead for three years.

ex.zh: 这被认为是一件大事。
ex.p: zhè bèi rèn wéi shì yī jiàn dà shì
ex.en: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.

items.en: average; on average; evenly; in equal proportions

ex.zh: 选手们的平均身高是多少？
ex.p: xuǎn shǒu men de píng jūn shēn gāo shì duō shǎo
ex.en: What's the average height of the players?

ex.zh: 我会给你你想要的任何事物。
ex.p: wǒ huì gěi nǐ nǐ xiǎng yào de rèn hé shì wù
ex.en: I'll give you whatever you want.

ex.zh: 人们通常不喜欢他们不理解的事物。
ex.p: rén men tōng cháng bù xǐ huan tā men bù lǐ xiè de shì wù
ex.en: People usually don't like what they don't understand.

ex.zh: 我不能抓到他演讲的重点。
ex.p: wǒ bù néng zhuā dào tā yǎn jiǎng de chóng diǎn
ex.en: I couldn't get the point of his speech.

ex.zh: 我没有抓到他演讲的重点。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu zhuā dào tā yǎn jiǎng de chóng diǎn
ex.en: I didn't get the point of his speech.

ex.zh: 我们在严肃地谈论你的未来。
ex.p: wǒ men zài yán sù de tán lùn nǐ de wèi lái
ex.en: We are having a serious talk about your future.

ex.zh: 我们认为这不严肃。
ex.p: wǒ men rèn wéi zhè bù yán sù
ex.en: We don't think it's serious.

items.en: to bear (an expense, a responsibility etc); burden
to declare to be untrue; to deny

ex.zh: 我们无法否认，他确实是很诚实的人。
ex.p: wǒ men wú fǎ fǒu rèn tā què shí shì hěn chéng shí de rén
ex.en: We can't deny the fact that he's honest.

ex.zh: 无可否认她非常有能力。
ex.p: wú kě fǒu rèn tā fēi cháng yǒu néng lì
ex.en: There is no denying that she is very efficient.

ex.zh: 游泳锻炼肌肉。
ex.p: yóu yǒng duàn liàn jī ròu
ex.en: Swimming develops your muscles.

ex.zh: 我不知道该说什么来安慰你。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me lái ān wèi nǐ
ex.en: I don't know what to say to make you feel better.

ex.zh: 我可以安慰她。
ex.p: wǒ kě yǐ ān wèi tā
ex.en: I can comfort her.

items.en: to go up by one grade; to be promoted
to know from experience; to learn through experience; to realize
to cultivate; to train; to groom

ex.zh: 他想要减少进口品的税。
ex.p: tā xiǎng yào jiǎn shǎo jìn kǒu pǐn de shuì
ex.en: He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.

ex.zh: 这个价格含了税。
ex.p: zhè gè jià gé hán le shuì
ex.en: This amount includes tax.

ex.zh: 她把她儿子独自留在了车里。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā ér zi dú zì liú zài le chē lǐ
ex.en: She left her son alone in the car.

ex.zh: 我不相信孩子能独自到东京。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiāng xìn hái zi néng dú zì dào dōng jīng
ex.en: I don't believe the child came to Tokyo alone.

items.en: to expand; to enlarge; to broaden one's scope
to impel; to carry forward; to push on
to install; to erect; to fix

ex.zh: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu quán sōu chá nǐ de gōng yù
ex.en: We have a warrant to search your apartment.

ex.zh: 我只是个大众脸。
ex.p: wǒ zhǐ shì gè dà zhòng liǎn
ex.en: I'm just another man.

ex.zh: 假如能一个月之内还上的话，我可以把钱借给你。
ex.p: jiǎ rú néng yī gè yuè zhī nèi hái shǎng de huà wǒ kě yǐ bǎ qián jiè gěi nǐ
ex.en: I don't mind lending you the money provided you pay it back within a month.

ex.zh: 想象一下，假如你有一台时光机。
ex.p: xiǎng xiàng yī xià jiǎ rú nǐ yǒu yī tái shí guāng jī
ex.en: Imagine that you have a time machine.

ex.zh: 有很多的方法可以改善人的一生。
ex.p: yǒu hěn duō de fāng fǎ kě yǐ gǎi shàn rén de yī shēng
ex.en: There are many ways to improve one's life.

ex.zh: 我想改善我的英语发音。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng gǎi shàn wǒ de yīng yǔ fā yīn
ex.en: I would like to improve my English pronunciation.

ex.zh: 木质房屋很容易着火。
ex.p: mù zhì fáng wū hěn róng yì zháo huǒ
ex.en: A wooden building can easily catch fire.

ex.zh: 这是一所现代房屋。
ex.p: zhè shì yī suǒ xiàn dài fáng wū
ex.en: It's a modern house.

items.en: variant of 记录 (but in Taiwan, not for the verb sense "to record")

ex.zh: 农民总是抱怨天气。
ex.p: nóng mín zǒng shì bào yuàn tiān qì
ex.en: Farmers always complain about the weather.

ex.zh: 农民在春天播种。
ex.p: nóng mín zài chūn tiān bō zhǒng
ex.en: Farmers sow seeds in the spring.

items.en: to advise; to urge; to try to persuade
to fan; to slap sb on the face

ex.zh: 你有这扇门的钥匙吗？
ex.p: nǐ yǒu zhè shān mén de yào shi ma
ex.en: Do you have the key to this door?

ex.zh: 我想过扇你一巴掌。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng guò shān nǐ yī ba zhǎng
ex.en: I wanted to smack you.

items.en: to block up (a road, pipe etc); to stop up (a hole); wall (literary)
to treasure; to value; to cherish
to disseminate; to propagate; to spread

ex.zh: 阿司匹林是用什么做的？
ex.p: ā sī pī lín shì yòng shén me zuò de
ex.en: What is aspirin made of?

ex.zh: 他对什么都感好奇。
ex.p: tā duì shén me dōu gǎn hào qí
ex.en: He's curious about everything.

ex.zh: 她太过好奇，以至于打开了盒子。
ex.p: tā tài guò hào qí yǐ zhì yú dǎ kāi le hé zi
ex.en: She was so curious that she opened the box.

sents.en: At that moment, time seemed to stand still.

sents.zh: 铁路与公路平行。

sents.en: Go straight down this street and turn right at the third light.

sents.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。

sents.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.

sents.zh: 祝你一路顺风。
sents.p: zhù nǐ yī lù shùn fēng
sents.en: I hope you have a good trip.

sents.zh: 祝您一路顺风。
sents.p: zhù nín yī lù shùn fēng

units.title: History and traditions
units.intro: Grammar focus: Four-character idioms (成语) with their origin stories; first Tang poems (静夜思, 春晓)

ex.zh: 不正确的命题听起来可能符合逻辑。
ex.p: bù zhèng què de mìng tí yǐn qǐ lai kě néng fú hé luó ji
ex.en: An argument may be logically sound without being true.

ex.zh: 你说的话在逻辑上有问题。
ex.p: nǐ shuō de huà zài luó ji shǎng yǒu wèn tí
ex.en: What you're saying isn't logical.

items.en: to be good at; to be expert in

ex.zh: 我不太擅长打高尔夫球。
ex.p: wǒ bù tài shàn cháng dá gāo ěr fū qiú
ex.en: I'm not very good at golf.

ex.zh: 这不是我所擅长的事。
ex.p: zhè bù shì wǒ suǒ shàn cháng de shì
ex.en: It isn't something I'm very good at.

ex.zh: 那朵云对我来说像一只兔子。
ex.p: nà duǒ yún duì wǒ lái shuō xiàng yī zhǐ tù zi
ex.en: That cloud looks like a rabbit to me.

ex.zh: 兔子长着长长的耳朵和短短的尾巴。
ex.p: tù zi cháng zhe cháng cháng de ěr duo hé duǎn duǎn de wěi ba
ex.en: Rabbits have long ears and short tails.

items.en: to bend; bent; a bend; a turn (in a road etc)
to neglect; to overlook; to disregard; to ignore

ex.zh: 这种错误很容易被人忽视。
ex.p: zhè zhǒng cuò wù hěn róng yì bèi rén hū shì
ex.en: This kind of mistake is easy to overlook.

ex.zh: 哲学不是我们用六个月就能学的东西。
ex.p: zhé xué bù shì wǒ men yòng liù gè yuè jiù néng xué de dōng xī
ex.en: Philosophy is not a thing one can learn in six months.

ex.zh: 你有光明的未来。
ex.p: nǐ yǒu guāng míng de wèi lái
ex.en: You have a bright future.

items.en: esteemed guest; honored guest; guest (on a show)
to admit (a student); to hire (a job candidate)

ex.zh: 天空是浅蓝的。
ex.p: tiān kōng shì jiān lán de
ex.en: The sky is light blue.

items.en: practice; to put into practice; to live up to (a promise)

ex.zh: 理论上说，理论和实践没有区别。但实践上说，是有的。
ex.p: lǐ lùn shǎng shuō lǐ lùn hé shí jiàn méi yǒu qū bié dàn shí jiàn shǎng shuō shì yǒu de
ex.en: In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But, in practice, there is.

ex.zh: 我们怎样才能将其付出实践？
ex.p: wǒ men zěn yàng cái néng jiāng qí fù chū shí jiàn
ex.en: How can we put it into practice?

items.en: the present time; to be faced with
to improve; to take a turn for the better; improvement

ex.zh: 我们近期内的情况应该会好转。
ex.p: wǒ men jìn qī nèi de qíng kuàng yīng gāi huì hǎo zhuǎn
ex.en: Our situation should improve in the near future.

items.en: early period; early phase; early stage
seldom; rare; hard to come by

ex.zh: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù huì shuō yīng yǔ nǐ jiù hěn nán dé dào yī gè hǎo de zhí wèi
ex.en: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.

items.en: to talk about; to narrate; to give an account

ex.zh: 他给我讲述了他的一生。
ex.p: tā gěi wǒ jiǎng shù le tā de yī shēng
ex.en: He told me the story of his life.

items.en: previously; formerly; once upon a time

ex.zh: 从前有个美丽的公主。
ex.p: cóng qián yǒu gè měi lì de gōng zhǔ
ex.en: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess.

items.en: (used in the names of grand buildings such as 百老汇大厦 Broadway Mansions (in Shangh

ex.zh: 他们的货品有着最高的品质。
ex.p: tā men de huò pǐn yǒu zhe zuì gāo de pǐn zhì
ex.en: Their goods are of the highest quality.

ex.zh: 这些产品的品质是一样的。
ex.p: zhè xiē chǎn pǐn de pǐn zhì shì yī yàng de
ex.en: The quality of these products is the same.

items.en: to prevent; to take precautions against; to protect

ex.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。
ex.p: yù fáng cuò shī bǐ zhēn zhèng de zhì liáo gēng yǒu xiào

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第92单元

History and traditions

Grammar focus: Four-character idioms (成语) with their origin stories; first Tang poems (静夜思, 春晓)

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 不正确的命题听起来可能符合逻辑。
sents.p: bù zhèng què de mìng tí yǐn qǐ lai kě néng fú hé luó ji
sents.en: An argument may be logically sound without being true.

sents.zh: 你说的话在逻辑上有问题。
sents.p: nǐ shuō de huà zài luó ji shǎng yǒu wèn tí
sents.en: What you're saying isn't logical.

sents.zh: 我不太擅长打高尔夫球。
sents.p: wǒ bù tài shàn cháng dá gāo ěr fū qiú
sents.en: I'm not very good at golf.

sents.zh: 这不是我所擅长的事。
sents.p: zhè bù shì wǒ suǒ shàn cháng de shì
sents.en: It isn't something I'm very good at.

sents.zh: 那朵云对我来说像一只兔子。
sents.p: nà duǒ yún duì wǒ lái shuō xiàng yī zhǐ tù zi
sents.en: That cloud looks like a rabbit to me.

sents.zh: 兔子长着长长的耳朵和短短的尾巴。
sents.p: tù zi cháng zhe cháng cháng de ěr duo hé duǎn duǎn de wěi ba
sents.en: Rabbits have long ears and short tails.

sents.zh: 这种错误很容易被人忽视。
sents.p: zhè zhǒng cuò wù hěn róng yì bèi rén hū shì
sents.en: This kind of mistake is easy to overlook.

sents.zh: 哲学不是我们用六个月就能学的东西。
sents.p: zhé xué bù shì wǒ men yòng liù gè yuè jiù néng xué de dōng xī
sents.en: Philosophy is not a thing one can learn in six months.

sents.zh: 你有光明的未来。
sents.p: nǐ yǒu guāng míng de wèi lái
sents.en: You have a bright future.

sents.zh: 天空是浅蓝的。
sents.p: tiān kōng shì jiān lán de
sents.en: The sky is light blue.

sents.zh: 理论上说，理论和实践没有区别。但实践上说，是有的。
sents.p: lǐ lùn shǎng shuō lǐ lùn hé shí jiàn méi yǒu qū bié dàn shí jiàn shǎng shuō shì yǒu de
sents.en: In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But, in practice, there is.

sents.zh: 我们怎样才能将其付出实践？
sents.p: wǒ men zěn yàng cái néng jiāng qí fù chū shí jiàn
sents.en: How can we put it into practice?

sents.zh: 我们近期内的情况应该会好转。
sents.p: wǒ men jìn qī nèi de qíng kuàng yīng gāi huì hǎo zhuǎn
sents.en: Our situation should improve in the near future.

sents.zh: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù huì shuō yīng yǔ nǐ jiù hěn nán dé dào yī gè hǎo de zhí wèi
sents.en: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.

sents.zh: 他给我讲述了他的一生。
sents.p: tā gěi wǒ jiǎng shù le tā de yī shēng
sents.en: He told me the story of his life.

sents.zh: 从前有个美丽的公主。
sents.p: cóng qián yǒu gè měi lì de gōng zhǔ
sents.en: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess.

sents.zh: 他们的货品有着最高的品质。
sents.p: tā men de huò pǐn yǒu zhe zuì gāo de pǐn zhì
sents.en: Their goods are of the highest quality.

sents.zh: 这些产品的品质是一样的。
sents.p: zhè xiē chǎn pǐn de pǐn zhì shì yī yàng de
sents.en: The quality of these products is the same.

sents.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。
sents.p: yù fáng cuò shī bǐ zhēn zhèng de zhì liáo gēng yǒu xiào
sents.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.

sents.zh: 我决不会忘记去年与总统握手的情景。

sents.zh: 我不相信商人。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiāng xìn shāng rén
sents.en: I don't trust businessmen.

sents.zh: 我不认为那可以变得更糟
sents.p: wǒ bù rèn wéi nà kě yǐ biàn de gēng zāo
sents.en: I don't think that it can get any worse.

sents.zh: 没有什么比战争更糟的了。
sents.p: méi yǒu shén me bǐ zhàn zhēng gēng zāo de le
sents.en: Nothing is worse than war.

sents.zh: 他有几分像学者。
sents.p: tā yǒu jī fēn xiàng xué zhě
sents.en: He is something of a scholar.

sents.p: shǒu xù fèi shì duō shǎo
sents.en: How much is the commission?

items.en: to revolve around; to center on (an issue)
to reduce; to decrease; to shrink

ex.zh: 我完全是在偶然的情况下发现了密室。
ex.p: wǒ wán quán shì zài ǒu rán de qíng kuàng xià fā xiàn le mì shì
ex.en: I found the secret compartment quite by accident.

ex.zh: 我偶然发现了那家餐馆。
ex.p: wǒ ǒu rán fā xiàn le nà jiā cān guǎn
ex.en: I found that restaurant by accident.

items.en: reception (of transmitted signal); to receive; to accept

ex.zh: 这句句子意思模糊。
ex.p: zhè gōu jù zi yì si mó hu
ex.en: The meaning of this sentence is obscure.

ex.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào xiǎn wēi jìng hé wàng yuǎn jìng de chā bié ma
ex.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?

ex.zh: 两者之间有显著的差别。
ex.p: liǎng zhě zhī jiān yǒu xiǎn zhù de chā bié
ex.en: There are noticeable differences between the two.

items.en: to approve; to endorse; (literary) to assist

ex.zh: 让我来告诉你我不赞成你的理由。
ex.p: ràng wǒ lái gào sù nǐ wǒ bù zàn chéng nǐ de lǐ yóu
ex.en: Let me tell you the reasons that I don't agree with you.

ex.zh: 很抱歉那个问题我不赞成你。
ex.p: hěn bào qiàn nà gè wèn tí wǒ bù zàn chéng nǐ
ex.en: I'm sorry I don't agree with you on that matter.

items.en: to replace the old with new; to renew; to renovate

ex.zh: 我必须更新我的护照。
ex.p: wǒ bì xū gēng xīn wǒ de hù zhào
ex.en: I must renew my passport.

items.en: to duplicate; to make a copy of; to copy

ex.zh: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。
ex.p: bù yào yīn wèi chī de tài duō ér rǎo luàn wèi de zhèng cháng xiāo huà
ex.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.

items.en: to receive (a visitor); to admit (allow sb to enter)

ex.zh: 这个家庭热情地接待了我。
ex.p: zhè gè jiā tíng rè qíng de jiē dài le wǒ
ex.en: This family gave me a warm welcome.

items.en: to push (e.g. for acceptance of a plan); to promote; to give impetus to

ex.zh: 在某种程度上你是对的，但我还是有疑问。
ex.p: zài mǒu zhǒng chéng dù shǎng nǐ shì duì de dàn wǒ hái shi yǒu yí wèn
ex.en: In a way you're right, but I still have doubts.

items.en: to wrap up; to bind up; bundle

ex.zh: 你空闲时间喜欢做什么？
ex.p: nǐ kòng xián shí jiān xǐ huan zuò shén me
ex.en: What do you like doing in your free time?

ex.zh: 您空闲时间喜欢做什么？
ex.p: nín kòng xián shí jiān xǐ huan zuò shén me
ex.en: What do you like doing in your free time?

items.en: to be good at; to be adept at

ex.zh: 他不善于记人名。
ex.p: tā bù shàn yú jì rén míng
ex.en: He's not good at remembering names.

items.en: to originate; to initiate; to launch (an attack, an initiative etc)

ex.zh: 这张沙发起码可以坐三个人。
ex.p: zhè zhāng shā fā qǐ mǎ kě yǐ zuò sān gè rén
ex.en: This sofa can seat three people easily.

items.en: to put to use; to apply; practical

ex.zh: 有它的应用吗？
ex.p: yǒu tā de yìng yòng ma
ex.en: Is there an app for that?

ex.zh: 我删除了这个应用。
ex.p: wǒ shān chú le zhè gè yìng yòng
ex.en: I deleted the app.

ex.zh: 我们有一些令人鼓舞的消息。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu yī xiē líng rén gǔ wǔ de xiāo xi
ex.en: We have some encouraging news.

ex.zh: 没有人鼓励他。
ex.p: méi yǒu rén gǔ lì tā
ex.en: Nobody encouraged him.

items.en: for the most part; many; most

ex.zh: 大多数的事故都发生在家附近。
ex.p: dà duō shù de shì gù dōu fā shēng zài jiā fù jìn
ex.en: Most accidents happen near home.

ex.zh: 大多数美国人似乎不反对我直呼其名。
ex.p: dà duō shù měi guó rén sì hū bù fǎn duì wǒ zhí hū qí míng
ex.en: Most Americans do not object to my calling them by their first names.

ex.zh: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。
ex.p: shí jiān shì shì jiè shǎng zuì bǎo guì de dōng xī
ex.en: Time is the most precious thing in the world.

ex.zh: 时间比什么都宝贵。
ex.p: shí jiān bǐ shén me dōu bǎo guì
ex.en: Time is more precious than anything else.

ex.zh: 日本的石油依靠进口。
ex.p: rì běn de shí yóu yī kào jìn kǒu
ex.en: Japan depends on other countries for oil.

ex.zh: 他想要减少进口品的税。
ex.p: tā xiǎng yào jiǎn shǎo jìn kǒu pǐn de shuì
ex.en: He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.

ex.zh: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。
ex.p: gōng chéng shī gào sù wǒ men rú hé shǐ yòng jī qì
ex.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.

ex.zh: 我决定当个工程师。
ex.p: wǒ jué dìng dāng gè gōng chéng shī
ex.en: I've decided to become an engineer.

ex.zh: 我要几个土豆。
ex.p: wǒ yào jī gè tǔ dòu
ex.en: I want some potatoes.

ex.zh: 把土豆切一下。
ex.p: bǎ tǔ dòu qiē yī xià
ex.en: Cut the potatoes.

items.en: to put on display; to exhibit; exhibition

ex.zh: 展览现在已经开放。
ex.p: zhǎn lǎn xiàn zài yǐ jīng kāi fàng
ex.en: The exhibition is now open.

items.en: to travel along a route (of vehicles etc)
to exceed; to overstep; to go too far
eating and drinking; food and drink; diet

ex.zh: 蔬果对平衡饮食必不可少。
ex.p: shū guǒ duì píng héng yǐn shí bì bù kě shǎo
ex.en: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.

ex.zh: 他停下脚步看起海报。
ex.p: tā tíng xià jiǎo bù kàn qǐ hǎi bào
ex.en: He paused to look at the poster.

items.en: (of systems, facilities etc) comprehensive; well-developed; excellent

ex.zh: 对猴子来说，爬树很容易。
ex.p: duì hóu zi lái shuō pá shù hěn róng yì
ex.en: It is easy for a monkey to climb a tree.

ex.zh: 山上无老虎，猴子称大王。
ex.p: shān shǎng wú lǎo hǔ hóu zi chèn dà wáng
ex.en: When the cat's away, the mice will play.

ex.zh: 我非常享受你的陪伴。
ex.p: wǒ fēi cháng xiǎng shòu nǐ de péi bàn
ex.en: I really enjoy your company.

ex.zh: 你已经有人陪伴了。
ex.p: nǐ yǐ jīng yǒu rén péi bàn le
ex.en: You've got company.

ex.zh: 我妈妈眼含着泪看我。
ex.p: wǒ mā ma yǎn hán zhe lèi kàn wǒ
ex.en: My mother looked at me with tears in her eyes.

ex.zh: 这个梯子是否足够坚固以承受我的重量？
ex.p: zhè gè tī zi shì fǒu zú gòu jiān gù yǐ chéng shòu wǒ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?

ex.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。
ex.p: qián bì de jià zhí qǔ jué yú suǒ shǐ yòng de jīn shǔ de zhòng liàng
ex.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第93单元

History and traditions

Grammar focus: Four-character idioms (成语) with their origin stories; first Tang poems (静夜思, 春晓)

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 我完全是在偶然的情况下发现了密室。
sents.p: wǒ wán quán shì zài ǒu rán de qíng kuàng xià fā xiàn le mì shì
sents.en: I found the secret compartment quite by accident.

sents.zh: 我偶然发现了那家餐馆。
sents.p: wǒ ǒu rán fā xiàn le nà jiā cān guǎn
sents.en: I found that restaurant by accident.

sents.zh: 这句句子意思模糊。
sents.p: zhè gōu jù zi yì si mó hu
sents.en: The meaning of this sentence is obscure.

sents.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào xiǎn wēi jìng hé wàng yuǎn jìng de chā bié ma
sents.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?

sents.zh: 两者之间有显著的差别。
sents.p: liǎng zhě zhī jiān yǒu xiǎn zhù de chā bié
sents.en: There are noticeable differences between the two.

sents.zh: 让我来告诉你我不赞成你的理由。
sents.p: ràng wǒ lái gào sù nǐ wǒ bù zàn chéng nǐ de lǐ yóu
sents.en: Let me tell you the reasons that I don't agree with you.

sents.zh: 很抱歉那个问题我不赞成你。
sents.p: hěn bào qiàn nà gè wèn tí wǒ bù zàn chéng nǐ
sents.en: I'm sorry I don't agree with you on that matter.

sents.zh: 我必须更新我的护照。
sents.p: wǒ bì xū gēng xīn wǒ de hù zhào
sents.en: I must renew my passport.

sents.zh: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。
sents.p: bù yào yīn wèi chī de tài duō ér rǎo luàn wèi de zhèng cháng xiāo huà
sents.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.

sents.zh: 这个家庭热情地接待了我。
sents.p: zhè gè jiā tíng rè qíng de jiē dài le wǒ
sents.en: This family gave me a warm welcome.

sents.zh: 在某种程度上你是对的，但我还是有疑问。
sents.p: zài mǒu zhǒng chéng dù shǎng nǐ shì duì de dàn wǒ hái shi yǒu yí wèn
sents.en: In a way you're right, but I still have doubts.

sents.zh: 你空闲时间喜欢做什么？
sents.p: nǐ kòng xián shí jiān xǐ huan zuò shén me
sents.en: What do you like doing in your free time?

sents.zh: 您空闲时间喜欢做什么？
sents.p: nín kòng xián shí jiān xǐ huan zuò shén me
sents.en: What do you like doing in your free time?

sents.zh: 他不善于记人名。
sents.p: tā bù shàn yú jì rén míng
sents.en: He's not good at remembering names.

sents.zh: 这张沙发起码可以坐三个人。
sents.p: zhè zhāng shā fā qǐ mǎ kě yǐ zuò sān gè rén
sents.en: This sofa can seat three people easily.

sents.zh: 有它的应用吗？
sents.p: yǒu tā de yìng yòng ma
sents.en: Is there an app for that?

sents.zh: 我删除了这个应用。
sents.p: wǒ shān chú le zhè gè yìng yòng
sents.en: I deleted the app.

sents.zh: 我们有一些令人鼓舞的消息。
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu yī xiē líng rén gǔ wǔ de xiāo xi
sents.en: We have some encouraging news.

sents.zh: 没有人鼓励他。
sents.p: méi yǒu rén gǔ lì tā
sents.en: Nobody encouraged him.

sents.zh: 大多数的事故都发生在家附近。
sents.p: dà duō shù de shì gù dōu fā shēng zài jiā fù jìn
sents.en: Most accidents happen near home.

sents.zh: 大多数美国人似乎不反对我直呼其名。
sents.p: dà duō shù měi guó rén sì hū bù fǎn duì wǒ zhí hū qí míng
sents.en: Most Americans do not object to my calling them by their first names.

sents.zh: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。
sents.p: shí jiān shì shì jiè shǎng zuì bǎo guì de dōng xī
sents.en: Time is the most precious thing in the world.

sents.zh: 时间比什么都宝贵。
sents.p: shí jiān bǐ shén me dōu bǎo guì
sents.en: Time is more precious than anything else.

sents.zh: 日本的石油依靠进口。
sents.p: rì běn de shí yóu yī kào jìn kǒu
sents.en: Japan depends on other countries for oil.

sents.zh: 他想要减少进口品的税。
sents.p: tā xiǎng yào jiǎn shǎo jìn kǒu pǐn de shuì
sents.en: He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.

sents.zh: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。
sents.p: gōng chéng shī gào sù wǒ men rú hé shǐ yòng jī qì
sents.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.

sents.zh: 我决定当个工程师。
sents.p: wǒ jué dìng dāng gè gōng chéng shī
sents.en: I've decided to become an engineer.

sents.zh: 我要几个土豆。
sents.p: wǒ yào jī gè tǔ dòu
sents.en: I want some potatoes.

sents.zh: 把土豆切一下。
sents.p: bǎ tǔ dòu qiē yī xià
sents.en: Cut the potatoes.

sents.zh: 展览现在已经开放。
sents.p: zhǎn lǎn xiàn zài yǐ jīng kāi fàng
sents.en: The exhibition is now open.

sents.zh: 蔬果对平衡饮食必不可少。
sents.p: shū guǒ duì píng héng yǐn shí bì bù kě shǎo
sents.en: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.

sents.zh: 他停下脚步看起海报。
sents.p: tā tíng xià jiǎo bù kàn qǐ hǎi bào
sents.en: He paused to look at the poster.

sents.zh: 对猴子来说，爬树很容易。
sents.p: duì hóu zi lái shuō pá shù hěn róng yì
sents.en: It is easy for a monkey to climb a tree.

sents.zh: 山上无老虎，猴子称大王。
sents.p: shān shǎng wú lǎo hǔ hóu zi chèn dà wáng
sents.en: When the cat's away, the mice will play.

sents.zh: 我非常享受你的陪伴。
sents.p: wǒ fēi cháng xiǎng shòu nǐ de péi bàn
sents.en: I really enjoy your company.

sents.zh: 你已经有人陪伴了。
sents.p: nǐ yǐ jīng yǒu rén péi bàn le
sents.en: You've got company.

sents.zh: 我妈妈眼含着泪看我。
sents.p: wǒ mā ma yǎn hán zhe lèi kàn wǒ
sents.en: My mother looked at me with tears in her eyes.

sents.zh: 这个梯子是否足够坚固以承受我的重量？
sents.p: zhè gè tī zi shì fǒu zú gòu jiān gù yǐ chéng shòu wǒ de zhòng liàng
sents.en: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?

sents.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。
sents.p: qián bì de jià zhí qǔ jué yú suǒ shǐ yòng de jīn shǔ de zhòng liàng
sents.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.

units.title: History and traditions
units.intro: Grammar focus: Four-character idioms (成语) with their origin stories; first Tang poems (静夜思, 春晓)

items.en: well-developed; flourishing; to develop; to promote; to expand
to submit (a report etc); to refer (a problem) to sb

ex.zh: 我能跟任何人工作。
ex.p: wǒ néng gēn rèn hé rén gōng zuō
ex.en: I can work with anyone.

ex.zh: 我们经常听说日本人工作勤奋。
ex.p: wǒ men jīng cháng tīng shuō rì běn rén gōng zuò qín fèn
ex.en: We often hear it said that the Japanese are good workers.

items.en: trustworthiness; (commerce) credit; (literary) to trust and appoint

ex.zh: 可以用万事达信用卡吗？
ex.p: kě yǐ yòng mò shì dá xìn yòng kǎ ma
ex.en: Do you take MasterCard?

ex.zh: 我能用信用卡支付吗？
ex.p: wǒ néng yòng xìn yòng kǎ zhī fù ma
ex.en: May I pay with a credit card?

ex.zh: 昨天上午下大雨。
ex.p: zuó tiān shàng wǔ xià dà yǔ
ex.en: It rained hard yesterday morning.

ex.zh: 我每天上教堂。
ex.p: wǒ měi tiān shàng jiào táng
ex.en: I go to church every day.

items.en: to recycle; to reclaim; to retrieve

ex.zh: 那房子因为其少有的形状被突显出来。
ex.p: nà fáng zi yīn wèi qí shǎo yǒu de xíng zhuàng bèi tū xiǎn chū lái
ex.en: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.

items.en: depth; (of a speech etc) profundity; advanced stage of development

ex.zh: 我们测量了这条河的深度。
ex.p: wǒ men cè liáng le zhè tiáo hé de shēn dù
ex.en: We measured the depth of the river.

ex.zh: 这个穷小子最后成为了一个了不起的艺术家。
ex.p: zhè gè qióng xiǎo zǐ zuì hòu chéng wéi le yī gè liǎo bù qǐ de yì shù jiā
ex.en: The poor young man finally became a great artist.

ex.zh: 你是位了不起的女性。
ex.p: nǐ shì wèi liǎo bù qǐ de nǚ xìng
ex.en: You're a wonderful woman.

items.en: to stay somewhere temporarily; to stop over

ex.zh: 在这停留，这不可能。
ex.p: zài zhè tíng liú zhè bù kě néng
ex.en: It's not possible to stop here.

ex.zh: 她多停留了五天。
ex.p: tā duō tíng liú le wǔ tiān
ex.en: She extended her stay by five days.

ex.zh: 你的名字已经从名单删除了。
ex.p: nǐ de míng zi yǐ jīng cóng míng dān shān chú le
ex.en: Your name has been crossed off the list.

ex.zh: 我觉得我是误删了这个文件。
ex.p: wǒ jué de wǒ shì wù shān le zhè gè wén jiàn
ex.en: I think I mistakenly deleted that file.

items.en: Yanchang county in Yan'an 安, Shaanxi

ex.zh: 我想延长这里的住宿多几天。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yán cháng zhè lǐ de zhù sù duō jī tiān
ex.en: I want to extend my stay here for a few more days.

ex.zh: 他的要求如下。
ex.p: tā de yāo qiú rú xià
ex.en: His request is as follows.

items.en: to practice; field work; to intern
to launch; to develop; to unfold

ex.zh: 这是场长久的战争。
ex.p: zhè shì cháng cháng jiǔ de zhàn zhēng
ex.en: It's been a long war.

items.en: to extend; to spread; to popularize

ex.zh: 因为闹铃没有响，所以我继续睡下去了。
ex.p: yīn wèi nào líng méi yǒu xiǎng suǒ yǐ wǒ jì xù shuì xià qù le
ex.en: I overslept because my alarm didn't go off.

ex.zh: 门铃响的时候，我正准备出门。
ex.p: mén líng xiǎng de shí hou wǒ zhēng zhǔn bèi chū mén
ex.en: I was about to leave when the doorbell rang.

items.en: to view as; to see as; to consider to be

ex.zh: 我把你视为我最要好的朋友之一。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ nǐ shì wéi wǒ zuì yào hǎo de péng you zhī yī
ex.en: I consider you one of my closest friends.

ex.zh: 他被视为村里最好的医生。
ex.p: tā bèi shì wéi cūn lǐ zuì hǎo de yī shēng
ex.en: He is regarded as the best doctor in the village.

ex.zh: 我觉得他有几分像个诗人。
ex.p: wǒ jué de tā yǒu jī fēn xiàng gè shī rén
ex.en: I think he is something of a poet.

items.en: to interrupt; to break off; to break (a bone)

ex.zh: 他打断了我们的谈论。
ex.p: tā dǎ duàn le wǒ men de tán lùn
ex.en: He interrupted our conversation.

ex.zh: 我们没有打断。
ex.p: wǒ men méi yǒu dǎ duàn
ex.en: We didn't break in.

items.en: to pay attention to; to emphasize

ex.zh: 请在被叫到名字之前坐在椅子上等候。
ex.p: qǐng zài bèi jiào dào míng zi zhī qián zuò zài yǐ zi shǎng děng hòu
ex.en: Please have a seat and wait until your name is called.

ex.zh: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。
ex.p: diàn huà yùn yíng shāng tí shì lái diàn rén děng hòu jiē tōng
ex.en: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.

items.en: area (of a floor, piece of land etc); surface area; tract of land

ex.zh: 我在我的院子里种了棵桃树。
ex.p: wǒ zài wǒ de yuàn zi lǐ zhǒng le kē táo shù
ex.en: I planted a peach tree in my yard.

ex.zh: 你想拿多少桃子就拿多少。
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng ná duō shǎo táo zǐ jiù ná duō shǎo
ex.en: Take as many peaches as you like.

ex.zh: 她用力地拍了球。
ex.p: tā yòng lì de pāi le qiú
ex.en: She hit the ball hard.

sents.en: I want to extend my stay here for a few more days.

sents.zh: 他的要求如下。
sents.p: tā de yāo qiú rú xià
sents.en: His request is as follows.

sents.p: zhè shì cháng cháng jiǔ de zhàn zhēng

sents.zh: 因为闹铃没有响，所以我继续睡下去了。
sents.p: yīn wèi nào líng méi yǒu xiǎng suǒ yǐ wǒ jì xù shuì xià qù le
sents.en: I overslept because my alarm didn't go off.

sents.zh: 门铃响的时候，我正准备出门。
sents.p: mén líng xiǎng de shí hou wǒ zhēng zhǔn bèi chū mén
sents.en: I was about to leave when the doorbell rang.

sents.zh: 我把你视为我最要好的朋友之一。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ nǐ shì wéi wǒ zuì yào hǎo de péng you zhī yī
sents.en: I consider you one of my closest friends.

sents.zh: 他被视为村里最好的医生。
sents.p: tā bèi shì wéi cūn lǐ zuì hǎo de yī shēng
sents.en: He is regarded as the best doctor in the village.

sents.zh: 我觉得他有几分像个诗人。
sents.p: wǒ jué de tā yǒu jī fēn xiàng gè shī rén
sents.en: I think he is something of a poet.

sents.zh: 他打断了我们的谈论。
sents.p: tā dǎ duàn le wǒ men de tán lùn
sents.en: He interrupted our conversation.

sents.zh: 我们没有打断。
sents.p: wǒ men méi yǒu dǎ duàn
sents.en: We didn't break in.

sents.zh: 请在被叫到名字之前坐在椅子上等候。
sents.p: qǐng zài bèi jiào dào míng zi zhī qián zuò zài yǐ zi shǎng děng hòu
sents.en: Please have a seat and wait until your name is called.

sents.zh: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。

sents.en: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.

sents.zh: 我在我的院子里种了棵桃树。
sents.p: wǒ zài wǒ de yuàn zi lǐ zhǒng le kē táo shù
sents.en: I planted a peach tree in my yard.

sents.zh: 你想拿多少桃子就拿多少。
sents.p: nǐ xiǎng ná duō shǎo táo zǐ jiù ná duō shǎo
sents.en: Take as many peaches as you like.

sents.zh: 她用力地拍了球。
sents.p: tā yòng lì de pāi le qiú
sents.en: She hit the ball hard.

ex.zh: 她能很准确地评估投资。
ex.p: tā néng hěn zhǔn què de píng gū tóu zī
ex.en: She can assess investments very accurately.

ex.zh: 欢迎作任何评论。
ex.p: huān yíng zuō rèn hé píng lùn
ex.en: Any comments are welcome.

ex.zh: 那是人类第一次在月球上行走。
ex.p: nà shì rén lèi dì yī cì zài yuè qiú shǎng xíng zǒu
ex.en: That was the first time that a man walked on the moon.

ex.zh: 你可以想象在月球上行走吗？
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ xiǎng xiàng zài yuè qiú shǎng xíng zǒu ma
ex.en: Can you imagine walking on the moon?

ex.zh: 兔子有长耳朵和短尾巴。
ex.p: tù zi yǒu cháng ěr duo hé duǎn wěi ba
ex.en: Rabbits have long ears and short tails.

ex.zh: 孩子抓住了猫的尾巴。
ex.p: hái zi zhuā zhù le māo de wěi ba
ex.en: The child caught the cat by the tail.

ex.p: tā hé tā de péng you wò shǒu
ex.en: He shook hands with his friend.

ex.zh: 他拒绝跟我握手。
ex.p: tā jù jué gēn wǒ wò shǒu
ex.en: He refused to shake hands with me.

ex.p: tā de dà bù fen shōu rù fù le zū jīn
ex.en: The majority of his income goes to pay his rent.

ex.zh: 你应该提前付租金。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi tí qián fù zū jīn
ex.en: You should pay your rent in advance.

ex.p: nài xīn duì yī gè jiào shī lái shuō shì bì xū de

ex.p: yào zhù zài jiāo qū de huà qì chē shì bì xū de

ex.p: qǐng bǎ yán dì gěi wǒ ná zhe

ex.p: wǒ yǐ jīng dòu guò hěn duō zhǒng lèi de shū le
ex.en: I've read many kinds of books.

ex.p: nǐ xiǎng kàn nǎ zhǒng lèi xíng de diàn yǐng
