lessons.html:
HSK 5 · 第96单元

Arguing a point

Grammar focus: 总之; 何况; 不见得; a 400-character opinion essay

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 她能很准确地评估投资。
sents.p: tā néng hěn zhǔn què de píng gū tóu zī
sents.en: She can assess investments very accurately.

sents.zh: 欢迎作任何评论。
sents.p: huān yíng zuō rèn hé píng lùn
sents.en: Any comments are welcome.

sents.zh: 那是人类第一次在月球上行走。
sents.p: nà shì rén lèi dì yī cì zài yuè qiú shǎng xíng zǒu
sents.en: That was the first time that a man walked on the moon.

sents.zh: 你可以想象在月球上行走吗？
sents.p: nǐ kě yǐ xiǎng xiàng zài yuè qiú shǎng xíng zǒu ma
sents.en: Can you imagine walking on the moon?

sents.zh: 兔子有长耳朵和短尾巴。
sents.p: tù zi yǒu cháng ěr duo hé duǎn wěi ba
sents.en: Rabbits have long ears and short tails.

sents.zh: 孩子抓住了猫的尾巴。
sents.p: hái zi zhuā zhù le māo de wěi ba
sents.en: The child caught the cat by the tail.

sents.zh: 他和他的朋友握手。
sents.p: tā hé tā de péng you wò shǒu
sents.en: He shook hands with his friend.

sents.zh: 他拒绝跟我握手。
sents.p: tā jù jué gēn wǒ wò shǒu
sents.en: He refused to shake hands with me.

sents.zh: 他的大部分收入付了租金。
sents.p: tā de dà bù fen shōu rù fù le zū jīn
sents.en: The majority of his income goes to pay his rent.

sents.zh: 你应该提前付租金。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi tí qián fù zū jīn
sents.en: You should pay your rent in advance.

sents.zh: 总体上说，日本人很保守。
sents.p: zǒng tǐ shǎng shuō rì běn rén hěn bǎo shǒu
sents.en: On the whole, the Japanese are conservative.

sents.zh: 这道题目没有一位老师会做。
sents.p: zhè dào tí mù méi yǒu yī wèi lǎo shī huì zuò
sents.en: None of the teachers could solve the problem.

sents.zh: 电脑为我们节省了很多时间，解决了很多问题。
sents.p: diàn nǎo wèi wǒ men jié shěng le hěn duō shí jiān jiě jué le hěn duō wèn tí
sents.en: Computers save us a lot of time and trouble.

sents.zh: 你为什么戴那条围巾？
sents.p: nǐ wèi shén me dài nà tiáo wéi jīn
sents.en: Why are you wearing that scarf?

sents.zh: 你现在可以删除它。
sents.p: nǐ xiàn zài kě yǐ shān chú tā
sents.en: You can delete that now.

sents.zh: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào zěn me huī fù yǐ shān chú de wén jiàn ma
sents.en: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?

sents.zh: 我们要在海边在烧烤架上烤肉。
sents.p: wǒ men yào zài hǎi biān zài shāo kǎo jià shǎng kǎo ròu
sents.en: We'll have a barbecue at the beach.

sents.zh: 我喜欢烧烤食物。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan shāo kǎo shí wù
sents.en: I love barbecue.

sents.zh: 耐心对一个教师来说是必需的。
sents.p: nài xīn duì yī gè jiào shī lái shuō shì bì xū de
sents.en: Patience is essential for a teacher.

sents.zh: 要住在郊区的话，汽车是必需的。
sents.p: yào zhù zài jiāo qū de huà qì chē shì bì xū de
sents.en: A car is a must for life in the suburbs.

sents.zh: 可以把牛奶递给我吗？
sents.p: kě yǐ bǎ niú nǎi dì gěi wǒ ma
sents.en: Can you pass me the milk?

sents.zh: “请把盐递给我。”“拿着。”
sents.p: qǐng bǎ yán dì gěi wǒ ná zhe
sents.en: "Pass me the salt, please." "Here you are."

sents.zh: 父母承担教育子女的责任。
sents.p: fù mǔ chéng dān jiào yù zǐ nǚ de zé rèn
sents.en: Parents are responsible for their children's education.

sents.zh: 我觉得我们需要一个打包盒。
sents.p: wǒ jué de wǒ men xū yào yī gè dǎ bāo hé
sents.en: I think we need a doggy bag.

sents.zh: 我当时正忙着打包，因为我两天后要去法国。
sents.p: wǒ dāng shí zhēng máng zhe dǎ bāo yīn wèi wǒ liǎng tiān hòu yào qù fǎ guó
sents.en: I was busy packing, because I was leaving for France in two days.

sents.zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。
sents.p: tā dìng qī qù kàn yá yī suǒ yǐ tā hěn shǎo yá tòng
sents.en: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.

sents.zh: 太空跑步是历史上激动人心的时刻。
sents.p: tài kōng pǎo bù shì lì shǐ shǎng jī dòng rén xīn de shí kè
sents.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.

sents.zh: 我已经读过很多种类的书了。
sents.p: wǒ yǐ jīng dòu guò hěn duō zhǒng lèi de shū le
sents.en: I've read many kinds of books.

sents.zh: 你想看哪种类型的电影？
sents.p: nǐ xiǎng kàn nǎ zhǒng lèi xíng de diàn yǐng
sents.en: What kind of movie do you want to watch?

sents.zh: 新鲜的水果对你的健康有益。
sents.p: xīn xiān de shuǐ guǒ duì nǐ de jiàn kāng yǒu yì
sents.en: Fresh fruit is good for your health.

sents.zh: 深呼吸有益健康。
sents.p: shēn hū xī yǒu yì jiàn kāng
sents.en: It's healthy to breathe deeply.

units.title: Arguing a point
units.intro: Grammar focus: 总之; 何况; 不见得; a 400-character opinion essay

items.en: to rely on; to depend on; by means of

ex.zh: 你用什么浏览器？
ex.p: nǐ yòng shén me liú lǎn qì
ex.en: What browser are you using?

items.en: to look upon as; to regard as

ex.zh: 请问剧场后门在哪？
ex.p: qǐng wèn jù chǎng hòu mén zài nǎ
ex.en: Where is the stage door?

ex.zh: 一位医生告诉过我，吃鸡蛋对我的健康有害。
ex.p: yī wèi yī shēng gào sù guò wǒ chī jī dàn duì wǒ de jiàn kāng yǒu hài
ex.en: A doctor told me that eating eggs was bad for me.

ex.zh: 但我没有害怕。
ex.p: dàn wǒ méi yǒu hài pà
ex.en: But I wasn't afraid.

items.en: to open a business; to open a practice; open (for business)
to pour liquid; to irrigate (using waterwheel); to water

ex.zh: 你最后一次给花园浇水在什么时候？
ex.p: nǐ zuì hòu yī cì gěi huā yuán jiāo shuǐ zài shén me shí hou
ex.en: When was the last time you watered the garden?

ex.zh: 你可不可以帮忙除草浇花？
ex.p: nǐ kě bù kě yǐ bāng máng chú cǎo jiāo huā
ex.en: Could you please pull the weeds and water the flowers?

ex.zh: 我今天得把这本书还给图书馆。
ex.p: wǒ jīn tiān de bǎ zhè běn shū hái gěi tú shū guǎn
ex.en: I have to return this book to the library today.

ex.zh: 我们学校的图书馆很小，但是是新的。
ex.p: wǒ men xué xiào de tú shū guǎn hěn xiǎo dàn shì shì xīn de
ex.en: Our school library is small, but new.

ex.zh: 大象是如今现存的陆生动物里最大的。
ex.p: dà xiàng shì rú jīn xiàn cún de lù shēng dòng wù lǐ zuì dà de
ex.en: Elephants are the largest land animals alive today.

items.en: second of the ten Heavenly Stems 干; second in order; ethyl

ex.zh: 这只梨闻上去很香。
ex.p: zhè zhǐ lí wén shàng qù hěn xiāng
ex.en: This pear smells nice.

items.en: to go on foot; to walk

ex.zh: 从这里步行到你家要多长时间？
ex.p: cóng zhè lǐ bù xíng dào nǐ jiā yào duō cháng shí jiān
ex.en: How long does it take from here to your house on foot?

ex.zh: 我爷爷喜欢步行。
ex.p: wǒ yé ye xǐ huan bù xíng
ex.en: My grandfather likes to walk.

items.en: one after another; in succession; one by one

ex.zh: 房租很可能会上涨。
ex.p: fáng zū hěn kě néng huì shàng zhǎng
ex.en: Rents are likely to go up.

ex.zh: 油价上涨的可能性很高。
ex.p: yóu jià shàng zhǎng de kě néng xìng hěn gāo
ex.en: There is a good chance that gasoline prices will go up.

items.en: to spread; to circulate; to hand down
conscious; aware; on one's own initiative
to focus one's attention; to concentrate on (doing sth)
to pay a visit to; to see (sb)

ex.zh: 尽管雨下得很大，但他还是去医院看望他的朋友了。
ex.p: jǐn guǎn yǔ xià de hěn dà dàn tā hái shi qù yī yuàn kàn wàng tā de péng you le
ex.en: In spite of the heavy rain, he visited his friend in the hospital.

ex.zh: 我去那里看望她。
ex.p: wǒ qù nà li kàn wàng tā
ex.en: I went there to see her.

items.en: heat; quantity of heat; calorific value

ex.zh: 每天早晚，我给我的猫喂食。
ex.p: měi tiān zǎo wǎn wǒ gěi wǒ de māo wéi shí
ex.en: I feed my cat every morning and every evening.

ex.zh: 多亏你我胃口都没了。
ex.p: duō kuī nǐ wǒ wèi kǒu dōu méi le
ex.en: Thanks to you I've lost my appetite.

ex.zh: 多亏了你，我还活着。
ex.p: duō kuī le nǐ wǒ hái huó zhe
ex.en: I owe it you that I am still alive.

ex.zh: 我们需要一辆救护车。
ex.p: wǒ men xū yào yī liàng jiù hù chē
ex.en: We need an ambulance.

ex.zh: 救护车把伤者送往了最近的医院。
ex.p: jiù hù chē bǎ shāng zhě sòng wǎng le zuì jìn de yī yuàn
ex.en: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.

ex.zh: 这本字典对我很实用。
ex.p: zhè běn zì diǎn duì wǒ hěn shí yòng
ex.en: The dictionary is of great use to me.

ex.zh: 这本导游册子或许会对你的旅行有帮助。
ex.p: zhè běn dǎo yóu cè zǐ huò xǔ huì duì nǐ de lǚ xíng yǒu bāng zhù
ex.en: This guidebook might be of use to you on your trip.

ex.zh: 他有多少册图书？
ex.p: tā yǒu duō shǎo cè tú shū
ex.en: How many books does he have?

ex.zh: 我把车库改造成车间使用。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ chē kù gǎi zào chéng chē jiān shǐ yòng
ex.en: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.

ex.zh: 我把它忘在车库里了。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ tā wàng zài chē kù lǐ le
ex.en: I forgot it in the garage.

items.en: to agree to and sign (a treaty etc)

ex.zh: 足球在巴西是最受欢迎的运动。
ex.p: zú qiú zài ba xī shì zuì shòu huān yíng de yùn dòng
ex.en: Soccer is the most popular sport in Brazil.

ex.zh: 他们这么热情的欢迎我，让我感觉家人一样。
ex.p: tā men zhè me rè qíng de huān yíng wǒ ràng wǒ gǎn jué jiā rén yī yàng
ex.en: They welcomed me warmly, so I felt at home.

sents.p: wǒ men xū yào yī liàng jiù hù chē
sents.en: We need an ambulance.

sents.zh: 救护车把伤者送往了最近的医院。
sents.p: jiù hù chē bǎ shāng zhě sòng wǎng le zuì jìn de yī yuàn
sents.en: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.

sents.zh: 这本字典对我很实用。
sents.p: zhè běn zì diǎn duì wǒ hěn shí yòng
sents.en: The dictionary is of great use to me.

sents.zh: 这本导游册子或许会对你的旅行有帮助。
sents.p: zhè běn dǎo yóu cè zǐ huò xǔ huì duì nǐ de lǚ xíng yǒu bāng zhù
sents.en: This guidebook might be of use to you on your trip.

sents.zh: 他有多少册图书？
sents.p: tā yǒu duō shǎo cè tú shū
sents.en: How many books does he have?

sents.zh: 我把车库改造成车间使用。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ chē kù gǎi zào chéng chē jiān shǐ yòng
sents.en: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.

sents.zh: 我把它忘在车库里了。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ tā wàng zài chē kù lǐ le
sents.en: I forgot it in the garage.

sents.zh: 足球在巴西是最受欢迎的运动。
sents.p: zú qiú zài ba xī shì zuì shòu huān yíng de yùn dòng
sents.en: Soccer is the most popular sport in Brazil.

sents.zh: 他们这么热情的欢迎我，让我感觉家人一样。
sents.p: tā men zhè me rè qíng de huān yíng wǒ ràng wǒ gǎn jué jiā rén yī yàng
sents.en: They welcomed me warmly, so I felt at home.

ex.p: tā kě néng mí lù le

items.en: to hate to do sth; to hate to part with; to begrudge

ex.zh: 好多朋友和熟人来了。

items.en: to report for duty; to check in; to register

ex.zh: 我每天都帮我妈做家务。
ex.p: wǒ měi tiān dōu bāng wǒ mā zuò jiā wù
ex.en: I help my mother with the housework every day.

ex.zh: 我忘记在信封上贴邮票了。
ex.p: wǒ wàng jì zài xìn fēng shǎng tiē yóu piào le
ex.en: I forgot to put a stamp on the envelope.

ex.zh: 请不要忘记寄信前要在上面贴邮票。
ex.p: qǐng bù yào wàng jì jì xìn qián yào zài shàng miàn tiē yóu piào
ex.en: Please don't forget to put a stamp on the letter before mailing it.

ex.zh: 她给了她父亲一条领带。
ex.p: tā gěi le tā fù qīn yī tiáo lǐng dài
ex.en: She gave her father a tie.

ex.zh: 我是不会系领带的。
ex.p: wǒ shì bù huì xì lǐng dài de
ex.en: I won't be wearing a tie.

ex.zh: 他买的第一项东西是一个闹钟。
ex.p: tā mǎi de dì yī xiàng dōng xī shì yī gè nào zhōng
ex.en: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.

items.en: to stay up late or all night

ex.p: wǒ áo yè āo duō jiǔ dōu xíng
ex.en: I can stay up as late as I want.

ex.zh: 熬夜是皮肤的大敌。
ex.p: áo yè shì pí fū de dà dí
ex.en: Staying up late at night is very bad for your skin.

items.en: early or late; priority; in succession
to have the courage to do sth; to dare to; bold in
(of an area) vast or extensive; large-scale; widespread

ex.zh: 这些数字总数不符。
ex.p: zhè xiē shù zì zǒng shù bù fú
ex.en: These figures don't add up.

ex.zh: 我能借用你的剪刀吗？
ex.p: wǒ néng jiè yòng nǐ de jiǎn dāo ma
ex.en: Can I borrow your scissors?

ex.zh: 书桌上有一把剪刀。
ex.p: shū zhuō shǎng yǒu yī bǎ jiǎn dāo
ex.en: There is a pair of scissors on the desk.

sents.zh: 请不要忘记寄信前要在上面贴邮票。
sents.p: qǐng bù yào wàng jì jì xìn qián yào zài shàng miàn tiē yóu piào
sents.en: Please don't forget to put a stamp on the letter before mailing it.

sents.zh: 她给了她父亲一条领带。
sents.p: tā gěi le tā fù qīn yī tiáo lǐng dài
sents.en: She gave her father a tie.

sents.zh: 我是不会系领带的。
sents.p: wǒ shì bù huì xì lǐng dài de
sents.en: I won't be wearing a tie.

sents.zh: 他买的第一项东西是一个闹钟。
sents.p: tā mǎi de dì yī xiàng dōng xī shì yī gè nào zhōng
sents.en: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.

sents.zh: 我熬夜熬多久都行。
sents.p: wǒ áo yè āo duō jiǔ dōu xíng
sents.en: I can stay up as late as I want.

sents.zh: 熬夜是皮肤的大敌。
sents.p: áo yè shì pí fū de dà dí
sents.en: Staying up late at night is very bad for your skin.

sents.zh: 这些数字总数不符。
sents.p: zhè xiē shù zì zǒng shù bù fú
sents.en: These figures don't add up.

sents.zh: 我能借用你的剪刀吗？
sents.p: wǒ néng jiè yòng nǐ de jiǎn dāo ma
sents.en: Can I borrow your scissors?

sents.zh: 书桌上有一把剪刀。
sents.p: shū zhuō shǎng yǒu yī bǎ jiǎn dāo
sents.en: There is a pair of scissors on the desk.

sents.zh: 我不想不及格。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng bù jí gé
sents.en: I don't want to fail my exams.

sents.zh: 他穿着上很不讲究。
sents.p: tā chuān zhuó shǎng hěn bù jiǎng jiu
sents.en: He's very sloppy in his dress.

sents.zh: 我们曾经总在星期六傍晚去看电影。
sents.p: wǒ men céng jīng zǒng zài xīng qī liù bàng wǎn qù kàn diàn yǐng
sents.en: We used to go to the movies on Saturday evening.

sents.zh: 每个傍晚我都会喂我的狗狗们。
sents.p: měi gè bàng wǎn wǒ dū huì wéi wǒ de gǒu gǒu men
sents.en: I've always fed my dogs in the early evening.

sents.zh: 稍微冷点儿不要紧。
sents.p: shāo wēi lěng diǎn ér bù yào jǐn
sents.en: I don't care if it's a bit cold.

sents.zh: 他很像他外公。
sents.p: tā hěn xiàng tā wài gōng
sents.en: He resembles his grandfather.

sents.zh: 我在信封上写错了地址。
sents.p: wǒ zài xìn fēng shǎng xiě cuò le dì zhǐ
sents.en: I wrote the wrong address on the envelope.

ex.zh: 所有学科中，我比较喜欢英语。
ex.p: suǒ yǒu xué kē zhōng wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan yīng yǔ
ex.en: I like English best of all subjects.

ex.zh: 英语变成了我最喜欢的学科。
ex.p: yīng yǔ biàn chéng le wǒ zuì xǐ huan de xué kē

sents.en: It was just as I thought.

sents.zh: 我们游览了所有主要城市。
sents.p: wǒ men yóu lǎn le suǒ yǒu zhǔ yào chéng shì
sents.en: We toured all the major cities.

sents.zh: 我是最后交的考试卷。
sents.p: wǒ shì zuì hòu jiāo de kǎo shì juǎn
sents.en: I was the last one to turn in my test.

sents.zh: 老鼠是胆小的生物。
sents.p: lǎo shǔ shì dǎn xiǎo de shēng wù
sents.en: A mouse is a timid creature.

sents.zh: 你买了往返的票吗？
sents.p: nǐ mǎi le wǎng fǎn de piào ma
sents.en: Did you buy a round-trip ticket?

sents.zh: 我买了往返的票。
sents.p: wǒ mǎi le wǎng fǎn de piào
sents.en: I bought a round-trip ticket.

sents.zh: 您不需要提高音量。
sents.p: nín bù xū yào tí gāo yīn liàng
sents.en: You don't have to raise your voice.

sents.zh: 收音机太响了。你不能把音量调低一点吗？
sents.p: shōu yīn jī tài xiǎng le nǐ bù néng bǎ yīn liàng diào dī yī diǎn ma
sents.en: The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?

sents.zh: 我在银行附近碰见老朋友。
sents.p: wǒ zài yín háng fù jìn pèng jiàn lǎo péng you
sents.en: I ran across an old friend near the bank.

sents.zh: 我都没想过会在这里碰见你。
sents.p: wǒ dōu méi xiǎng guò huì zài zhè lǐ pèng jiàn nǐ
sents.en: I didn't expect to see you at a place like this.

sents.zh: 我能问一下您的姓名和住址吗？
sents.p: wǒ néng wèn yī xià nín de xìng míng hé zhù zhǐ ma
sents.en: Might I ask your name and address?

sents.zh: 我问他是否知道她的住址。
sents.p: wǒ wèn tā shì fǒu zhī dào tā de zhù zhǐ
sents.en: I asked him if he knew her address.

sents.zh: 你擅长书法吗？
sents.p: nǐ shàn cháng shū fǎ ma
sents.en: Are you good at calligraphy?

sents.zh: 他是聪明能干的人。
sents.p: tā shì cōng ming néng gàn de rén
sents.en: He was an intelligent and practical man.

sents.zh: 他是个能干的男人。
sents.p: tā shì gè néng gàn de nán rén
sents.en: He's a man of ability.

sents.zh: 我们有必要为上这门课买本教材吗？
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu bì yào wèi shǎng zhè mén kè mǎi běn jiào cái ma
sents.en: Will it be necessary for us to buy a book for this class?

sents.zh: 这些书架上没有很多书。
sents.p: zhè xiē shū jià shǎng méi yǒu hěn duō shū
sents.en: There aren't many books on these shelves.

sents.zh: 书架上放着很多字典。
sents.p: shū jià shǎng fàng zhe hěn duō zì diǎn
sents.en: There are a lot of dictionaries in the bookcase.

units.title: Arguing a point
units.intro: Grammar focus: 总之; 何况; 不见得; a 400-character opinion essay

ex.zh: 元旦就在眼前。
ex.p: yuán dàn jiù zài yǎn qián
ex.en: New Year's Day is close at hand.

items.en: to spread extensively; to generalize; widespread
friends and family; kith and kin
attendant on an airplane, train, boat etc

ex.zh: 他急忙出了办公室。
ex.p: tā jí máng chū le bàn gōng shì
ex.en: He rushed out of the office.

items.en: first; first time; for the first time

ex.zh: 这是个死胡同。
ex.p: zhè shì gè sǐ hú tòng
ex.en: It's a dead end.

ex.zh: 你不介意我关窗吧？我有点着凉了。
ex.p: nǐ bù jiè yì wǒ guān chuāng ba wǒ yǒu diǎn zháo liáng le
ex.en: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.

ex.zh: 我肯定着凉了。
ex.p: wǒ kěn dìng zháo liáng le
ex.en: I must have caught a cold.

ex.zh: 这是一把中式扇子。
ex.p: zhè shì yī bǎ zhōng shì shàn zi
ex.en: This is a Chinese fan.

ex.zh: 叉子从桌上掉了下来。
ex.p: chā zi cóng zhuō shǎng diào le xià lai
ex.en: A fork fell off the table.

ex.zh: 我想要一把叉子。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào yī bǎ chā zi
ex.en: I'd like a fork.

items.en: multicolored; every color under the sun

ex.zh: “我爱你”用法语怎么讲？
ex.p: wǒ ài nǐ yòng fǎ yǔ zěn me jiǎng
ex.en: How do you say "I love you" in French?

ex.zh: 我父母通常用法语对话，即使我母亲的母语是英语。
ex.p: wǒ fù mǔ tōng cháng yòng fǎ yǔ duì huà jí shǐ wǒ mǔ qīn de mǔ yǔ shì yīng yǔ
ex.en: My parents usually speak to each other in French, even though my mother is a native English speaker.

items.en: sour, sweet, bitter and spicy hot; fig. the joys and sorrows of life
